review_title: This rescued my poor chapped lips!
review_text: This lip mask got me through my first north east winter with ease. I’m from a hot humid climate originally, so my lips were in a panic in all the negative degree temperatures, wind, and snow. The cold dry air was absolutely assaulting my lips - until I found this gem! Used in combo with a sugar scrub, this product repairs, hydrates, and protects your lips in an instant. This product feels so luscious and smooth, and makes your lips so plump and pouty and soft. This is an absolute fall and winter essential! I can’t imagine a winter without it now. review_title: good, but cheaper alternatives out there
review_text: I’ve tried many other DE products and have always found them to be a home run for me, particularly their Vitamin C serum and their Glycolic night serum, as well as their Hydrating Serum. I have combo oily skin and had always heard good things about this cream so I finally went for it during a VIB sale. It’s good. I liked the consistency, not too tacky and sticky like alot of gel moisturizers, and I liked how it delivered just the right amount of hydration. It absorbed into my skin nicely and didn’t ever feel oily. However, this lasted just under 2 months, with me using it as a day cream. It seems like a lot of money for something where there are alot of good alternatives. Enjoyed this and might even repurchase it in the future at a heavy discount but will opt for cheaper alternatives.

review_title: I’d give this more than 5 stars if I could!!
review_text: Okay, first off, I received this full size product complimentary from Influenster and Peace Out skincare for an honest review. But that in no way influenced my decision for greatness that is this product! I’m very skeptical when it comes to skin care, even more so with acne products. So to be honest, after the first round of testing this product, I noticed a difference, but thought my feelings on it would be a little biased. So I tried it out again, this time on a holy mother of God zit! I left it on overnight, over the problem area, and when I woke up I felt the circle to see if I could still feel a lump underneath. Sure enough I could, so I was thinking maybe the first time was indeed a fluke. I took the dot off, and the lump was not a zit, but the dot itself that had whatever it pulled from the zit overnight. My zit was GONE! OVERNIGHT! No squeezing, no pain, just clear skin under the magic that are these acne dots!I will absolutely be purchasing these again, and recommending this product to all my fellow acne sufferers! The only thing I should note is, and I only discovered this after trying the first time, was that your skin cannot have anything else on it before applying these dots. No toner, no moisturizer, no cream of any kind or it won’t adhere properly. But that’s literally my only tip as these are seriously a no brained, set it and forget it type of treatment! Thank you soooo much Peace Out God’s!!Note: I attached a picture of the dot after use so that you can see visual proof of its greatness. Sorry, I know that’s TMI, because who wants to see anyone’s zit crap?! Sometimes you just have to see to believe!
I’ve tried other peace out products and this one is no different. Love it and it actually works! Easy  to pop on, leave on overnight and by morning the pimple had gone in size. Highly suggested!

I get cystic acne at times and it can be so frustrating. I apply the dots at night before I go to sleep and they work so well. I wake up and find that my pimple had gotten smaller and some pus has been sucked into the dot. You have to reapply for the deeper pimples but it works well and stops you from picking at your skin.

These things are amazing. While they don’t really work on any of my cystic acne, they work great on whiteheads or any pimples that I stupidly tried to pop. I put them on before bed and by the time I wake up, everything is all sucked out and flat. I definitely recommend these to anyone, a great product to have in case an inflammation pops up.
They do the job. But hey are not amazing. I woke up with a pimple and try a patch and work just fine. I think that for the price they are ok.Don’t have that much patches , but they work .

I love these! I get horrible deep and painful cystic acne and will spend 7-14 days waiting for it to become something that I can clean out myself.   These are not full on miracles but wow do they help! I still have to wait a few days for the deep acne to come forward a bit, once it gets closer to the skin I will put a pad on it and it does not go away but will be visibly looking smaller the next day and closer to the skin. If it opens at all or gets a head at all on it this little bitty pad pulls it to the surface so thickly that I have been finding that the entire process takes 3-5 days versus the 7 to 14 I previously had been experiencing. On non cystic acne It is the little miracle that I pop on and tomorrow it is either gone or opened to the surface that it’s easy to clean out and never be seen again.  Even using one 2 days in a row on the same area I have never experienced any type of drying or reaction, and I do have sensitive skin! They also are a decent color for my fair/light skin that I have walked around my house with a couple on my face and my husband never even notice until I turned my head and the light hit my face just right.

If peace out sees this, please make a large strip out of this material to cover a large area like forehead or chin. I only just recently started incorporating serums  into my skincare routine and found them to help keep my skin moisturized, smoother and more balanced. I didn’t quite know what to expect with this serum but was immediately intrigued when I saw that they incorporated  Long Life Herb, a superfood from Japan, & Niacinamide, into the formula. I also liked that the serum was vegan, clean and cruelty-free.  Unlike my other serums, the  main difference  I noticed immediately was it said in order to see optimal results, you would have to use it twice daily for four weeks. The first time I used this serum was in the morning, during my normal skin care routine. I used it after cleansing like the instructions said. I liked the texture and smell of this serum. The milky white consistency was not too thick and not too watery. The serum blended into the skin easily. There was a very, very, LIGHT fragrance that disappeared immediately after I applied it which I liked  despite not  liking fragranced products on my face. The serum dried slightly  tacky which I also liked. After it was completely dry I did notice a slight glow to my skin which I  really liked as well .Because I have oily skin, I usually am not a fan of products that  leave a glow or sheen-like effect, however I liked the fact that this serum was completely dry and my skin looked glowy versus actually being glowy.  The second day  I used this serum  I decided instead to use it after cleansing and moisturizing my face and used it in place of primer due to the tackiness. Again, because of my skin texture and type, I prefer a primer  that has  more of a tacky  feel to the skin as I find that my foundation sticks better, however I didn’t notice much of a difference. In terms of using it at night it had the same effects as it did in my morning routine. I’m excited to see how this serum  holds up to its claims* and how it effects my skin within the next four weeks.

review_title: A Glam-pire facial that won’t break the bank!
review_text: This is the poster child for “more bang for your buck”—using this just once a month makes my face clearer and more even on average than it was before. It tingles a little both when I first apply it and while I’m wearing it, but as long as I don’t have any open wounds/zits on my face, I’m fine (like, 2 out of 10 on the pain scale at worse). I recommend working your way up to using this—try something like a 10% AHA/BHA/PHA weekly before committing to something this strong.

This is not a beginner’s product for chemical exfoliants. If you consider your skin sensitive in any way I do not recommend this product. If you experience redness or irritation with harsh products, do not use this product. I tried it for almost a full month with three or four uses total and each time my cheeks became extremely irritated and red with red splotches showing up the following days. I wanted to see if that was my skin adjusting to the product but it’s happened each time and I’m going to listen to my skin and stop using this product. By the way, I am not prone to red spots or breakouts ESPECIALLY in this area.

I’ve definitely noticed big changes in my skin, especially when using consistently (2x per week). I have worry lines between my eyebrows and these pretty much disappear when using this. It also really helps with my forehead and smile lines. I’ve also noticed improvement in my skin texture.

review_title: Best thing for my C section scar!
review_text: I like this on my face - I have very dry skin and few products can help that. But with this I wake up in the morning feeling almost kind of oily. It’s probably not for everyone but I like the super moisturized feeling. I don’t use it more than 3 times a week. But I found an alternative use for this which is a life saver. I apply it to my (itching) C section scar (completely healed, but still itches pretty bad once in a while) and the itch goes away! This stuff is powerful. I have tried all sorts of things on my scar - coconut oil, lush lotions, Vaseline, etc.. everything out there. This is the best thing for it. It is kind of wasteful to use such an expensive product as body care BUT if it works it’s worth it for me. Will be repurchasing!!

review_title: Formula is different from my beloved older version
review_text: I recently received a 7 day Clarins anti-aging duo sample from Influenster- the Double Serum & Extra-Firming Energy Day Cream. As a former Clarins employee, I have used the Double Serum & a previous version of the Extra Firming Day cream with phenomenal results in the past, so I was excited to put the new variant to work!One of the reasons I went to work for #Clarins was because their plant-based skincare completely transformed my tight, dry, itchy, sensitive skin after I lost weight. Clarins did what no other brand could for my skin, so I was hooked. Needless to say I was thrilled to give this #VoxBox my undivided attention for a week to test the Double Serum & Extra-Firming Energy Day Cream.DOUBLE SERUM* Two-phase formula that’s oil & water based. * 21  potent plant extracts {many of them organic}— including Banana, Oat, Teasal, Kiwi, Avocado, Goji Berry, Leaf of Life, Huang Qi, Turmeric, & such— to attack visible signs of aging.* Visibly firms, reduces wrinkles, smooths, hydrates, tightens pores, & boosts radiance in 7 days.* Eco-friendly bottle made from PCR & uses less packaging.* Serum boosts the performance of Clarins’ moisturizers.Seven days is not that long to test anti-aging skincare, but these are 2 that provide appreciable results in the short term, but even bigger, better ones 30+ days later. They feel silky smooth, give the nicest finish, & work beautifully under makeup. The drawbacks for me are price & that the Double Serum is not the same formula as the one I used & loved several years ago. The older version seemed to give a deeper hydration & more overall brightening, but maybe I should not compare my past history to just a 7 day trial. It is also important to note that very little product is required, so these may last longer than your typical serum + moisturizer, making them more cost effective. Overall I would recommend this if it’s in your budget or if you could take advantage of a sale.

I’ve been skeptical of makeup prep products for a while now, I always feel like it leaves my makeup application worse off, this is absolutely NOT the case here.  This goes on the skin super smooth and absorbs leaving for face looking fresh and dewy. I love wearing this on light coverage days as well as full coverage. As always the packaging is GORGEOUS and a little goes a far way. If you like a natural dewy highlighted look without the glitter, this is definitely the way to go. I was gifted by Glow Recipe this product,  for my review, but my thoughts and opinions are my own.
Love this serum, it keeps the skin hydrated and glowy! I also love the smell
I was gifted this by Glow Recipe, it has a nice silky texture which I enjoy. It doesn’t help the longevity of my makeup but it does produce a nice subtle glow!

This might be my favorite GLOW RECIPE item that I’ve tried. My sister got this for me for bday & in the couple of weeks that I have used it I have noticed an improvement in my skin in terms of fewer blemishes (which normally aren’t that much of an issue for me but mask-acne is a real thing). I have worn it sans makeup & mixed it with my foundation as suggested on the box & I like my makeup much better now! It helps give that glowy look without being oily & mixing it with my foundation gave my makeup a more natural finish. Highly recommend! I also use the GR watermelon toner prior to this & they are a nice compliment to each other in my morning skincare routine.

This product really is sunshine in a bottle and add such a beautiful soul glow highly recommend mixing it with a moisturizer or sunscreen definitely not on its own because it is very highly pigmented great ingredients and makes my skin Glowy and soft

review_title: The product I didnt know I needed!
review_text: Have you ever come across a product that you never knew you needed? Yeah, for me that was this. I have been rocking the no makeup look a lot more lately, but unfortunately I’m one of those poeple who looks deathly ill and super pale without makeup. Got this as a tester in one of the DE packages I got, so sure why not I’ll give it a try. And holy cow, I just looked awake so alive. My face had color and glow to it and it just made a huge difference when rocking no makeup or putting on a natural look. It’s one of those suble things that makes a huge difference.

I bought this during the VIB sale because Allana Davison raves about it! It’s not supposed to be used on it’s own so I mix it in with either my sunscreen or primer and it blends out nicely. A little goes a long way so I think this will last me a long time. I’d say it’s not like a “omg life changing“ product, but it’s definitely nice to have. It gives you a nice, healthy bronzy glow underneath makeup (or even just for your bare face) and I like the anti-pollution/skincare components it has. I’ve only used it for a few weeks now, but liking it so far!

I admit it - I fell for the hype that was all over social media about this product. The ingredients are great, can’t argue that one. I’m yellow-toned/pale skinned, and it didn’t quite work for me in terms of texture and color. I tried to mix it in other DE products (Virgin Marula Oil, then the B-hydra) but didn’t quite look natural (too oily with the oil and color/texture didn’t work great with B-hydra). If you don’t mix it with other products, you need too much to be able to spread it and it’s way too concentrated. Will be returning this, sadly. Seemed too great to pass up but will have to.

I love this product. It is a little expensive but for me it’s worth it because I don’t end up using every day so it’s lasted me awhile. It’s especially helpful in the colder months when my skin is kind of lack luster, I add this in with my moisturizer and it makes me look a lot more alive lol

This is such a genius product! Add a little bit of this stuff to your existing moisturizer and it gives such a healthy, natural glow- no orange tones at all. I also find that it evens skin tone and smoothes my pores which is perfect for summer when I don’t want to wear a heavy foundation. Absolutely worth the investment!
Absolutely love the glow these drops give you! Simply add it to your moisturizer and you’re golden all day long. I also love how it doesn’t make me oily at all.

Had to experiment with application a bit but I ended up loving it! If it’s mixed in with moisturizer or spf it gives a nice subtle glow. I’ll also use it sometimes alone as a liquid bronzer/contour. Love that it’s ‘clean’.

Day 3 of using this product. I have very fair skin, and terrible facial rosacea. My whole face is nothing but red 24/7. I thought this would be my new fav. Adding this in with my moisturizer is not doing much for my skin. I have been adding two pumps and although from a distance some parts of my face appear tan, my complexion looks uneven and almost more red/pink. I wanted to love this, I’m going to continue for another week or so and see if it will improve my skin overtime.

I have nothing negative to say about this product. It hasn’t caused any adverse effects to my skin since using it and I mix it with Tatcha Water Gel moisturizer for a nice, healthy and glowy base prior to my make up application. It doesn’t make me orange as I feared it would (I’m sure if you just used it on its own, it would be too much) It gives me a boost of happiness everytime I apply it because it just gives me such a nice wash of subtle colour. I can’t say much about whether it really prevents pollutants from getting into my pores but I would recommend it just for the fact that it gives your skin such a nice glow up.
i will forever repurchase this i love that it gives me a little bit of a tan and such a amazing glow and no white and protects my skin from the sun
i will forever repurchase this i love that it gives me a little bit of a tan and such a amazing glow and no white and protects my skin from the sun

I bought this because the reviews for the unseen sunscreen seemed soo good, but I wanted something that would give me that lit within beach glow & let me tell y’all, this did just that!!! It does have a slight sunscreen sent, but it is not strong & the results are to die for!!  PS. You could literally only put this on & some concealer & people will tell you you’re glowing!!

I bought this because the reviews for the unseen sunscreen seemed soo good, but I wanted something that would give me that lit within beach glow & let me tell y’all, this did just that!!! It does have a slight sunscreen sent, but it is not strong & the results are to die for!!  PS. You could literally only put this on & some concealer & people will tell you you’re glowing!!
I loved unseen and now seeing the moisturizing benefits and dewy finish I had to try. After my skincare routine just put this on and go. My skin looks plump and dewy/radiant. Would highly recommend.
I loved unseen and now seeing the moisturizing benefits and dewy finish I had to try. After my skincare routine just put this on and go. My skin looks plump and dewy/radiant. Would highly recommend.
very glowy, looks great under makeup. soaks in relatively quick, doesnt feel like anything on the face after a minute
very glowy, looks great under makeup. soaks in relatively quick, doesnt feel like anything on the face after a minute

Absolutely obsessed! I’ve worn it everyday since getting it & it’s now become apart of my daily routine. Very sheer with the tad bit of sheen. Love wearing under my makeup or on days when I want my skin to look a little refreshed.

Looking for a sunscreen that protects your skin and let’s you look great doing it? Give this a try. It’s lightweight enough to let your skin breathe, yet strong enough to protect you from the sun. Its gentle coverage gives your skin a clean, naturally smooth appearance. Love it!
I’m a huge fan of Fresh and their caramel hydrating lip balm and this is the exact same formula except for the coconut. Definitely reminds me of summertime.
Absolute trash. Doesn’t keep lips moisturized have to keep reapplying. Will never purchase again.

I bought this six months ago, use nightly, and still have a little left.  The coconut fragrance is amazing, but I was surprised and disappointed that the main lubricant is apricot seed oil, NOT coconut or any ingredient derived from coconut.  Correct me if I’m wrong, but I studied the ingredients list, looking for any sign of a coconut essence or ingredient.  Ruins it for me when the smell is obviously manufactured, not real.  It goes on creamy and hydrating, but I don’t notice any extra moisture in my lips in the morning.  Will try other Fresh products, but will def check the list of what it’s made of, first.
Love this product, just wish it was a little bigger. If you use it everyday, you end up repurchasing often. I use this more as a going out balm. It does hydrate well and smells delicious.

Love that this feels so rich on the lips even if applying a thin layer. It’s so moisturizing I put it on under my matte lipsticks and it keeps my lips feeling hydrated. To top it off it smells like paradise and I always get compliments on it ;)

I love ALL Fresh lip balms. I saw this new coconut flavor and bought it. I love it. Very moisturizing and stays on the lips for hours. This is the only lip balm I use and my lips feel so smooth. A little goes a long way.

pretty good and hydrating. it has a strong smell, but it doesn’t linger and it smells good. however, im giving it 4 stars because its kind of pricey and its not as hydrating as other balms like aquaphor
Love the smell, love the texture, hate the unhygienic packaging.Pairs nicely with hand sanitizer. Also doesn’t really moisturize my lips as well as most drug store brands.

review_title: LEMON SEE'S CANDY TRUFFLE or LEMON MERINGUE PIE
review_text: This is a total WINNER! Smooth and hydrating.  I am a lemon lover and they nailed this formula.  The lemon reminds me of See’s Candy Lemon Truffle Chocolates or Lemon Meringue Pie.  I am stocking up because whenever I love a product this much it always gets discontinued.  Please keep this LEMON in permanent stock.  My only wish is that it came in a stick form.  I don’t enjoy putting my finger in the jar but I will do anything for this lip balm.  So worth it the price.  I highly recommend this.  I love it so much I created this account so I could leave my first review.
I love this so much! I got a trial and got the full version too because it was so good! I love the how soft it makes my lips!

The lip mask is actually pretty moisturizing but I do find I have to put on quite a bit or else it dries up too quickly! I find it doesn’t really have a smell which I don’t mind at all, I’ve been using it both day and night to really test it I would repurchase the full size. Also it leaves such a nice glossy finish on the lips.

I usually have pretty dry lips and hate putting on lip products. Putting this at night before bed works wonders. I wake up with softer lips and not having to apply any in the daytime. It might be a little heavy for daytime use unless you have super dry lips but for nighttime this is perfect.

Moisture galore! Seriously. The first time I applied this my lips felt instantly smoother! I feel that the formula lasts a long time on your lips, and when it goes away, you are left with smooth lips for days. I am so glad that I got to review this product for free. It really is an amazing product and it will definitely leave you addicted to its healing magic!
It’s fine. Nothing super special but it worked. Doesn’t feel really heavy.

I received this product to test for free and I couldn’t be happier! The texture is spot on. Some lip masks it is too thick or oily but this is perfect. There is a faint scent but nothing overpowering to wear at night (apparently I’m sensitive)!
Best lip mask. I applied a generous amount at night and by the morning my lips felt soooo much more hydrated. My lips get really dry in the winter so this product will be my go to.

Wow…I thought nothing would top the Laniege lip mask. Got this as a sample and dare I say it might be better…more rich, moisturizing and has less of a scent. Will buy the full size which is crazy to me because I have been using the same lip mask for 3 years!

review_title: One of the best lip masks I have tried
review_text: Recived this from influenster I gave it a try for 1 week before giving my feedback this lip mask has really been a game changer for my lips they are soft and smooth great for these winter months my lips usally are dry and cracked but not since using this product .

I really enjoyed using this lip mask. I’m always feeling dry and chapped. It works great overnight but I actually used it more as a daytime lip balm. There’s no scent or bad taste on it. I like to use a lip stain and then gently pat this over it to combat any dryness. I do wish this came with some sort of applicator.

Very impressed at how rich and hydrating this overnight lip mask is! Honestly, I was a bit skeptical about this product to start out with - in my personal experience, most lip products actually end up drying out my lips, requiring me to reapply the product over and over again just to keep my lips hydrated. This lip mask actually works- not only did it actually last all night, but when I woke up my lips felt really smooth and hydrated! Very impressed! Thank you to Sephora and influenster for sending me a sample to try and provide my honest opinions! I will be purchasing this product again!

I love this stuff. It’s moisturizing without being too heavy. I recommend waiting a good 10 minutes if you’re going to apply makeup following this product. The only downside is you really can’t tell when you’re going to run out, but the packaging does help with germs/contamination. I reached out to DE and they gave me an idea of how long each product should last you. The employee said this one should last 100-110 pumps. So if you use this twice per day, it would last you about 2 months.
I loooove this. Whenever I breakout, I use this cream and it helps to rebuild my skin barrier ! I recommand it for people with dry skin with occasional acne

What I like about this product is that it’s very moisturizing perfect for those who have dry skin. A good thing is that it is 100% free of essential oils, silicones, and fragrance. Including Vegan and cruelty-free perfect for those who looks for these type of ingredients. It definitely makes my skin moisturizing through the whole day. Overall I recommend this product.

Got as sample from influenster to try. It doesn’t smell bad but I wish it had more of a ‘fresh/clean’ scent. The texture is really nice and goes on smoothly. It moisturizes well but not the best I had, and honestly at the price it is, I would never buy.
Great moisturizer to mix with serum- I like the dispenser. Leaves my skin hydrated but not greasy. Iight enough for under makeup and formula leaves my skin feeling soft
This moisturizer is so lightweight and easily absorbs. With my combo skin I can get very oily, but this moisturizer doesn’t cause my skin to produce extra oil. Very very happy!
In love with this moisturizer. It is so hydrating. I apply as the last step of my morning and night skincare routine and my skin feels amazing! I highly recommend!
I have reordered this moisturizer 4 times and a still loving it! It’s perfect for dry winter skin

A winter must-have! I have sensitive skin and this has been a lifesaver for those harsh winters and my mild patches of ecemza I have on my face. This is a really thick cream, so if you’re not into heavy creams, then this will not be the right match for you.

I love this product. It makes my skin so hydrated and moisturized. Even In the middle of winter it does an amazing job keeping me moisturized. I love the thickness of the lotion and it goes on smooth.  I would definitely recommend this product!

Started with a sample (some of the reviewers mentioned tingling and redness) so I could see how my skin reacted. I guess I’m used to acids since I experienced no tingling, burning or redness. WOW! Within 15 minutes of my first use, my skin felt smoother & was actually glowing. Love the Farmacy honey scent and it left my skin feeling moisturized and soft. Got the full size and my skin is still happy with the product and is actually glowing. I use it 2-3x/ week and I’ve seen an improvement in my texture.

I love this serum so much that I’ve repurchased it. It truly defines my skin and keeps it clear and smooth. The morning after using this I can see such a difference in my skin. I will continue to buy this product because the results it produces are amazing.
Even the first time using this my skin was glowing in the morning and it reduced the size of my blemishes as well. Excited to see the results as I keep using it.

review_title: BIG NO NO for sensitive skin
review_text: Wanted to love based on the reviews but I have very sensitive skin. Because of this I patch tested it on my neck and I’m glad I did. I broke out with small red bumps and a dry patch within minutes. It’s too harsh for my skin. It may work for others but if you have sensitive skin BE CAREFUL, the ingredients are very strong.

Very nice formula with just enough sting so that you know it’s working. If you’re choosing between this and a pricier competitor product, I recommend this one ;). I don’t get a glow but I do have nice resurfacing with this product.

I received this as a sample and I immediately loved it. After just one use, I saw a difference on the surface of my skin. My skin looked beautiful.  I am 49 years old with dry, acne-prone, sensitive skin and my skin loved this serum. I’ve already used it 3 times and I just purchased my first bottle.
magic in a bottle. I used to use drunk elephant’s night serum, but this stuff is cheaper and works wonders on my skin.

review_title: better than the drunk elephant TLC glycolic serum
review_text: This smooth my skin and gave it a glow within 2 weeks of daily use. It also absorbs quickly and isn’t tacky so works well with other serums and a moisturizer
Ok yeah I LOVE this product. I love the products that make a difference from the first application! Glow check...hydration check...nourishing a big check! I definitely recommend it!

I have very dry sensitive skin, so I wasn’t surprised that it burned for a few seconds after application the first few weeks. But my skin got used to it and I could slowly use the product more frequently. I noticed my skin was a bit smoother and hyperpigmented areas from inflammation would fade faster, however I think I need a gentler formula.

I got this serum complimentary from Influenster to try out and I’ve held off on reviewing this for about two weeks because I wanted to really give the product time to work. And I must say I’m not disappointed. This feels like luxury when I apply it to my face. Goes on super smooth and quickly absorbs into the skin leaving a really nice glow!. And my skin is visibly smoother and more plump. I’m in love.

review_title: Plum Pump Leaves You With Supple Skin
review_text: My skin just soaked up this serum. At first I thought it wasnt doing anything but after a week I noticed my skin looked supple and had a glow. I would definitely buy this. Only reason I didnt give this product 5 stars is because im not a huge fan of the scent

Recieved this complimentary for testing purposes. I absolutely loved this product my skin looked so healthy and clean. I usually have oily skin and this did not make my skin oily. my skin looked really glowy.
Love love love this! It does make my face feel a bit sticky after initial application but it quickly goes away. I can feel the change in moisture and it has reduced fine lines!

In love with this serum! This is definitely my go-to serum for these weeks!The formula is very silky and watery and it absorbs into my skin quite quickly. I especially like to use it in the morning as its lightweight non-greasy formula sets my skin perfectly for makeup.The serum claims that it contains 5 weights of hyaluronic acid to fills each layer of skins and gives you visible plump skin. After using this serum everyday for about 3 weeks, I do feel my skin becoming brighter and healthier. Highly recommend to someone’s looking for the serum that is simple and good right in place.

I have dry/combo acne prone skin and this definitely broke me out real bad.  Everyone’s skin is different, but there are definitely better hyaluronic serum options out there.  I’ll stick with the inkey list which is like 1/4 of the price and didn’t irritate my skin.  Bottle looks cute tho I guess lol
The texture of it is so light, absorbs really fast and doesn’t feel sticky after. It only takes to drops and my skin feels so smooth and hydrated.

review_title: A great serum, especially for combination skin
review_text: I received this product free for testing. However when it runs out, I’m likely going to purchase it. It’s a nice serum, with only the lightest scent. While it’s a little tachy at first, when I put on my usual moisturizer, it’s completely smooth. I have combo/ oily skin and this serum does not make me at all greasy! I really like it!

I wanted to love this. It’s a very light serum, it looks as though it absorbs completely, but it stays tacky. It has a light scent also, bonus that you can keep it in the fridge and use it as cooling globe.
Very pretty, smells lovely, and works beautifully, my skin felt smooth, bright, and hydrated after using. I had a lovely glow.

I love this product! I recommend it to everyone. I suffer from a very oily nose and bad dry patches on my forehead an around my mouth. For the first time in my life my skin has balanced out, thanks to this serum! I use it in the morning and at night. It is a miracle worker for me! I took off one star because I wish it had a dropper. It is too easy to accidentally get too much product. I just bought a dropper and remove the lid so I’m not wasting so much.

review_title: Not really a necessary product for me
review_text: I have normal-dry skin so I thought this would be the best product for me, but as I got more into skincare, I find that I don’t need this stand alone HA serum because HA is in so many other products. This product was fine. I probably will not repurchase this product once I go through it.

I have combination skin - oily forehead, dry around my mouth area. It’s a struggle. This product (especially for the price), works great on my dry areas. I got this product to review through Influenster!

The contents of this small bottle are amazing. This hyaluronic acid is probably the best I’ve ever tried. It compares to the 50 dollar serums sold by other high-end brands. It’s light, non-sticky, fast-absorbing and very hydrating. Just beautiful.  But the packaging.. if I didn’t love this product so much I would have stopped using it by now bc of the bottle. The product dries around the lid, making it hard to open and close. I actually decanted it into a bottle with a pump and it’s so much easier to use plus I can control how much I want a lot better. It’s probably a small gripe considering how well this product works. Everyone should incorporate this into their routine.
Nice texture. No fragrance. Skin feels more moisturized. Good dupe for drunk elephant hydrating serum. Great for that price!
Not a whole lot of product. I have oily acne prone skin and this product made me break out. I did not think it hydrated my skin

The texture is really great - not too sticky, not too fluid. I think the packaging isn’t the best, and I think it would be better if it were in a dropper style container. However, i LOVE this HA! Normally it breaks me out if I use the wrong kind, so i love that this works and is gentle. I would highly recommend this.

This product was new to me. I was surprised with how much I liked it. It didnt leave my skin feeling sticky nor do it leave any residue. I have sensitive skin and it did not cause me to have any reaction. It felt light on my skin and left my face feeling smoother than before. I recommend this product will be purchasing more especially with its affordable price.
This product is great. I have noticed my skin clearing. It’s a gel like substance and a little goes a long way. If you have acne prone skin this is for you!

Best simple hyaluronic acid ever. I’ve used over 5 bottles!!! I always start with this after I double cleanse and it sets the tone for the rest of my regimen. I usually don’t take the time to write reviews but I appreciate this brand so much and want them to stay in business so this product and continue to thrive!

review_title: Removes makeup, doesn’t make skin dry
review_text: Great for removing makeup and not leaving skin dry. I use this with my foreo luna mini. It foams up nicely and creates a rich lather. I purchased two 150mL tubes when they were on sale for $15. Will definitely repurchase when I run out. I have combo skin. This product doesn’t leave my face too oily or too dry.

I will literally never use another cleanser  again. this cleanser does an amazing job of removing any dirt/build up without stripping your face. it feels so clean after using and doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. ive convinced so many people to buy this cleanser and every one with all different skin types loves it.
Boyfriend loves it and he’s actually using it everyday! Doesn’t dry out his skin and does the job nicely. I use it occasion when I’m at his place and works well for me too for my oily sensitive skin.
Does a great job removing makeup and for a great price. Stings a little when it gets in your eyes so be careful. But, super user-friendly and easy-to-use cleanser.
This is the BEST cleanser! It takes my waterproof mascara off every single time, leaving nothing left, and on top of that its super gentle! Makeup remover and cleanser in one step.

For the past 4 weeks I have been testing Pure Skin Face Cleanser that FAB gifted me and I absolutely adore it!! It has a luscious whipped texture that transforms to a rich, creamy lather upon the addition of water. It is super gentle on my skin, leaves my face fresh + clean, and soothes any redness I have. Some of the key ingredients are Aloe, Allantoin, vitamin E, glycerin, and a FAB antioxidant booster that includes Licorice Root along with White Tea & Feverfew Extracts. Afterwards, my face is incredibly clean but not tight + dry, it feels smooth, and my skincare seems to apply + absorb better.If you want a fragrance-free cleanser that feels like you’re washing your face with fluffy clouds then this is for you!! If have *any* skin type or sensitivity, then YES! This First Aid Beauty Pure Skin Face Cleanser is for you!! I can safely say that I will purchase this when I run out because it has jumped to one of my top 2 favorite cleansers.

It’s nice but not great. I’m 47 with dry skin and it leaves my skin feeling dry. Not extremely dry, but none-the-less dry. It lathers nicely and it takes off all my make up including eyeliner and mascara. I’m still searching for a cleanser that will work on my skin.

This face wash is great! it’s my new favorite and I will be buying again.  A little goes a long way and it even removes mascara easily.  I never have any makeup residue left over or anything.  It also leaves my skin feeling very soft and doesn’t dry my skin out.

Okay wow. I am really loyal to my La Roche Posay Toleraine cleanser because it is so gentle & non-irritating. The ONLY thing I don’t like about LRP is that I really have to work it in to properly cleanse my skin. This First Aid Beauty cleanser is exactly like my beloved LRP cleanser except it is better at cleansing! It’s a little creamier and lathers beautifully but it’s just as gentle. Totally thrilled about this - with someone with acne, redness & combo skin, this is alllllll I need!
I absolutely love this cleanser, for a combination skin, I’ve gone through many cleansers and this is the only one that leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh! Love this product line.
Love this stuff for a quick skin refresh after a workout or a quick moisture pick up after cleansing.

review_title: Not bad, but Lacombe is better
review_text: This kind of works. My face feels a little more hydrated and I still use moisturizer after it.  However, if your skin is really dry I would recommend Lancome Tonique Confort which is another hydrating toner but it works so much better on my skin.  Also, I found the laneige packaging cute but a little wasteful (I tried the smaller size and it came double boxed.  Adorable yes, but not necessary). I do like that it controls how much comes out so that you don’t waste too much.  It’s not bad at all, worth trying.

I found this two in one product okay for my skin. I wasn’t too happy with product only because it has a tacky feeling. Also I have very dry skin and it did not do the trick by itself. I had to still moisturize my skin which then felt too heavy. However my skin was well hydrated in the morning. I think it would be a great product for someone with combination skin. I received this product complimentary from Influenster Canada and Laneige. Thank you!
I loved this toner. This quickly became a part of my daily skincare routine. It left my skin feeling super refreshed, hydrated and soft. I would for sure get this product again.

It’s a decent toner but it didn’t feel hydrating or moisturizing on my combo/oily skin in an area with around 50% humidity. It’s an unscented, milky, minimally tacky, and lightweight watery toner that dries quickly and thankfully doesn’t break me out. I put 3 drops into my hand and pat onto my damp face after cleansing, then proceed with the rest of my skincare routine. I’ve also tried layering this product 2-3x on my skin and yet it doesn’t make my skin feel more hydrated/moisturized.I really wished that it worked for my skin since this is a rare fragrance-free product from this brand, but instead it was a teensy bit drying on my skin, especially around my eye area, even when I avoid applying the toner around my eyes. At least it wasn’t irritating or as drying as the yttp adapt,ogen mist that I’ve tried before. Sadly, this had to go back since my eyes weren’t feeling comfortable (heavy pressure feeling) at all once I started using this, and once I stopped using it, my eyes felt much better.The packaging is a sturdy, frosted plastic that dispenses by drops. I’ve attached a photo of the product.

I love this toner so so much because it’s so perfect for my dehydrated skin and this leaves my skin feeling hydrated with such a radiance! I also really like the texture of this and how easily it absorbs into my skin without any sort of tackiness. I received this product as a free sample but I definitely recommend it!

review_title: Maybe good for a back up
review_text: No scent sticky when first appliedsmooth and filmy textureskin was tight and tonedhad a more glowing area on my face in comparison to other tonersmade me sweatleft skin a bit splotchyskin stayed somewhat tacky the whole 8 hours I wore this

review_title: It sadly didn’t work for my skin.
review_text: Loved the consistency, the smell, the packaging and what the product is intended to be, but sadly it didn’t work for me. A still have over half of the bottle and plan to finish it or give it to a friend.I have combination skin, T zone, and found out this made me extremely oily as is intended for normal to dry skin. So beware if you have oily/combination skin. I would say give it a try and see if this work for you.

THIS IS REALLY GOOD! gentle and effective as a toner, moisturizes my skin well and my face is so glowy and plump after I incorporate this into my skincare routine be it in the morning or before I go to bed. Even before Sephora Canada has launched it here, I have already bought few bottles from South Korea and has been using this for more than a year now. During winter I layer this for about 3-5 times and it really helps in my face moisturization, it’s like an added boost to my face moisturizer. During summer I would only layer this twice. I am on my 5th bottle now and will definitely keep on buying and using this.

I have been obsessed with Laneige for several months, so I was very excited to give this a try. Let me tell you, it does NOT disappoint. This is a two-in-one toner/moisturizer, so it softens like a toner yet hydrated like a moistrizer. I have try combination skin and this has greatly improved the overall appearance of my complexion. I think this is a universal product that could work with all skin types. This is a watery formula (see picture below) so keep that in mind when applying. I have found that using a cotton pad works best for me. It’s fast absorbing which makes it great for a quick morning skincare routine, I use this and then apply my foundation for a flawless application. I’m a sucker for good packaging and I love that this matches the rest of their products on my vanity. I would recommend this, and everything else from their brand. If you’re looking for a simple skincare routine, definitely add this to it! * I did receive this product complimentary for review from Laneige, my opinions are my own.

I love this eyemask! I wake up feeling refresh and ready to start the day! With the changing weather my face gets dryer but this product super hydrates my under eye area! Bye bye cakey-ness from foundation and concealers!

This is a beautiful eye-cream. Smooth and creamy and sits nicely on delicate under eye skin. I haven’t noticed any dramatic differences yet (I mostly struggle with lines) but it is enjoyable to use. I’ve knocked of one star because the jar is designed so that you can really only use the spatula to get the product out. The jar is very narrow at the top and it is difficult to use your fingers. Not very convenient, but it has nothing to do with the product itself.

I loved this product! I used it a few nights per week as a night time eye mask. It is great and smooth, with a little tingle when you put it on. My only complaint was I used it two days in a row, as a night mask, and I did have itchy red bumps on my eyes the following day. They recovered quickly and could’ve been from that plus a combination of other products.

This product is moisturizing but that’s about all I can tel it does. It does not irritate my eyes. I wish it felt more luxurious for the price. I’ll finish it off but it’s hard to get your finger in the jar and the consistency makes it even more difficult to get out.
I love this eye mask. It is very hydrating and I definitely notice a difference in my under eye circles when I wake up the next morning. I received this product for free for testing purposes.

first of all..... PACKAGING OMG talk about luxury feeling. Nice glass pretty bottle. A lot of product in it. It says to use a pea size which I personally think is too much. Unless its pea to use on both lol. Super creamy and I like the smell. It came with a little blending spoon which I love bc I tend to tap too hard. Soaked in my skin fully in about 5 minutes. Next morning, my under eyes DO look visibly bouncier and feel more full of life. So far Im loving it. update: I have been using this eye cream for a while now and I LOVE IT!! I totally recommend because my baggy under eyes and  dark circled are gone. amazing!!

This mask applies very wet and smooth, easy to glide with your ring finger. The smell is clean and fresh. Unfortunately, within 15 min my under-eyes were tacky and not hydrated. Waking up, my under-eye was puffy with no physical or visible signs of hydration.  It also left a flaky residue which I had to be very careful while removing as to not pull at my under-eye. I did not expect fine line results immediately, but I at least expected hydration and reduced puffiness after the first night. I used for a week and to be honest, I felt it made my under-eye less hydrated and the lines more prominent. I wanted to love this product but unfortunately it did not work for me. I am late 20s with healthy skin. I wasn’t looking for a quick fix to aging.It is an odd shape and if you make it through the entire jar, you will not be able to reach the product in the very bottom. I also do not feel the cost for the size is appropriate.

This is my first time trying anything from Glow recipe and absolutely love this product and can’t wait to try more! #giftedbyglowrecipeI live in the NE and the weather has dropped significantly and it’s even began to snow, so my skin has been dry; especially my eyelids. The first time I used this product, the very next day my lids were smooth and they looked and felt hydrated. I love that the texture was thicker, so it helped to really target and spot treat my orbital area, avoiding mixing with my other products. This has definitely become a staple in my skincare routine and love that I can use it universally both morning and night. Using this before my makeup has been a life saver for my concealer; it no longer looks cakey and dry. I can’t say that I’ve been dramatic results for fine lines, YET, but hydration and brightness is definitely noticeable! This is a 5 star product for me!

I’ve used 2 jars of this eye cream and I love using it. I noticed my eye area became smoother shortly after using it regularly. I’ve had people tell me my eye area also looks less puffy as well. It has retinol but I’ve experienced no irritation. It’s an eye mask but I use it as my eye cream both in morning and night. If you’re looking for an eye cream that contains retinol, I definitely would recommend giving this a try!

review_title: Reduced scarring / no wrinkles in sight
review_text: I am one of those people who rarely writes reviews, and I focus most of my attention/wallet toward skin care than anything else. I gotta say, this stuff works. I have been using it for about 3 months and for starters, have noticed that the area under my eyes are noticeable brighter. I put it on nightly under my serum and moisturizer, and literally see a “glowy“ difference, and wake up with brighter eyes. I have used less expensive products in the past, and this has made a noticeable difference in comparison. Second, my esthetician noted that she cannot identify any wrinkles under my eyes (I am 30), and voiced that she is impressed with whatever I am using. Self high five. Third, and biggest effect I’ve seen, is the visible reduction in dark spots and acne scarring. When I layer this, I usually hit the very top of where my pores are and have noticed that in the past 3 months of use, the few scars and dark spots I had are literally gone. This might be ignorant to say, but if it took away scarring, I feel like it must be doing wonders for my eyes and wrinkles. I have sensitive skin, and does not irritate. Sure, the little spoon thing can be annoying, but we’re paying for a good product, not packaging.

This is a great new serum to add into my routine. It has a great silky texture and absorbed very well into my skin. It definitely left my skin feeling more hydrated and a little dewy looking immediately after using. After using for a little my skin is looking smoother and seems to be a little firmer.

This product was gifted by Fresh.  This serum has a light weight texture and has been a good addition to my skincare routine. I’m liking how it makes my skin feel thus far. It’s very hydrating and soaks into my skin well.

review_title: All I need in one product
review_text: Im in love with this product, my favorite serum from fresh is the Vitamin Nectar Glow Juice Antioxidant Face Serum and this is like a better version, have everything im looking for my skin, hydrates, helps with pores and without damaging my skin barrier, it makes my skin super glow which made it perfect for under makeup/makeup prep step!

I’ve had the opportunity to use this serum for a few weeks, and I’ve noticed that it makes my skin feel smoother and more hydrated. It’s formulated with real tea, and you can smell the tea aroma when you open the bottle. It has a bit of an astringent feel  (again, like real tea) and a bit of stickiness when applied, but it dries down nicely.

This serum leaves me face GLOWING every morning and night! I have seen a difference in my skin and I definitely think I am not as dull as I used to be. It’s great for a glow from within look, and I love the smell! I definitely recommend!

I love this serum! It minimized my pores and made my skin super soft! The serum also smells amazing. I usually use hyaluronic acid but this worked better for me. This product was gifted to me but I’ll continue to buy it.

I have absolutely been loving this new serum.  After using it daily during my nighttime skincare routine, I has noticed that my skin looks refreshed and hydrated when I wake up.  There is a scent but it’s not overly strong and the serum absorbs quickly and works well with the other products I use.  Looking forward to seeing the continuous improve over time.

A new must have to my skin care routine! I was previously using two different products but I now only need to use this! As someone with large pores I have been using more products that contain niacinamide and HA. My skin feels so much smoother and soft to the touch, creating the perfect canvas for skincare and makeup.

FIRST IMPRESSION: First time I applied this serum on my skin It made it so soft, smooth, and feeling fresh. The smell of this serum is so citrusy that it makes me want to bathe in it. I love that the texture of this serum is not too thick and sticky. The serum has  a liquid formulation. I love that it absorbs so quickly in my skin. Most importantly that I love about this serum is how it did not irritate my skin at all as I have combo-sensitive skin. I will keep using this and give my full one month update.

This serum makes me skin look brighter! So easier to use with the dropper and has a smooth application as well. It does have a strong tea smell to it but the smell fades away as you blend it into your skin.

review_title: Not very moisturizing for dry skin
review_text: I have very dry mature skin. I only have small hormonal breakouts usually. I didn’t find this was moisturizing enough for me and it made me breakout really bad on my cheeks and chin. I’m not sure what it was that did it but I don’t ever breakout like that so it really surprised me. I gave it two stars because the texture was nice and the smell was pleasant. I took three off for not being moisturizing enough for my dry skin and the breakout.

review_title: scent is amazing and really hydrates skin
review_text: I’ve been looking for a good moisturizer for a while now, and I’m so glad I found this one! I have oily skin, but I found that this product keeps my skin hydrated enough to where my skin doesn’t over produce oil! loving it so far! and the scent is amazing
I’ve been using this night cream for a few weeks and I absolutely love it. I love the smell and texture of it. my skin feels so soft and supple after using this.
Great moisturizer, very hydrating. Perfect for someone in their 20s-30s. Not the most hydrating I’ve tried, but still good! I received this complimentary from Influenster

I have weird skin, weird because it is kinda combined, but kind of dry. So, finding a product to fully satisfy me is HARD. It must be thick enough to give sufficient moisture, but thin enough to not get oily. This product made me happy because it fits all my crazy requirements.Also, I am a true believer that a cream/moisturizer is actually meant to cover your liquid products and conceal the moisture, rather than provide the moisture itself. I tried this product as a stand alone product (just on toner), and I tried this product in combination with my toner, essence, serum and night mask.I found this product to work EXCELLENT in the multiple step Korean method of skin care. And it worked well as a stand alone product. As a stand alone product I did feel like I needed just a little more moisture though.I think the formula is great, the smell is preferential. It is a little sticky at first, but if you do your routine at least 1h before bed you should be fine. I like the texture because it is right in the middle. You can use a little less, or a little more depending on your skin’s needs. I also love that it does not clog my pores, as I have a major issue with pore clogging.I found my skin to be glowing in the morning, after using this product. I would highly recommend this product. Also, the 1.6 oz is a huge amount. I have been using this for a couple of weeks now, and I still feel like I have not used any yet.I received this product complimentary, to test from Influenster.

This has a very similar texture as the moisturizer - not too thick, not too thin. Using the Youth Preserve Moisturizer each morning and this face cream at night has definitely helped hydrate my skin so I don’t need to use as much moisturizer in the morning. Also, I do have mild acne, but haven’t had any breakouts since using their products, so that’s always a plus! This is definitely a great nightly moisturizer/face cream! Oh, and it smells AMAZING!

This is a great light weight, pleasant smelling night cream. I have been using for about 2 weeks every night and this has not broke out my acne prone skin- yay! It is very calming on my skin. I wake up with no redness or dry spots and no new bumps like some night creams cause.

Love love love this night cream! I noticed a difference the very first night I used this. Most moisturizers cause me to break out, and this one did not. I have been using this consistently for awhile now, and can’t go without it! It’s so smooth and creamy and SO moisturizing!!! I would recommend this to friends and family!

This stuff is awesome! The scent is very minimal. It’s non greasy and it only takes the smallest amount to cover your entire face! My face feels soft immediately but in the morning it looked and felt amazing! Highly recommended this stuff.
I loved the fragrance, the texture and how soft it made my skin feel. During the winter months I have to take special care of my skin and this product has become my new favorite cream.

It’s a very pleasant cream, with light scent and light consistency. It leaves some silicony feeling in the morning though. It hydrated my around eye area, but I didn’t see any big results so far. I got it from Influenster free for a review

I like this product. It applies very well with a little going  along way and absorbs into the skin well. Since I don’t have fine lines or dark circles to begin with it’s hard to rank on that but I do see this as a preventative product.

In terms of skincare, when it comes to eye creams, I tend to be a bit more particular and specific about what I’m looking for and what I like to use for my under eyes. I was always taught that when it comes to your under eyes, to be as gentle and take extra care. I started using eye creams here and there when I was in my 20s and only recently started using them routinely and for targeted reasons. For me, my biggest concern when it comes to my under eyes is the dark circles. I’m no stranger to Estée Lauder skincare and was able to sample their night cream some time ago. I wasn’t crazy about the cream and found it to be a bit too “mature” for me personally so I was curious to see if this repair eye cream would leave me with a similar impression… boy was I wrong! I loved this eye cream that I got to try complimentary for my review. My biggest concern was that this eye cream would be heavily scented. I was pleasantly surprised to learn that this eye cream barely had a scent(I get bad headaches and prefer to steer clear of products with heavy scents). I also loved that this repair cream works its magic almost instantly but when you use it consistently, it really helps repair your under eyes! I wear a lot of makeup regularly as well as lash extensions so I’m constantly focusing on my under eye area specifically. When I applied this cream at night the first time, it immediately brightened my under eyes! The texture and feel of the cream is light and smooth like water which I also really loved(versus a heavy/thick cream). Overtime as I continued to use this repair eye cream nightly I noticed a good improvement in my dark circles brightening. I also looked more rested and awake and looked more “youtful”. Honestly, I’m so glad I got to sample this repair eye cream! I love it and would definitely recommend it, I have no complaints and think it works great for all skin types and

I received this product from influenster in exchange for my honest review. It actually came at a great time because my old eye cream was running low & just not doing what I needed it to. I’ve been suffering from some horrible allergies and my skin and puffy under eyes have felt it. This really helps soothe my poor skin. It’s a great consistency & really soaks in over night. I don’t use it during the day, but a little went a long way for me at night and seemed to help with my puffiness. I actually may make this a staple in my routine.
I love how moisturizing this eye cream feels. Seems to be great for sensitive skin. A little product goes a long way. I received this product to test complimentary of Influenster.

When I get this eye gel cream I was a bit skeptical, it advertised itself for reducing fine lines and looking brighter/ healthier. However, after using for almost a month, I can really see the results! It did reduce the fine lines and make your under eye look plumper, but does not really help with dark circles. Another thing I really like about it is the texture is ‘gel’ instead of cream, so it it not greasy and comfortable

I am very impressed by this advanced night repair eye gel cream. The texture is so smooth and soft but it actually feels hydrated after using without feeling heavy without feeling oily without feeling sticky or without feeling like there’s a residue left in your under eye area, like normal moisturizing eye creams do. This formula just felt silky smooth and absorbed into your under eye area very quickly. When I woke up my eyes look refreshed and supple. I really love this product I haven’t seen a huge significance in dark circles yet but I don’t think I have been using it long enough to determine that but everything else looks and feels great after using and that is where to find in a formula that actually works.

This eye cream is amazing, just like everything else Estee lauder makes for your skin. Leave under eyes moisturized, soft, glowy. Overall improvement of dark circles and bags. I received this complimentary of influenster to try and all opinions are my own.

I was super excited to try them.I was in need for a eye cream so this came on time for me. This eye cream was very hydrating and little goes a long way . I did use them day and night. I have seen notice difference on my eye area. I have less wrinkles on my eye .I would definitely recommend this product and have decided to buy them again
I liked how light weight the formula is. I received this from Influenster so it was only a sample size so I didn’t get to see long term results.

It is a little thick and creamy but goes on smoothly and absorbs quickly. It hydrates my skin very deeply. I have really enjoyed this cream and how much softer my skin is. The scent is good too and not too overpowering and the package is gorgeous!

This is a really great moisturizer and it really does what it says it’s going to do,  which is deeply moisturize and hydrate the skin.  Like some of you say it is very fragrance but I personally love the smell. I always wake up with this softest skin and would recommend this for the driest skin.

This cream is great for dry skin. It has light texture that absorbs pretty fast. I use it in summer. I don’t like the smell, that why 4starts. Over all my skin feels soft and moisturized through the whole day. I got it for free for my honest review.

This face cream applies silky smooth to the skin and has a very light fresh scent to it. It’s extremely hydrating without feeling too heavy or sticky. It leaves your face plump, dewy, and cool feeling. I love that it has the hyaluronic acid in the ingredients because it allows me to skip the step of applying that separately. It feels very luxurious and is the perfect night cream to apply before bed.

I like how this face cream hydrates my skin! It’s light and absorbs nicely . It leaves my face smooth , hydrated and healthy looking.I love the scent too.I received this product from Fresh in exchange for my honest review

I really love this face cream is very rich and make my face supper smooth. I have combo skin and is perfect for me doesn’t make me brake out and the scent is very delicious but at the same time not over powering

This was so AMAZING! it smelled so wonderful ! It made your skin look so smooth and your face feels so refreshed ! I will totally buy this out of pocket. The smell is not so overbearing it’s the perfect amount of scent!

I have acne prone dry skin so before I completely apply something new to my face I only test a small spot first. After I saw that I didn’t get a reaction to it I applied it to my face and I absolutely loved it. It left my face so hydrated and soft. The texture is very thick so a little goes a long way.  The scent is very soft light and it smells amazing. I think this product would be great for someone who has sensitive skin or dry skin struggles because it left my skin so hydrated and plumped my foundation went on so  smooth! I will definitely be buying one after I finish this one!

Loving my daily moisturizer as it is smooth, light and creamy onto my skin. It doesn’t make my skin greasy or blocks pores. It has hyaluronic acid which acts as an anti aging property and enriches my skin from within. It makes my skin plump and glowy.

This really hydrates my skin and makes my face looking healthy. It also looks good under makeup. It doesn’t have a sticky feeling. It feels good on the skin and it also smells good. I’ve used this product for two weeks now and I do see a difference on my skin.

What can I say!!! This product is quite amazing!!!! I’ve tried this mask a couple times a week for the past 3 weeks and my skin has come a long way!! It truly does make your skin feel nice and exfoliated, super glowy and smooth!! It has a nice consistency without a strong aroma! Definitely a product I will be repurchasing. (Received this product complimentary for testing purposes)

Got this product in my FabFitFun box and I was quite excited because I had just run out of my holy grail Drunk Elephant Baby Facial. With the different price points I was hyped to try this one out. After about a half a bottle of usage, I will say I’ll keep splurging for Drunk Elephant. The thickness and smell of the mask is something I can’t get over and it just isn’t as strong as the Baby Facial. I didn’t notice much of a different in my skin as far as texture, plumpness or glow and I can’t stand the tacky/sticking feeling after washing the mask off. This product would be good for those trying to ease themselves into this kind of mask, but it just didn’t hold a candle to the Drunk Elephant Baby Facial.

This mask is pretty “ok”. It has a beautiful rose color initially but turns lighter when it dries. I have a sensitive spot under my nose that gets super dry. This mask made that spot burn and redden but it was fine on the rest of my face. It did make my skin feel mice but nothing extraordinary, like it felt “nice” like any other mask or wash. It was kind of annoying that your face has to be completely dry when you put it on because you have to wash your face first but it wasn’t a deal breaker. The fragrance was not too strong but it definitely had a scent. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I tried it for free since it came on an influenster vox box. It’s a great product in a chemical stand point but for me it just didn’t do the work. I guess it’s for a different skin type or maybe it works after more than one application. I have mixed skin, so it’s oily in the t zone and dry in the rest, even though it did help my pores look smaller my face looked dry and not healthy after applying it. I have to pass on this one. I gave it a 3 for effort.
Really luxurious feeling, and smells great. Very subtle     My skin feels smooth afterwards. I have rosacea on my cheeks and this doesn’t irritate it. I find it a real treat to use.

So far I really like this mask. It’s really gentle on the skin, it doesn’t burn or anything, and I feel like my skin was a lot smoother after. I’d recommend giving it a try! I received this product free for testing.

This product is everything I’ve been looking for this summer! The glow it gives my skin, especially on those hot days that I can’t fathom wearing making up, gives me the ~no makeup~ look we all strive for. It goes on so seamlessly and makes my skin feel so great afterward. I’ve beeb recommending to everyone i know. I received this product complimentary from Influenster as part of their OleHenriksen Vox Box.

review_title: Good mask - would recommend for newbies and pros
review_text: This is a reliable PHA mask - my skin is smoother, and softer after the first two weeks. PHAs are a larger molecule which is often safer for sensitive skin, so this would be a great mask if you wanted to dip a toe into the acid game. As an older gal in the acid game, I use it every other night. It helps keep my dry skin spots smooth, and a fresh soft look to my skin.
Was so excited to try it. I certainly didn’t see results it promised.

I am amazed by how great this product is. I have only used it three times and I see a difference in my skin. I have left texture and my skin feels so smooth, baby soft even. I also like the packaging, it keeps the active ingredients safe and the pump makes it so easy to dispense only what you need. I also noticed that my skin looks brighter too. I received this product free for testing purposes courtesy of Influenster
I received a sample from beauty Influencer. I loved how it absorbed really fast on my skin. I probably going to buy a full size

This product was very hydrating for my skin. I have tried and used the original moisture surge in the past and I didn’t notice a significant difference with the 100H. It had a nice gel texture, which I prefer and didn’t have a sticky finish. I have oily skin and this did not make me shiny. It’s not a bad moisturizer, however there are better options out there!

I’ve used Clinique Moisture Surge 72 hr hydrator for years, but was excited to sample the new version. It’s amazing! I have oily/combination aging skin, so I love how clean it feels on my skin and does not add any extra oil. My skin drinks it in and feels moisturized throughout the day and the next. I’m anticipating with ongoing use, it will truly improve my skin and keep hydration for 100 hrs. Highly recommend!

I received a small sample of this cream to try. I have fairly dry skin and this cream did help with hydration. My face felt soft after application and it lasted most of the day. I like that it is not oily and does not leave your skin looking greasy. I do wish some of the ingredients were a bit cleaner. Overall I enjoyed using this cream but did not have enough to see if it has positive long term effect’s from using. I only had enough for about a week! It is a thin cream so if you’re looking for a thicker cream you might not like this one. It is very lightweight which I prefer. I would purchase this face cream!
I expected this product to be super hydrating and it wasn’t. I’ve used their other moisture surge products but this one missed the mark. It does leave your skin feeling smooth, but not hydrated.
I really like the Clinique moisture surge 100 hour hydrator. I was amazed at how it made my skin feel. Left my skin feeling soft and looking great.
Clinique Moisturizer surge is a gel cream that is lightweight, non-greasy, and very hydrating. It absorbs quickly and I love the softness and hydration it gives my skin.
I love this product. It gives my skin the extra hydration boost it needs without making my face look greasy or feeling sticky#freeproduct#influenster

I received this product from Influencer for a trial. I was alittle disappointed at the size sent because you can only test for 2-3 times. That being said the 2-3 times I did apply this product I did enjoy it. It is a very light cream. Easy to apply and blends in well with little work. I still need to wear a mask to work for my job, this under my mask did not create a bunch of grease or oil. I would definitely add this into my skin care routine!

This cream is so good. It doesn’t go on greasy. It’s very lightweight and can be used both day and night. I have combination skin and rosacia on my cheeks. It helped with the redness and didnt agrivate my rosacia. My skin still feels very soft in the morning . I have been trying diffrent moisturizers because of my rosacia and I will definitely be making this my go to moisturizer.from now on.

This is a really nice eye cream. I like that it has a thicker consistency without leaving my eye area feeling greasy. It was very easy to apply and the applicator has a nice cooling effect - nice for warm desert nights! The ingredients works really well in my skin, it loves niacinamide and ceramides! I’ve been able to use it every night, so it seems fairly gentle. I am looking forward to see how the retinol works on my skin over the next few weeks!

This serum is one of my new favorite products and I’m so excited to continue using this! I love how this brightens, hydrates and makes my under eyes look smoother. I’ve been using this for about a week now and I have noticed a difference in the fine lines and my dark circles! The packaging is gorgeous and I love the applicator.

review_title: Amazing! I loved this eye serum!
review_text: I absolutely loved this retinol eye serum! Not only does it have amazing ingredients but it feels amazing under the eye! It really help smooth and brighten my under eye, also I love the applicator, makes it 10x better! It’s super gentle, perfect for all skin types. Highly recommend

Eye product reviews are tricky because it typically takes a while for real results to show. My first impressions of using this product are that the serum applies with ease and doesn’t leave a tacky film. The applicator allows for precise dispensing of the precious product and there isn’t any waste. My under eye area is well hydrated and the serum is non-irritating or drying, despite having retinol in the formula. Since this is a serum, I like to use it as a base layer under a thicker, moisturizing cream. I would recommend that if you need that extra boost. I look forward to seeing what the results of use are in the long term, but my first impressions are A+

I have loved so many of Sunday Riley products except for the Auto Correct eye cream, so I was a tad skeptical to try this new retinol eye serum. Well, 5 Stars Eye Serum has completely blown away any preconceived notions I had because it is phenomenal! The serum itself feels refreshing & balmy, yet it absorbs quickly & leaves the orbital area incredibly soft, smooth, & bright. I have used it just over a week so I cannot speak to long terms results, but I can say that it seems to slowly be improving my fine lines/ crepey areas & dark circles.After my toner & serums I use a pea sized amount of 5 Stars Eye Serum and then apply it with the applicator on the tube (which somehow always feels so cool and revitalizing!). Once it’s applied around the orbital area and at the “11’s” between my brows, I then massage it in gently with my fingertips or a jade roller. The next morning my eyes look well rested (even if the rest of me doesn’t, lol!) and younger, so I couldn’t ask for more! I definitely recommend this to anyone seeking an anti-aging eye cream.

This was not the eye cream for me :( My undereye area is extremely sensitive and after about a week of using this every night, my undereye became extra sensitive and even putting concealer would sting. It is a retinol though so I will continue using it twice a week instead of every night! Hoping I can see results that way and not have to worry about sensitivity because the before/after pics for this for others are amazing!

I wasn’t sure what to expect from this product, as I’ve only used one retinol eye cream before. But WOW - this little gem has become one of the favorite parts of my nighttime routine! The applicator tip is just perfect: it dispenses the smallest amount of product at a time, so you don’t end up with smeary eyes, & spreads it around smoothly & evenly. The texture is creamy & silky, and there is an overall cooling effect that lasts for several minutes. I’ve been using it every night and have experienced absolutely no irritation, and I have fairly sensitive skin, so those of you who may be afraid of retinol products, never fear! I feel like the tube is large enough to last at least 3 months with daily use. I’m super excited to have gotten to try this & will definitely repurchase!

In love with this eye cream! Such a gentle moisturized cream that you can take out on your finger, or the shape of the product will allows you to make it easier to apply directly on your eye. As soon as I apply on my eyes, I can feel it relaxes my tension and give me natural look of my skin.

I just absolutely love Sunday Riley and this product just adds to the obsession. Love it’s cooling ceramic applicator. I think that’s very neat. The product itself is very moisturizing and it brightens my under eyes. Great product with great ingredients! Also love that it is an overnight eye cream!

Cant say enough good things about this eye cream! Love it so much. It apples easily, soaks right in, and my eye area already looks smoother. Retinol products can take a few months to work so I wasn’t expecting to notice a difference right away. I was shocked when I noticed an improvement in my eye area after a few weeks. My eye area looks more hydrated, smoother, and has an overall more awake look. Already blows my other eye night creams out of the water. Definitely recommend!

It is a really thick moisturizer that locks the hydration in. I like that it doesn’t have a smell. I like to use it after a hydrating serum. I got it on sales and you don’t need much to cover your face and neck so it’s an amazing deal! Right now in summer it’s a bit too heavy for my skin but I feel it will be perfect in the dry winter’s day. It feels so nourishing!

review_title: wish I could give it 4.5 stars
review_text: I’ve been really enjoying this moisturizer. My skin is sensitive dry/combo and gets very dry during the winter. Most popular moisturizers don’t moisturize enough so I’m always searching for a thicker cream. The consistency of this is really thick and it spreads almost like lotion. It didn’t give me any irritation or allergic reactions which is a big plus, most products can. I also appreciate how unlike other thicker creams it doesn’t leave me looking greasy or too wet- it dries down almost matte and smooth. I wish it was a little more intense but I can supplement with a hyaluronic acid serum. Excited to see how this works under makeup!

I absolutely love this moisturizer! The product is packaged in the cutest lime green container. The moisturizer consistency is very thick when you first apply it, but in good way. It is perfect for the winter months, especially if your skin gets dry or flaky. The moisturizer melts into the skin and doesn’t leave it feeling oily or sticky. It’s also great that it is unscented, made of natural ingredients, and is super delicate for the skin. I definitely recommend this product for everyone to try!

review_title: Great moisturizer for the winter time
review_text: To start off, I have combination skin but it turns extremely dry in the wintertime cause I live in Chicago. The packaging is so beautiful and really stands out alongside my other skincare bottles.
