The only thing I personally don’t like is the consistency.. it reminds me of a body butter and I prefer my creams to be moisturizing but more on the lightweight side. It’s fragrance-free which is amazing for my sensitive skin and really is hydrating, but I think I have yet to see any other mindblowing results. I use it in the morning on days where I’m not wearing make up and my face only starts to feel a tad dry when it hits the 5-6 hour mark. Overall it’s a great daily moisturizer, and I think the formula would help ladies who have really dry and sensitive skin. I received this product as a free sample.

I really love the vegan milk cleanser of this brand so I had high hopes for this moisturizer. Unfortunately, I found it exremely disappointing. It has an insanely, oddly thick, texture-- to the point that I feel confused about the positive reviews as I am unsure how someone could possibly feel comfort with this moisturizer on their face. I would suggest trying a sample of this, if possible, prior to buying if you’re curious about it.
I received this product complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes. However, I would purchase this product on my own. The packaging is sleek.  This product works great!
I’ve been struggling for years trying to find a good moisturizer, I have extremely dry skin because I take Accutane. This also works AMAZING as a primer!

This lotion is great, it hydrates really well and has a lovely creamy texture. It soaks in quickly and left skin feeling refreshed. Living in midwest in the winter, I will say I need an even more hydrating lotion, so I think this would be better for less dry climates/seasons.

This is a very hydrating moisturizer! I love the way my skin feels after using it.  However, it is on the THICKER side and doesn’t glide on the face smoothly. It feels heavy and a bit oily at first. This is why I have to give 4 stars. It does get the job done and leaves your skin hydrated. Just keep in mind that you will feel this on your face! It can also make you look too oily at times. I can rub the shine off my face after several hours so the absorption isn’t the best. I received this product from influenster for free to review!
10/10 would recommend. I was so surprised that this rich, creamy formula was not too heavy for my combo/oily skin. It’s incredibly pleasant, not greasy, and leaves my skin so smooth.

Totally in love with this brand. I have received this product complimentary from topbox and would say this is worth it if you are facing discoloration.My skin has small discoloration which gets more pronounced in summer but using this product helped me lighten my skin tone and make sure its balanced throughout. Totally worth it.

review_title: Great for anyone with combo or dry skin
review_text: Super light weight formula. Smells like sweetness and blends in easy. I use it at night in my trouble spots and hope to decrease some spots from sun damage. I wouldn’t want to wear under makeup being an oil. Nice birthday sample!

Hands down one of the best serums I’ve ever used! This helps with my dark marks and texture while leaving my sensitive skin hydrated, refreshed and glowing. I’ll continue using this and will most definitely be repurchasing when I run out of it!

I’ve seen a lot of bloggers recommend it, but It didn’t work on me. The serum is so sticky and you have to use a moisturizer after applying it. Didn’t give me the glow or radiance I was hoping to see. It smelled like rose water which I don’t like. It didn’t work for me but it could work for you.

I used this in conjunction with the Vinoperfect Brightening Essence. It absorbs fairly well, though it feels a little sticky (but in a moisturizing way). Others reported fantastic results that I just haven’t seen. In the end, for me the Resveratrol Lift Serum works much better. I do think this product is high-quality; building a good skincare regimen involves finding the product that works best for you, and I suspect this would work well for others.

I have received multiple samples of this over the years, but never used them.  I received some samples in a recent order and thought I’d give it a try.  Wow!  I used it twice a day for a week and even my husband said how nice my skin was looking.  I have some discoloration that popped up during chemo treatments and this is helping to even everything out.  I bit the bullet and bought the bottle.  It’s pricey but it works.
I have very very sensitive skin and this is one of the rare products that really work for me. So good, but so expensive.

i was so excited to try this product and i assumed it would be great for my skin due to the price and it’s label as “clean.” i am sure it is a good product for more mature skin but i still get clogged pores and can breakout from certain things and this was the only thing i could link it to. i wish i didn’t spend 75 for it.

I bought this in the Vinoperfect Serum Set that was sold a few months earlier. I love this serum because it smells great and does an amazing job of healing my acne scars or just the occasional blemish. I decided to finally write a review because it helped heal my skin from some acne bumps and mosquito bites that scabbed over. I try to use it sparingly because it’s quite pricey, but would say that it’s worth the money for what it does.

I’ve used this product for at least 3 years now and I truly cannot find a better serum for my acne scars! After several uses, I noticed that my spots were getting lighter and my redness was reduced. I don’t think it claims to help with pimples, but when I do end up with hormonal acne or pimples by trying out a new face product, it always helps make the pimples go away that much faster and reduced the overall appearance. The times that I have ran out of this and hadn’t repurchased it, my complexion was uneven and I could tell I needed to buy this serum again. This has a very very faint scent but goes away and I will say that the 1oz bottle only lasts for a few months when used every night (I only use this at night after a regular wash, exfoliating wash or mask). Highly recommend making the investment over other serums!
I bought one for me and another for my daughter. We agree that it makes your lips softer than other “solutions” for chapped lips and the smell is not intrusive. It’s a win.
Pretty good doesn’t make my lips peel but price wise eh
this is my new fav! it keeps my lips hydrated and so soft. when you think about how much product you get and how long it will last, the price isn’t high. its well worth every cent.

LOVE THIS! After buying one I bought another so one is in my house and the other is in my purse. It doesn’t sit on the lips, it actually soaks in and moisturize the lips. I feel like some lip balms/chapsticks can sometimes look messy and oily and this one does not at all, my lips have never been this soft! I will definitely keep repurchasing this product.
I wish I didn’t love this so much because it is on the pricey side for a lip balm - but it works better than anything else I’ve tried and I have dry lips from working in a hospital with very dry air
Love the smell and very moisturizing on the lips. A bit too expensive for the product though
love this balm!! it cured my chronically chapped lips

Moisturizing at first but then it started drying my lips to the point they were flacking. And the size of it is a little too big and weird to apply on the lips. I’m a DE fan! I’ve been using their serums and moisturizers for years but this product I don’t like a d don’t recommend.
I did not know a lip balm could be so amazing. My lips are never dry after using this.
Cute packaging, but this lip balm made my lips dry and peel.

I am absolutely in love with all their products, but specifically, this Violet-C Brightening Serum has made a huge HUGE difference for my skin. I have been using it for about 3 weeks now in combination with the Essence, and my skin is a lot smoother and softer, more even-toned skin, it looks healthier overall and has made applying makeup SO much easier and BETTER! I use to have bad acne and had spots on my face but I noticed it’s fading away (not sure if this products is suppose to help with it, but I noticed the marks fading! and they’ve been there for months!) I’m impressed with Tatcha products. I’ll definitely be continuing using this. Thank you to Influenster and Tatcha for sending me this complimentary to try!

I received this in a Vox box from Influenster and I’m absolutely in love. This makes my skin feel so plump and healthy. I’ve also always had extremely textured skin and this has almost completely rid my skin of it. I will be purchasing this when I run out. I’m giving it four stars because the first one I received the cap was glued on and we had to break it to get it off, luckily tatcha sent me a new one.

I ravished this product for free as a sample for testing purposes and it is truly amazing. It’s smells sweet like vanilla! I have been using it for about a week now and already have noticed my skin has a brighter, more even tone. 10/10 would recommend.

This serum is seriously transforming my skin! Everyday my skin looks more even and bright! Bye bye dullness! I received this serum along with the tatcha Essence in a complimentary Voxbox and have absolutely fallen in love with the brand!

I received this product for free for testing purposes. I have only used this product a couple of times so far but each time I have used it my skin has felt AMAZING. I can’t wait to continue to use this and look for long term results!

review_title: Have to try it to believe it!!
review_text: This product is unbelievable, just after the first use I felt my skin was so smooth! This product is not heavy at all and does not even have a smell to it which makes you feel confident that you aren’t using harmful chemicals on your face like many other serums! And dries within second after massaging it into skin.

This serum is extremely rich and nourishing. I use after using The Essence from TATCHA and it leaves my skin feeling supple and hydrated and looking radiant and rejuvenated. It is fragrance-free and soaks into the skin right away. I received this serum complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes and couldn’t be more satisfied with them!

This is an amazing serum! I have dark spots from cystic acne and this has really helped them. It also makes my skin brighter and plumper. I use with the Tatch essence. I received this product complimentary.

I wanted to love this stuff. The bottle is really pretty, and the promised results were intriguing. The serum itself is really watery, which is strange for a serum. In the end, I just didn’t see any results after using a full bottle. I’m always happy to pay any price if a product works, but I won’t be repurchasing this.
good for acne prone skin. lightweight and absorb easily. awesome ingredient
This product is a great addition to my AM skincare routine. The oil is pure but gentle on my sensitive, oily skin.

review_title: Holy Grail! Constant Compliments On My Skin!
review_text: This oil cures all! I have hormonal breakouts and with this oil I don’t even experience them anymore. Recently I had stopped using this oil and I had a pimple on my cheek that I popped. It bled and it crusted over but still had a nasty scab and was poking out on my face but when I put this oil on my skin at night, I woke up with NO bump and no dry, crusted scab. I had a very small mark where the pimple had been which is unusual for me because I am dark skinned and I usually scar immediately when I get pimples. My sister asked me what I had been using on my skin because my skin looked so smooth and I said just some rose hip oil from The Ordinary! Every woman needs this in her skin care routine. I apply just 2-3 drops and it immediately absorbs into my skin. It doesn’t really have a smell at all and it’s not greasy at all. I even got my boyfriend to use this to help improve the surface of his skin and reduce his breakouts. He loved that it didn’t make his skin shine. I don’t use any other moisturizers on my skin anymore and many other rose hip oils out there aren’t organic, cold pressed and 100% rose hip oil and might I add CHEAP! I LOVE this oil!
wow. my face feels so supple and smooth! I would highly recommend. doesn’t break me out either.

This oil is everything I hoped for! My skin is oily (yet sensitive), so it is very rare that I find an oil that works for me. It absorbs rather quickly and makes my skin feel so supple and moisturized. It leaves my skin with a healthy glow. I also use it for face massages.

I wanted to really try this because my mom has one and I tried hers and loved it.  Mine has a very bad fish smell to it and my moms has no odor at all....not sure if I got one that’s gone bad or it’s supposed to smell??  I am returning it and getting a new bottle so hopefully second time around it works for me.

I would die without this! I have oily, acne-prone skin that is very sensitive to irritation. This oil helps seal my moisturizer in and has not broken me out, which is a huge plus. I apply it in layers at night and my skin looks great in the morning. I would not recommend using it in the morning since it does have quite a bit of shine to it.

review_title: My not-so-secret weapon against dry skin
review_text: I first discovered this oil about 4, possibly 5c years ago when my skin was going through a major upheaval - very dry, flaking skin, post inflammatory hyperpigmentation - and have had a bottle in the house ever since. I am sharing this genuine and authentic opinion as a Sephora Beauty Insider Community Ambassador.  In the warmer seasons, my skin is combo (oil T-zone and dry cheeks). This comes in handy for those days or nights when I need something to soothe redness and infuse more moisture into my cheeks.  In the cooler months, this is part of my daily evening skincare routine - mixed in with my moisturizer or applied as the last step of my skincare routine; or sometimes I do both. In the winter when my skin is dry all over and some days, very, very dry, I keep a bottle on my nightstand, to moisture my face and hands just before turning out the lights. My skin drinks up the goodness overnight and my skin looks rested and looks and feel nourished. I cannot recommend this oil enough. It saved my skin years ago and I’ve not been without it since. The price is hard to beat, but be assured that this is not just a good product for the price point, it’s good, period.

This little bottle seems to last forever. I ended up not using it as intended, as part of my daily moisturizing routine, as it turned out to be a little heavy for me and caused me to breakout. But it made a great inexpensive eye serum - no problems at all there, in fact super happy with that application.
saved my dry/combo skin. i’m so in love and i’m about to purchase my 2nd bottle!!!
I love this for when my skin is very dry I put it on at night and it’s all moisturized in the morning!!!!

This product should be a staple in every over-40 person’s arsenal to treat uneven tone and texture.  I’ve seen a HUGE change in the tone and texture of my skin AND my pores seem so much less noticeable.  I’m on my 3rd bottle and I will be getting more.

This was the first serum I ever consistently used in my routine! The  results aren’t out of this world, but I did notice a more even complexion and less texture, as well more radiant/supple skin. I would totally recommend this as a beginner serum since its not intimidating at all for a skincare newbie like myself. It’s a gel like consistency but gets thinner and more liquidy as you spread. It leaves a sliiightly sticky residue but that goes away after applying moisturizer. Overall, I’ll probably purchase this again!
Used this for a month, twice a day, and saw no difference in my skin.

Nice but I could live without it.    Nice base before makeup that has a little of everything if you don’t want to buy a ton of different products.    Easy application.  Little bit goes a long way.   Try the smaller size first. Large one is big.
This brand is just WoW ! Love the effect of the product on my skin after only 1 try!
I like this serum, it hydrates nicely and I find my skin tone is more even! Also can’t beat the price, I usually use this in the morning and use a stronger serum at night.

I started using this and the Tata Harper Hydrating Floral Essence at the same time, and the combo is pure magic. My skin is so soft, plump, and hydrated! I feel like I don’t use a lot of this serum, maybe 2-3 drops, yet it covers not only my face, but neck and chest too. While a little goes a long way, I still feel like I’m going through it quickly.. luckily it’s so affordable I’ll just order another bottle soon

I’m so happy I started using this product! When I learned about The Ordinary I was immediately intrigued and started doing my research. Buffet continuously came up as a recommended product for all skin types for anti-aging. It was also what I could get from The Ordinary - they have some other products that have been out of stock for so long :’(. Luckily this has been in stock. First off, it absorbs quickly, but not in a drying type of way. The serum is pretty clear and a super light gel consistency. It feels great on my skin and I enjoy putting it on. Secondly, I do think it’s helping with anti-aging. I feel my skin a bit tighter, but even better is the brightening effect it had. I feel like my skin is becoming that coveted word: “radiant.“ I’m really happy I bought it and have frankly bought even more than I need because I am so scared of it being out of stock like the others and I love it too much!
broke me out a lot even though i have pretty clear skin and i don’t have sensitivity problems. the breakouts went away after i stopped using the serum.
Good serum, gives good hydration for my combination skin, doesn’t feel too greasy
I’m rating this 5 stars because I havent used a better facial oil. This oil is very light and locks in moisture to my skin. Its not greasy or uncomfortable at all! I think its a little too pricy.

I fell in love with Drunk Elephant when a couple of Sephora’s cast members used the Protini Polypeptide Cream has on my face before my makeovers. They’re the ones who told me to mix the products to get the best effects. Now I use the cream, Vitamin C Complex, and this oil every morning. People tell me my face looks radiant. I attribute it to Drunk Elephant.

The first time I used this oil three years ago I felt like it clogged my pores and caused me to develop white heads, however, it no longer does that. I’m not sure what was going on with my skin then but I use this oil paired with the tlc framboos and I love the results. I wake up to smooth hydrated refined skin.

I love this oil!! Can’t say enough good things. It’s light, hydrating, and absorbs pretty quickly. I use it by itself at night after my skincare routine or mix it into my moisturizer in the morning if I need a little extra hydration. It can appear a little oily when you first put it on but once it absorbs I think it gives me a nice glowy look. And it’s such a good price for the smaller sized bottle  - my last one lasted me 6 months using it every day.

I opted to buy the smaller size of this oil as I feel I could make it last a while. All I do is take the dropper out and let a few drops land on my finger tip, I don’t even squeeze down on the dropper. I apply this around my eyes, eyebrow area and on my lips. I love the feel this leaves on my lips in the morning and at night.  I have noticed my brows growing in the more sparse areas as well. I am a huge fan of DE products and even have my friends loving it!

SAVES my skin from the dry winter air! Still have to see how it is during the summer months, but so far it is amazing. Also really wonderful for those with dry cuticles. Only took a star off because of the unnecessary high price.

I really loved this product on my skin when I used it at night. It soaks into your skin pretty quickly and leaves it feeling really hydrated without being greasy. My skin can be sensitive and this did not break it out at all. Also very neutral in terms of smell which I like. Would definitely purchase again. Only takes a few drops so the product goes a long way.

I love this.  I had never used an oil on face until I tried this when I first started using DE. This is amazing I thought it would make feel too oily and it does  not.  It works amazing mixes in with lotion for extra moisture.  I love putting it on after using DE baby facial makes my skin feel so smooth. It’s a great product I use am and pm and it’s part of daily routine

review_title: Does not cause breakouts! Miracle oil!
review_text: I breakout very easily all the time. This product hasn’t caused breakouts it actually assisted my skin to heal and prevent breakouts. I only use it at night or under my makeup as a primer. During the day I use an oil controlling cream. This oil minimizes my fine lines as I’m getting close to 30. Definitely recommend to everyone.
I found this oil very light and has a pleasant scent. The applicator is also easy to use.
Absolutely love this product. Only been using for a week but can seriously already see a difference in puffy ness and dark circles.

review_title: Slow And Steady Wins The Race
review_text: This is a product which will be preventative. Beauty products do not erase what you have already done to your face. I’ve been using this for over a month and a little goes a LONG way. It goes on so smooth and my makeup goes on top with no issues or funky streaks. I’ll for sure buy again! And this will be a product I will stick with for years. This will be the true test. I’ll let ya know when I hit 40! Dont be afraid to invest in your skin... it’s a long term investment with rewards you wont notice for years to come. Stop being impatient with your skin care!

review_title: NOT SO GOOD FOR CONTACT WEARERS!
review_text: this eye cream is nice but if you wear contacts or suffer from dry eye and easily get irritation, then this might not be for you. Otherwise if you none of that applies to you, this is a nice silky eye cream that feels soothing and smoothing.

The packaging and design of Tatcha, it never fails to disappoint! When I learned about this new eye cream I was pretty excited to try it. The skin around my eyes area is really sensitive so when it comes to choosing eye creams I’m really picky. I gave this eye cream a try and it is working wonders so far. It is hydrating and lightweight. I wear it to sleep every night and my under eyes feels a lot softer. Not quite sure if this blurs fine lines as mentioned since I don’t have much around my eye area. I received this product for complimentary testing purposes.
Haven’t seen amazing results but I like the texture and it absorbs really fast.  Non-greasy and light but still gives good hydration.  One of the better eye creams I’ve tried.

review_title: Texture is nice, but that’s about it
review_text: Texture is nice, but I havent noticed any wow results.  It’s ok, probably not worth $60.

Some products don’t work for everyone - this eye cream is exactly that for me. I don’t see a difference in my eyes save for the now pronounced undereye puffiness this product gives me every morning. Not a fan!

I like the way this product feels on my skin. It’s very lightweight, but still feels hydrating and I like how I can really feel it soak into my skin. It has a slight fragrance to it, but it’s almost not noticeable in my opinion and I value that as well.I would recommend this product! I received this product complimentary to review, but all statements and opinions are my own.

I redeemed the small size for points and was able to use it for about 3 weeks or so. It feels nice and smells good, but I’ve noticed no difference in my undereyes aside from them being moisturized. I wouldn’t purchase this.
Hydrating and illuminating. It does it’s job! Scent is very minimal.

LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS!! I noticed the next morning when I put it on my eyes that the dark circles were completely brighter. It feels so smooth and hydrating and a little goes a long way. Ive tried 90$ eyecream from kate somerville, and other expensive eye creams, but this showed results and I’m certain that you will love it.
helps with puffiness and dark circles. the best eye cream I’ve ever used!!

I’ve always hated my dark under eye circles, so I’m always on the hunt for something to reduce their appearance. This cream is really nice, great packaging, and not sticky. I think it’s great for the price! I received this product to review through Influenster!
I bought this and was skeptical with such a low price. But this is great!!! It really helps with puffiness and dark circles.
I try the product for 3 weeks now, didn’t really notice the different. so i think it’s ok ?

Not sure what the hype is. I used this until the bottle was empty, but didn’t notice any difference. I left it in the fridge to make sure it was cold when applied. The formula is really thin and watery, and It’s not the most moisturizing, nor does it reduce any puffiness.

I am a fan of this eye cream. I find it goes on nicely, the price is right, and it works to make my undereye bags a little less puffy. I see lots of reviews here complaining that people use it for months but see zero progress - caffeine is a TEMPORARY fix. think of it as cosmetic. I use this in the morning then a different eye cream over it. this is a much nicer formula than the Ordinary caffeine serum - i prefer the cream to the ordinary’s runny serum. the only reason i give this fewer than 5 stars is i find it a bit drying on it’s own.
I really like this! A little goes a long way! I did see a difference in my under eye circles and overall puffiness of my eyes ! Only wish it were vegan but it’s a great product.

Love love love this product! I was constantly struggling with dark circles under my eyes from working night shifts and this product made them disappear! My undereyes were bright, soft, and full! It’s my new staple!
I’m very surprised on how great this eye cream worked. Within a week I noticed that my eyes were less puffy and lighter. For the price, its definitely worth trying.

Based on the amazing reviews I decided to get a free sample of this product. I have dry/combo skin and it usually loves rich products. Not this. I started breaking out on my under eye skin within days of trying this sample. I stuck with it in hopes my skin was merely purging. NOPE. The breakouts only went away after I stopped using this and went back to my combo of Mario Badescu Hyaluronic Eye Cream in the day & Kiehl’s Midnight Eye. I loved the rich texture but my eyes didn’t. If you have sensitive skin be wary.
Will not repurchase. It didn’t blend into my skin like others and I didn’t see any difference, so I’m happy that it’s out of my skin care collection.

Super creamy and feels great on.   It is a little greasy but at night if you want more hydration it works perfectly. My under eyes get really dry and I can use under my eyes during the day but have to use a tiny bit.

I’ve had better eye creams. It’s very thick and sticky. I just haven’t gotten around to using it as much as I would have liked. I suppose it’s a good eye mask for nighttime but it’s not very convenient under makeup. Meh. Expensive too.

review_title: A nice moisturizing nighttime eye cream
review_text: This eye cream isn’t revolutionary, but it is very moisturizing. It didn’t help with dark circles, but it was very cooling and refreshing to apply at night. It’s a little too heavy/oily for day wear on me, especially bc I have oily under eyes, but great for a night time eye cream!
best under eye cream ever! it seriously is amazing!

Love this eye cream. I use this and another because this is really for moisture only and not my sleep bags. Lol but this is great my daughter and i both have been using for over 6 months and Both purchase. It’s thick but it feels so good. Little goes a long way always use my ring finger to apply so it’s not over doing it which can happen. Love it. Kiehls has great products.
I can actually see the difference after just one day. It really smooths the eye area and makes it look hydrated.
I just bought it again. Very nice under eye cream. I have no complaint. I use it at night and in the morning.
I use this in the morning. It’s light and still gives good moisturization. I prefer something a bit heavier for night.  Works well under make-up.
This eye cream has a nice cooling feel which is probably what helps with the depuffing.

This eye cream is the only thing that has ever made me look less tired. Like when I wake up feeling like a cave person, this makes me look awake and rested. With consistent use, it also brightens the eyes and reduces puffiness - exactly what the bottle says. I highly recommend.

Since using SR Autocorrect it has helped but not a huge change in the under eye darkness department but doesn’t hurt either. It’s a bit heavy & hard to get just a tiny bit out but one “tiny” pump covers both eyes. No crazy for the scent but at least scent doesn’t linger.

review_title: No more puff and dark circles
review_text: After a week of using this cream I’ve seen a little less puffiness under my eyes, and my dark circles have gotten a little better. This cream is expensive but a little bit goes a very long way so I can see this lasting a long time.

The Sunday Riley Auto Correct Brightening & Depuffing Eye Contour Cream is a really wonderful product.  I saw a good difference on my under eye area.  The puffiness was reduced & made me look a little more brighter.

I have been using this for a month now and it works well. I haven’t received any blemishes from this product. I will say that I don’t have a lot of puffiness to begin with. I did use it on my forehead though! I have fine lines there i’m trying to get rid if that it’s helping to soften up.

I recently got this product and have been using it for just under two weeks and WOW!! I’ve already seen a major difference!! I’m so impressed. I will be buying this from now on!

This one is one of my favorite eye creams . I don’t usually use it too much but this brand has me hooked . I like the smoothness and I like the feeling and smell as well . It worked after two weeks of using it which I find amazing . I recommend this one .

This stick is so easy to use and keeps your hands clean while you apply. I like the finish to this clear stick, it is not sticky and doesn’t leave any white residue. I really love how this makes applying it easy.

I generally liked this product. It is very convenient, easy to use and most importantly effective. I was in the sun for hours and didn’t burn. My only complaint is not being able to wear it everyday, as the finish is very sheer and not in a good way. My face felt very oily the entire time it was on my face.

This sunscreen stick is SO handy! I noticed no streaks nor a weird smell and am totally going to keep this in my handbag for daily touchups.

I was hesitant when I opened this because it just looked like it was going to feel like putting deodorant on my face, but wow was I pleasantly surprised! Totally love this product. I always struggled with sunscreen product having thick stick white leftovers after application, but this clear stick is amazing transparent and can be applied over the makeup or under without forming any think layer. Would totally recommend with the spf for summer’s.

I was really impressed with the packaging. Very sleek. The clear stick formula works great abs doesn’t leave a white cast. The scent was a bit strong for my liking but It’s not an issue. I think this is a great product and I will be using it more closer to summer. I received th his complementary from influenster

review_title: Effective and fun, but not an essential
review_text: I have naturally large pores that tend to get bumpy with sebaceous filaments, so that is what this review is focused on, not blackheads or whiteheads. I noticed that after I removed the strip, there was a noticeable blurring of my normally VERY visible pores, and this effect lasted all day. By evening my pores looked their usual (genetic) size, but visibly clean. When I run my finger along the top of my nose, I no longer feel rough bumps, even a day later. I would recommend this product to anyone with sebaceous filaments who wants a temporary pore minimizing effect or rapid smoothing. I’m not sure how this would compare to drugstore versions, but obviously it does have added beneficial ingredients that those products do not have.Downsides to this product: There are only four nose strips per package, and since I didn’t need the rectangular strips, this was very expensive per unit. Like many other customers, I wish they would sell these two varieties separately. The nose strip must be placed carefully to avoid tugging at the under eye area, and removed slowly and carefully to not irritate the skin. Since it does pull at the skin when you remove it, I am not sure whether it would be safe to use daily to achieve the pore blurring effect, and at any rate it is too expensive for me to use daily. Using a retinol serum or exfoliating acids could probably smooth and minimize pores just as effectively and you would get more uses out of that kind of product.  Note that this product does not PULL blackheads or filaments out like a traditional pore strip, so do not expect this. Don’t get the strip wet! I sprayed it with a mist last night unthinkingly and this made it hard to remove and irritated my skin.Overall I am not sure whether this is a product I would want to incorporate into my routine, because while I love the way it produces results immediately, I’m not sure it’s necessary except for special occasions or other rare days when I want to rapidly unclog my pores.
I received this product as a free sample from pinchme. I absolutely loved it! I could tell a difference in my pores and blackheads. It also made my face feel refreshed!

This product is a good way to gently and effectively remove congestion of pores without the stinging from regular pore strips. Leave the strip on your nose at night removed it in the morning. It’ll leave your nose soft and clean. Do it weekly for maximum results!

But,  there are few things that I don’t like. 1st: it’s too fragranced for skin care (smell is nice and light,  but it’s an extra irritant). 2nd: pump is not good at all. review_title: Will change your pores! Not for daytime
review_text: This product has lasted me an entire year, and it’s amazing. It really does clean and shrink your pore size. With continued use, some of them will even go away! I am 37, in a dry mountainous climate and have combo skin: oily t-zone with normal-to-dry other areas. This product is the only thing that has ever actually shrunk my pores, and you don’t flake like a molting lizard the day or two after use! It’s very powerful, so even using just 3X a week is enough for results. It is very sticky/tacky though, and could not be worn during the day like it claims. But as a night treatment it is worth every  penny. My skin is CLEARER and my pores are clear, and shrinking still!

only bought this for the packaging... but after using it for two months i can confirm it really makes your skin softer and more noticeably glowy. never used a toner before where i saw results like these. definitely a keeper.

this like... doesn’t do anything. i’m dry/combo and on a bare face it makes me look shiny for a few minutes then it’s no noticeable difference. it does even less to my makeup. literally doesn’t make my makeup look any different whether i spritz it before or after. also, two spritzes for your whole face? i need at least four/five to cover everything, especially if i’m wearing foundation, and it’s tiny as if it’s some gold in the bottle... so i’m halfway finished with it and have used it maybe 5/6 times. i wanna love tatcha and this packaging is to die for but the actual product? hard pass. i see better results with a jumbo 7 dollar bottle of evian face mist from tj maxx.

review_title: Didn’t think it did much until I ran out
review_text: I got this moisturizer as part of the YTTP skin routine set. At first I was underwhelmed - it didn’t seem to make much difference in my skin. Then I ran out, and now I can tell a huge difference in my skin’s moisture level even though I’m still using a moisturizer. I have a fairly deep line in my forehead that had smoothed out quite a bit but is now back in full force. I will be getting more when my current moisturizer runs out!

I have combination skin and this moisturizer did not work for me. It feels nice upon initial application, but after a few moments of wear my face felt dried up. It didn’t matter how much I put on, within a few minutes it felt like the moisturizer had left and taken the moisture from my skin with it.I tried to make it work for a month to see if my skin would adjust, but my skin kept itching slightly and breaking out in random spots. After a month of my skin acting up, I wanted to look at the ingredients to see if there was something I missed that was causing my skin irritation. So, I flipped the glass moisturizer jar over to inspect it closer. The ingredients weren’t listed there as I expected, but I saw black specks sitting inside the bottom of the jar. At this point, I realized I may have recieved a faulty product. The seal was removed when I had first opened it, but I just assumed it had come off into the lid as I unscrewed it. I ended up returning the product.Despite my overall experience with the product not going well, I am still giving the product two stars because of the two redeeming qualities:1. I love the brand philosophy of Youth to the People and I would still happily try their other products.2. I think this product could possibly work well for people with super oily skin. I don’t think it’s a bad product; I think that it just didn’t work well for me.

This is the first moisturizer I’ve ever tried and I wish I did it before. I started using it because I saw dehydrated skin, showing small wrinkles (I drink a lot of water and do sports intensively every day). Even though I do not have a lot of comparison material, it doesn’t irritate, is full of known and good ingredients, smells nice, and is just leaving my feeling fresh every morning and night without any tightness. 1 Star less because it runs out quickly (every month) and is not cheap.

I love the ingredients in this moisturizer. I have sensitive oily acne prone skin and this did not make me break out. The smell is not overwhelming but I did feel like my skin would be become really oily as the day went on.
Did not work for me and made my skin very sore.  I used after the Superberry mask and between the two my skin became very inflamed.

Received a sample and loved the way this left my skin soft and moisturized, so I purchased the full sized. It smells good, almost like nothing. It comes with a little paddle to apply, which is nice. I was using the latest Drunk Elephant and this is more moisturizing.

I loooove this moisturizer!! It’s so lightweight and doesn’t make me feel oily. I apply it before my makeup and also sometimes before bed.

Okay, first of all, I just finished a sample I’d gotten in my allure box & loved it so much that I just bought the full size. It’s amazing. It originally went on looking kind of shiny but once it absorbed, my face wasn’t shiny or greasy at all. It calmed my irritation & soothed my redness. It didn’t break my skin out & it actually helped clear up the couple of breakouts I already had. I have a frown line on my forehead that has started to look softer & is less noticeable now (whaaaat?!). My skin looks clearer & more even, & it feels softer & smoother now. This stuff is 10/10, seriously. A little pricey, but I wouldn’t have bought the full size for this price if I hadn’t been so impressed with the sample size I’d gotten. I only used it for a week and a half before I ran out (used it 2x/day; also a little went a long way with this in my case) and it already did everything I described above; I can’t imagine what wonders it’ll do after a month of use!

I’ve tried many high end products in this arena over the years, so I believe it’s fair to consider myself of “advanced” level expertise. In a nutshell, this formula is smooth, satisfying to apply, and effective. I waited many weeks before reviewing so that I could give the product a fair amount of time to “work.” So many people are too quick to judge skincare products; give them time to do their thing! As far as packaging is concerned, Dior is expert level; the soft pink and silver design just screams luxury, and honestly looks stunning even just sitting on my shelf! Beginning with the first actual application, I was immediately impressed with this product. The formula is luxuriously soft, easy (and satisfying) to spread over delicate skin, and has a lovely, dainty floral fragrance. There is a slight tint that effectively blurs my pores and offers a subtle radiance that reflects light beautifully. I mostly wear it as a primer under foundation, for the blurring and smoothing benefits, but I also wear it alone on days I want a very natural look. I think it is so flattering, even on my “seasoned” skin. After about two weeks of daily use, I could tell a slight but noticeable improvement in the texture of my skin, especially around my cheeks and nose. These areas continue to improve as I continue to use the perfect skin creator every day. I believe that the fine wrinkles around my mouth, nose and eyes are becoming less and less noticeable as time passes as well. Thus far, my results have been encouraging and impressive, and I will continue to use and recommend the product with confidence!

This is an amazing moisturizer. My skin felt soft and silky smooth after a single use. There weren’t any visible benifits until about a week after i started using it. This is a game changer! I️ can noticeably tell a difference in my skin. I️ do not appear as blotchy and my skin is more even.

review_title: Calms down my complexion and clears redness!
review_text: When I was a Sephora Play! subscriber I got this in one of my boxes back in fall of 2017. I really wasn’t expecting much, but I ended up absolutely loving it and used up the entire little jar. Then I bought the full version because this is my new favorite mask. I feel like every time I use this it helps so much with my acne. It calms down the redness on my face (because I have red cheeks with acne scars) and overall makes my complexion look so much better. I am acne prone and I definitely feel like it helps when I have breakouts. I use it a few times a week but wouldn’t mind using it more. Some people either love the smell or hate it. I really really like the earthy herby smell but my husband absolutely hates it. Hah, it’s great when I want him to leave me alone. :)

Results aren’t immediate though, didn’t see any until the following morning. For the price point I probably wouldn’t buy this again as the ordinary’s red serum peel gives me the same results for $8

Listen to the reviews! On FIRST opening the smell was gross, it was dark green with black fluid floating around and I am definitely not putting on my skin. It’s so different than the sample I received previously. Really disappointed.

I’ve tried this out for a month now, about once or twice a week. The first time, I rinsed it off with warm water and didn’t notice any results. I really recommend adhering to their advice suggesting that you should wipe it off with a wet wash cloth. I think leaving a little on your skin will help the product work on it for longer. I don’t find that it helped with any existing breakouts or prevented any others, but eventually it does help make the rest of my skin feel fairly smooth and seems to be helping with my PIH marks.

This mask smells so good, like the BEST smell ever!!! Every time i use it, even my dogs want to come smell my face because it smells so good and interesting. Anyway, the mask itself calms my skin, gently exfoliates and turns down redness from minor breakouts. I love the texture and i keep mine in my skincare fridge for an extra cooling effects and to keep the product good for longer. did i mention the smell tho it’s like honestly my fav part

Newest favorite addition to my skincare routine. The pores on my nose have become a bit larger since my late 20s and this mask helps clean them right up! Very gentle on my face - and I have extremely sensitive skin.
Bought this yesterday and love it! The smell is amazing. It’s a great exfoliator yet gentle at the same time. I bought the 6 oz. tube and I know I’ll be repurchasing.

I do love this product but the smell........ it is strong and very off putting. It is a strawberry scent but it is not the smell I expected. I do love the product so I ignore the smell and it does not last. I love that it is not too harsh but works well. I find that I use a lot of the product each time but I will continue to use and consider repurchasing.

Fresh Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash is the best if both worlds—a gentle exfoliator and an effective face wash. I used this daily following the Fresh Soy Face Wash and it was amazing at effectively removing makeup. It never left my face dry or tight. It can be used alone or after oil cleanser. The package said it can be used daily. Although the sugar granules did dissolve fairly quicker than other sugar scrubs, I felt more comfortable using this every other day to avoid over exfoliating. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.
Meilleur exfoliant : l’odeur, la texture, la délicatesse, tout est parfait pour ma peau. Je suis en amour avec le parfum fruité de cet exfoliant et il laisse ma peau nette et lisse.

I received this for testing purposes from Influenster! This stuff smells AMAZING. Like red skittles I swear! It is super gentle and feels great on the skin. Just be careful mixing physical exfoliants with chemical exfoliants! I use chemical every night and when I tried to incorporate this it really dried my skin out! However this is a great physical exfoliant for 1-2 time use a week!

This sugar scrub smells so great and works great too! I used it tonight to take off my makeup after i used the soy facial cleanser and it took the rest of my base makeup off! The sugar crystals in it mixed with water make for such an awesome gentle exfoliate! I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

This wash is UNREAL. The consistency is so luxurious, it smells divine and the glow you’re left with is incredible. No harsh grit here - the sugar melts into your skin as you massage leaving a silky, smooth, supple feel. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

After oil cleansing, once or twice a week depending on how my face feels I use this! It’s not overly gritty and the sugar is very fine. This face wash doesn’t leave my face feeling stripped. It does have a scent, but it’s very light and I don’t notice it after I rinse. I love using this! It keeps my pores clean. On myself, I feel like it gives a brightening/ glow effect. I would recommend this to someone who doesn’t want a harsh scrub!!
Great for sensitive skin, the scent is divine makes me want to eat it. Product works well and its not harsh on skin
Absolutely love. Amazing smell and super gentle. Does not irritate my skin but still does the job. I love it and will buy again

I really liked the consistency. It’s creamy and I noticed a difference in my skin when I Added this product. It began to lighten My dark spots and my skin was brighter. I would buy this again. I think a second bottle is needed to see a greater difference.

This serum has a great smell and definitely did brighten my skin. For the first few days, I had a nice glow instantly. However, it did cause cystic acne after one week of consistent use. large cystic acne bumps after about a week. I kept using it just inin case it wa

review_title: Look Ready for the Day, Even if You're Not
review_text: This is part of my daily skin care routine.  I apply this every morning after toner, and it does an amazing job of perking up my skin.  I feel like it creates a great texture and plumpness.  Definitely helps me look ready for the day, even if I’m not.  The price point on Sunday Riley products is definitely high, but their products deliver real visible results.

Brightens overall appearance of skin, smells great. My skin looks more hydrated and dark(age, freckles and acne) spots look leas noticeable. Will make me break out if I use too often, and can be a bit oily feeling under foundation and/or other face cream. This product works best when you learn how your skin likes it best - mine every other night with a few dabs of evening facial moisturizer on top, on nights I’m not using Retinoids. Also works on scrapes and scabs to promote healing and leveling of scab surface. Use with salve and scabs will heal faster. Pricey, but worth it. Buy mini size to try and play around with application, you’ll love it.

I’m so glad I get this amazing Vitamin C serum was gifted by Sunday Riley. I used it in my day time routine. It works perfectly with my other skincare products. After I use it for a week I feel my skin brighter and softer. I’ll keep using it and recommend to everyone

review_title: Might be a good product but it’s a NO! For me.
review_text: Received a deluxe sample in my Sephora play box. I was super excited because I’ve heard such good things. I didn’t even read the reviews I was so excited to try. SO I used it the same day I got it, added it to my skincare routine. The next day I noticed some small pimples. But I refused to give up. SO I gave it another try, repeated it in my skincare routine. & My skin broke out SO BAD! Wasn’t about to use it again because the breakouts were so bad, I couldn’t risk it! SO I wouldn’t recommend if you have sensitive skin. I also have combination skin, currently on the dry side because of the winter. It just did NOT work FOR ME & my skin!!!

review_title: new addition to my skincare regiment
review_text: i wasn’t sure i needed a vitamin c product in my routine (already a fan of Good Genes in the morning, A+ at night). But i got this when i splurged on a kit of Sunday Riley products so I gave it a shot. after just three weeks i am seeing some lightening of dark spots on my face. now using this daily and alternating between my other products at night. This is sticky, yes, but less so than the Drunk Elephant product. and it smells WAY better.

My skin felt great and soft. My skin evened out and looked great. Texture seemed to be diminished as well. I really like this product. It smells like oranges! I was given this product free for review.

I received this complimentary from Sunday Riley for my honest review. I’ve used this for a solid month & am seeing clear results; there is an immediate glowing effect from first use, but after a few weeks, you can see a brighter skin tone & dark spots lightening. I had old sun damage spots that just would not lighten even through 3 bottles of other Vitamin C serums, & I am seeing them fade after 4 weeks of this one. It does take some getting used to: instead of a runny/gel serum, it’s like a thin cream (see picture) with some texture to it. I use it after cleansing & toning, but I can usually skip other hydrating products after using this & sometimes go straight to SPF because it’s moisturizing enough for my combo skin. It has a protective feel to it like a moisturizer, but is not greasy or sticky. I love that it has helped simplify my routine. I also tried it with the Good Genes lactic acid treatment & it was amazing - the two combined give such a dewy glow! And, I’ve used it in the evening before the CEO Glow facial oil for a super rich night treatment. I would definitely repurchase this even though it’s expensive, because it feels luxurious & works better than more basic serums.

I gave 5 stars because I don’t think it’s the products fault, it’s definitely my skin (or user error 😉 bypossibly using too much). I’ve noticed a slight break out after using the product but…. I have noticed a significant improvement in overall skin texture. My skin, is absolutely horrible for being dry. After using this product, my skin has been able to hold moisture better than I can remember. My skin feels tighter and looks brighter. It’s also minimized dark spots. - Packaging and presentation are flawless- The scent isn’t over powering at all- Product does everything it saysThe best of all, cruelty free ❤️

I really like this eye cream. I’m in my early 40s, and I’ve noticed my skin has changed from being oily to dry. I have been using this eye cream for about a month day and night I find it super emollient but not greasy. In the mornings I have applied it after washing my face and it absorbs pretty quickly. After about 15-20 minutes I am ready to prime my face and put on my makeup. I find that it does smooth out my under eyes by moisturising and tightening. The tightening feel is strange because it’s not drying, it’s the opposite. I received a free sample, which is what I am basing my review on, however I am considering buying a jar after aim done with it. Another thing, a little goes a very long way. I do 1 tap of the cream with my ring finger and I can use that tap under both my eyes. I love this eye cream. If I were to have 1 con, it would be that I wish it smelled less. I do not like applying fragrances products on my face.

I really like this eye cream. It’s smooth, creamy, and very hydrating. It feels great going on! There is no residue or residual oily feeling.  I’m a contact wearer and sometimes eye creams will bother my eyes if my contact lenses are in, but I’ve had no issues using this eye cream. I only gave 4 stars because I’ve been using it for a couple weeks now and only see a moderate difference in the lines around my eyes, but the area is so perfectly hydrated and I do see some improvement so I’d still recommend it.

i recieved this oroduct in exchange for my Honest opinion. That being said I find the cream to be extremely hydrating and soft. I have sensitive skin and this product did not irritate.  i have a hard time finding eye creams that i like and id say this has to be one of my favorites.  ive been using this about two weeks but think is need to test a full jar before giving it 5 stars

I truly like this eye cream. It is thick which is perfect at night and smells really nice.The packaging is simple and pretty and the lid is lovely.A little goes a loooooooooong way. No need to go overboard as this is a thick cream.

I received this product as a free sample in a Vox Box from Influenster. I was so excited to try this product because I heard that it had great results in only one week. I must say, I did see results after one week! I used this product for one week on one eye to see the difference and you can totally tell which eye I had been using it on! My first impression was the packaging was beautiful. When I opened it, the smell was a bit floral but not overwhelming. I liked the little applicator it came with. When I put it on the first night, it did feel really thick and I didn’t know if I’d be able to wear it morning and night like it said on the packaging. However, when I tried it the next morning, it worked well under my makeup and didn’t make it wear any differently. The first thing I noticed with the use of this was that my eyes seemed much more moisturized. By the end of the week, my fine lines had lessened in number and depth. I don’t have any real wrinkles but if it works that fast on fine lines I would imagine that it would work on wrinkles too, although it would probably take longer to notice a difference. I like the amount you get in the container because you don’t really need that much for each application. $70 is more on the expensive side, but it definitely works better than other eye creams or serums I’ve used. Now that I’ve been using it on both eyes for a few weeks, I’ve decided to only use it at night but I am still seeing results!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review or opinion of it. Overall, I’d say it’s extremely hydrating. It does a great job plumping up the eye area and limiting the visibility of wrinkles. It does not get rid of wrinkles per say. Overall, I would definitely continue pur Co asking because it has been by far the most eye hydrating product I’ve tried to date!

Shiseido is a prestige brand, they’re known for their amazing products. Age has a way of creeping up on you before you know it.  I’ll be 48 this year (yikes lol) I prefer to use skincare to help slow the process vs is fillers.    Shiseido Beneficance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream is truly a unique product.  Love the wand applicator, you don’t have to use your finger to apply the product, more companies should do that.  The product is nice and rich and soaks right in to your skin leaving your skin nice and silky.  It’s significantly reduced the puffiness under my eyes in such a short amount of time.  I’m looking forward to seeing the changes in my skin.

review_title: Took years off the appearance of my eyes!!
review_text: New Holy Grail eye cream! When I say I have tried every eye cream on the market I really do mean it. From drugstore all the way up to la Mer, even prescription creams. Nothing has ever wowed me like this one. It goes on cool and you can immediately feel the intense hydration. It’s not thick or sticky like some eye creams, just silky and hydrating. I wear this at night because even an hour later, my under eye area is still moist! I wake up and my eyes are refreshed and hydrated. Now for the amazing part- I have used this cream for 3 weeks straight at night, not only do my eyes feel hydrated and amazing - but they look that way too. Seriously, In three weeks I have noticed a significant reduction in fine lines and wrinkles! It seems to have taken years off my eyes. I just turned 51 and I swear my eyes look younger than when I was in my 40’s. I just bought a back-up in the Sephora sale because I never want to be without this eye cream.

I’ve been using this eye cream on and off for years. I take a break, try something different and it is NEVER as good as Shiseido’s eye cream. I use Bioscience (Squalane + Marine Algae Eye Cream) in the morning and this stuff at night. It’s super moisturizing and combats the dryness I started experiencing since being prescribed Tretinoin.

review_title: An Eye Cream That Truly Works
review_text: I have genetic under-eye dark circles and bags, and with aging (57) I am now adding lines to the mix. Go me! I got a sample of this and was surprised to see how much better my under-eye area looked when I used it. Concealer and makeup go on over it great, too. Believe me, I have tried soooo many eye creams over the past 3+ decades, from drugstore brands to $125+ luxury brands. While not cheap, this works and falls in the middle price wise. I’m convert. The skin around my eyes looks so much better when I use it.

Great vitamin c product, I’m just opposed to the formulation— it being an oil. I received this product from Influenster for review purposes. I enjoy it, but can’t really use it how I’d like to because it’s an oil and i have extremely oily skin.

This oil have a slight rose smell which is not too overwhelming. I was expecting the oil to be heavier and  meant for nighttime use but surprisingly it feels so light and soft on skin. I have not noticed my skin being brighter yet but it definitely feels more moisturized and soft.

This is a great product to moisturize your face. I initially was putting it on both morning and night but because I have normal to oily skin, I felt it was too much in the morning for me. I think it would be great for someone who has normal to dry skin in the morning. For me, it works great at night. I wake up with super soft skin every time I use it. It also leaves a nice glow. I would purchase in future.

review_title: Did nothing for my skin concerns
review_text: I used just about the whole bottle and saw no difference in my skin tone or texture. Just did not work for me.

I really love this.  I recently tried Drunk Elephant C firma and didn’t care for it at all. this serum however is amazing. Has lessened my fine lines, especially in the forehead area and pores seem minimized. just perfect.

my friend introduced me to this, got a sample of it and now I can’t get enough. It’s worth the price; for any skin types and especially for my acne prone skin, it does not break me out and it helps with reducing redness!

review_title: It's not the same as before
review_text: I’m not sure if they changed the formula or if the one I got from sephora was different from when I bought directly from Biossance; but this gave me huge sebum break out; It was strange, I thought it was my time of the month but I stopped using it and returned it. I got towards the end of the old bottle and couldn’t get all the products out
I sometimes avoid oily serums because i feel as though they bog down my skin. This, however, feels so light and does rejuvenate my skin. When I use it at night, come morning, my face feels more taut.

I wasn’t a fan on implementing facial oils into my skincare routine, until I tried the Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Oil. I have a combination type skin, and some facial oils tend to be heavy and comedogenic on me. So I used to apply the facial oils on my face only on the days that I would go in fully with my facial massager (aka pamper day), then cleanse afterwards and apply my skincare. But now, I quite enjoy adding an oil, well this oil, into my morning and night time routine. I have implemented this facial oil into my morning and night time routine for the past week and let me tell you. I never thought I would add an oil into my routines, but my skin has been loving it and not feeling heavy at all. It has a very light, natural, fresh rosy scent to it, which I love and the lightweight texture just sinks into the skin quick, making the skin feel hydrated, soft, tight, glowy and not oily at all. ⁣One thing though, the price of this 30 ml bottle is $72. It is very pricey, but I do feel like the product does a pretty amazing job. If you like splurging on skincare and you love facial oils, you must try this one. Also, a little goes a long way. I’ve used it  morning and night for an entire week and still looks like new. *I received the product complimentary from @influenster for testing purposes*. *All opinions are my own.⁣

This is a really nice oil. I have very dry skin and the is so hydrating and makes my skin feel so good after I use it. I received this for testing purposes from Influentser but I highly recommend this and this brand.

I was using the Fenty foundation and an employee at my local store suggested this instead. I’ve always had my foundation become oily and slide off very quickly. This solved the issue. I love the SPF, too. This created a nice finish, and it’s super easy to apply more throughout the day. It’ll blend right into an already finished area.

review_title: best mattifying product for my tzone
review_text: This is the only product I found that helps keep my tzone not oily throughout the day. No other foundation has the same mattifying power as this one. I have combination sensitive skin and it doesn’t cause any breakouts or other skin problems However this product is not hydrating enough for the rest of my face so I have to use this on my tzone and the original cc cream for the rest of my face, which can get pretty costly. I wish they would make the mini sized ones in all the shades!!!

This product has way more coverage than I was expecting. Two pumps and it’s comparable to a medium-full coverage foundation for me. When I bought this product I wanted something lighter for the summer than what I typically wear for foundation. I do love that it has SPF in it and I like the skin-like finish it has after using one pump. With that being said, it does move around your face throughout the day even with powder applied. Also from what I experienced, if you use more than one pump there is some cracking around fine lines on your face. I’m glad I bought it for the summertime, but I probably won’t be buying it again when there are way better options out there for CC/BB creams and tinted moisturizers.

I LOVE this! This is my go to every day foundation and has been for a few months now. I don’t plan on changing it anytime soon and even bought a second bottle. It s easy to apply and sits nicely on the skin. It definitely helps with oil control for me and stays on pretty well throughout the day. Definitely a great buy!

I was really excited when I came across this product, but was immediately disappointed. It does not blend as well as the original cc+ cream. The color match is also off from the original. I’d rather touch up my makeup throughout the day with the OG than use this one.

This CC cream has a smooth coverage and lasts pretty well. It provides evening out of skin tones and a light amount of coverage. It didn’t settle under my eyes and I did not bake nor use a setting spray. The only downside is using the product without any additional finishing is it did sweat off.Note: I was sent this product to try all opinions are my own.

This foundation is great as far as coverage goes, but for whatever reason it really accentuates my texture. However, it’s one of the only foundations I can find that actually matches my skin’s undertones, so I remedy the texture problem by mixing it with some primer (I use the Olehenriksen’s banana bright face primer) or another more radiant foundation.
Heavy, full coverage and moisturizing. NOT mattifying by any means. I have combo skin which is not incredibly oily and this product breaks down so quickly on my face.
I like the product but, I have oily skin and it doesn’t perform well throughout the day. I end up having makeup sliding around

review_title: Thick, but has great coverage, doesn't feel cakey
review_text: To be up front, I received this product for free from itcosmetics to review. I got the fair shade and started trying it immediately (it’s 110 in Texas, so perfect). I first tried a small pump on my hand and was a little turned off by how thick it is, but it promised to be matte, stay all day, and have SPF, so I gave it a go. The first try I wasn’t a huge fan due to the thickness still. However, the second day I used a damp beauty blender and spent a lot more time blending. I ended up using way less product and it looked SO much better. I have been using it for about a week and a half now and am very happy with it. It’s not something I would probably wear year round, but it’s beautiful for work and date nights!!!

I like this balm. It works well and doesn’t anger my skin. I switched to this one after drunk elephants slaai made my face explode.  For me the smell could either go away or be an actual smell but this halfway thing isn’t ideal because whatever smell that is in there doest totally cover up the waxy/oily smell that the balm just has normally so it just sorta smells like a slightly scented waxy crayon. Just the waxy smell would be fine honestly. I dismiss this because it works fine and gets off my mascara etc and its not on my face too long. I should also note i have rosacea and this was ok for my VERY fussy skin.

This product is amazing for getting all of your makeup off. Everything seems to melt right off my face and not to mention how good it smells. I’ve completely stopped using makeup wipes and switched over to this for my nightly routine. It’s also really nice to do a double cleanse with as well.

This was alright. If im honest, the packaging is what did it for me, its orange! And quality too, sturdy glass jar and a scooper. I used the whole container and will say i was a little bummed the first time i tried it bc it left a bit of a film behind. Farmacy Green Clean and DE Slai didnt do that for me. Not a huge deal bc my 2nd cleanse would take care of it.The smell isnt the best, it smells like candy but its not bad. If youre in to smells the Farmacy one smells like lime sorbet and i love it. As far of exfoliation, i didnt notice very much. I use acids regularly so thats probably why - i think this would be a good exfoliating option for those with sensitive skin for sure. Overall i think its good but wont be repurchasing, im on the Deviant Cleansing Concentrate right now and loving it

I got this with some of my reward points. I really like this balm, it smells really good and takes off all face/eye makeup without any irration to the eyes. Some I noticed have reviewed it’s hard to get off but I just rinse off with water and muslin cloth and it comes off very easily. I’m going to purchase full size!

I absolutely love this new way to take off my makeup! It worked well in dissolving my all day makeup. The smell is nice and light and it left my skin feeling smooth and bright! Absolutely In love with this product!

Overall, I really like this cleansing balm.  It has a subtle, fruity scent, and my face feels smoother and more hydrated.  The only minor downside is the texture.  When I rubbed it on my dry hands, it felt like a thicker/heavier oil compared to other cleansing balms I’ve tried.  However, I think it rinsed well.  I should note that I double cleanse, so I can’t tell if it leaves a residue.

review_title: Hard to rinse or wash off
review_text: Smells nice, melts on skin easy, takes makeup off. Does not rinse off well or even come off well with most cleansers. It feels waxy on skin instead of melting away with water or even cleanser. Was excited to try, but disappointed. I prefer the Farmacy cleansing balm and the drunk elephant one too. I’m glad I got it as a sample with purchase instead of paying for a large one.

review_title: very good product - doesn’t break you out
review_text: It’s a pretty good product for makeup removal. I would say it’s not the best I’ve used, but I’m not upset by it. The one thing it has going for it over my previously used cleansing balms/makeup melts is that it does not break out my skin. Drunk Elephant works better than this, but it destroys my skin. So I think it’s a good trade-off considering. I’ve also tried Farmacy’s balm and I still like this one over it.
got a sample to try it out. doesn’t emulsify well, and turned into a white cast sticking on my face, had to use a cloth to wipe it off!
This is the best product i’ve found to remove waterproof mascara (even better than coconut oil)! It doesn’t leave your skin greasy and washes off easily with water.

This serum is god sent! It is the first tatcha product I’ve ever tried and is making me want to try everything by tatcha now. The serum goes on my skin so smoothly and feels great to apply. A little goes a long way and that matters when products are pricer! Since using My skin texture feels so much smoother, plumper, and looks so bright. The hyaluronic acid in the serum definitely helps any fine lines I have while also keeping my skin moisturized. I’ve also noticed it’s helping a ton with my congested skin/sebum/large pores. I will definitely be purchasing this again as a staple for my skin routine. I received this product complimentary for my honest review.
Wow I absolutely love this. It makes my skin feel so refreshed and gives the best glow. I highly recommend. I’m also obsessed with the packaging.

I was not sure a first what to think of this product but after just a few applications I am hooked. I have very sensitive skin that is often very red. It has soothed the redness and not hurt my skin at all. This is def with and try but is going to be an investment. Liquid gold

review_title: love this product, Tatcha is worth it
review_text: I received this product for free in exchange for my fair and honest review. I’ve previously used other serums from Tatcha, and they are a cut above the rest. After the results I saw from the Violet C serum, I affirmed that despite the high price this brand is worth it, and I would be willing to buy Tatcha products again. I received this product for free and it blew me out of the water just as much as the Violet C serum. Whenever I use Tatcha products, my skin seems to literally glow. I put it on before bed and in the morning my skin looks plump, dewy, and healthy, a godsend especially during the winter months.

I really really liked this serum! This is my first time trying tatcha, and it certainly won’t be my last. My skin looked much more vibrant even after just one use. I would recommend this for all skincare needs!

I have used the luminous hydration and firming one prior to trying this but I have to say after about a week of using it, I much prefer this one...texture is milky and one pump goes a long way for me...very light and airy for me and leaves my skin very soft...the other one had a sticky feeling so I would definitely repurchase this one for the other serum...
Love this product! Got it to try for free and it’s amazing.

review_title: I hate how much I love this.
review_text: So I received this for free pre-release for testing purposes and I wanted to get a really good feel for this product before I reviewed it. I wanted this to be “okay,” but honestly it’s not. It’s fantastic. I use it morning an night, just half a pump worth, and it’s made me question my entire skin routine. Spot treatment? haven’t used it in weeks. Deep moisturizer? First winter in years without any flaky patches. Oily skin? Nowhere to be found. I hate how much I love this because it’s so pricy, but a little goes a long way, so I’ll see how long I can get out of this bottle. I’ll probably cave and get another. I love this stuff

recieved this serum from influenster. I love the way this makes my face feel and look. It has improved my daily glow so much. It is not greasy feeling. I love it and will deff be buying more once i run out!!

WOW! This stuff is absolutely amazing. Been using it for a couple weeks and my skin feels amazing. The smell of the product is to die for. I will definitely be continuing to use this product.I received this product compliments of Influenster and Tatcha to review

My favorite sunscreen :) I have dry, acne-prone skin and this works perfectly for me. I put it on top of my moisturizer or by itself with no issues. It feels light on the skin. Non-greasy and have never broken out with use.
LOVE this sunscreen! Leaves no white cast and feels like on my skin! Works well under makeup too.

This is the only sunscreen I’ve found that doesn’t leave me looking casket ready. It dries pretty matte but it doesn’t completely soak in my skin and did give me minor pimples. Wearing during the day and then using my rose hip oil at night to combat the pimples balances out the cons to using this product. The price point is also great. Almost perfect product.

Been using this sunscreen for about 2 weeks and have no complaints! The smell is fresh and it blends on the face so easily leaving no white cast. Also moisturizes my face well so I don’t need to later moisterizer on top
I love this sunscreen so much! It gives you a beautiful glow and hydrates my skin. I am obsessed with the smell! I really enjoy it. Does not leave a white cast. Overall, 10/10.

My absolute favorite sunscreen of all time! It doesn’t leave a white cast, it doesn’t make my eyes burn, it doesn’t irritate my skin or make me break out. It lays on my skin nicely and goes under make u well. It doesn’t feel greasy or shiny. It has a mild scent but I actually like it.

I heard great things about a different sunscreen by this brand so when I saw this one in stores I thought I’d try it. I normally use colorscience and I love it, but this is really great too. It’s not tinted but it does not leave a white caste. I am pretty pale though. I received this product complimentary from innisfree. Innisfree daily uv defense sunscreen has a packaging that is a nice clean look. The white cream is spf 36 and protects from the sun while giving skin a nice dewy glow and smelling like sunflowers.

If you have any kind of dry skin, you might want to skip this cleanser. I have truly combination skin, some parts are oily, some are dry, and some are normal. So I switch between this and a more hydrating cleanser depending on how my skin feels. Not too stripping and it really does leave your skin feeling nice and clean. review_title: Youthful dewy glow with no breakouts
review_text: Algenist GENIUS sleeping collagenI waited a full 2 weeks to post my review as I wanted to make sure I was giving a complete review, not just an initial one. I also wanted to wait as I have acne prone skin in my 40s and I wanted to see if it would cause my skin to flare. I spot tested my neck for 5 days before using it on my full face. I cleaned my face, used the liquid collagen, then applied the Algenist GENIUS sleeping collagen before bed. Much to my relief, It did not cause a breakout flare (YAY!!) the cream goes on very smooth and light. (I did not wake up stuck to my pillowcase!) The cream smells the way it feels, light and clean. It does not have a medicinal smell, which my husband appreciates. It left my skin very soft in the mornings. After using the cream for a week, I noticed that my skin was much softer. I continued using the cream for another full week. After w full weeks using the cream, I noticed that my skin had a soft dewy glow and was incredibly soft. I hesitate to use the word radiant, but I will absolutely state that the Algenist GENIUS sleeping collagen cream gave my 43 year old skin a youthful, soft, dewy glow. I am a 43 year old, former sun worshiping southern woman with acne prone skin. I am an honest reviewer who insists on using a product long enough to form an actual, not just initial, opinion before I will review it. I received the product free of charge from Influenster for reviewing purposes

So I’ve been using this cream for about 3 weeks now, and I am pretty happy with it. For reference I am 27 years old with combination sensitive skin. This cream is a rich buttery consistency that melts into your skin. Often I find rich hydration creams to leave a residue on my skin but this one absorbs well for me. The light vanilla scent is nice and not over powering. After my first use I woke up with plump hydrated skin. After 3 weeks my skin is well hydrated from this cream and my usual winter flaking around my nose is non existent. The only reason I’m not giving it 5 stars is because I haven’t noticed a difference in my fine lines mind you I don’t have many because of my age and also 3 weeks of use may not be enough time to allow the product to minimize fine lines. Over all happy!

I received this product complimentary in exchange for honest reviews., and I have to say I’m impressed. It’s a relatively thick cream, so a little goes a long way, but it definitely appears to reduce fine lines and provide a Dewey look after use over two weeks. I’d certainly recommend this product!

review_title: Bye bye winter skin - Algenist to the rescue!

I received this product for free via influenster for reviewing purposes, and oh my, this is a gem, it smoothes my skin to perfection, leaves pores less visible and its very moisturizing but doesnt leave my face oily.
