I found out real quickly that this moisturizer is indeed too thick to be used that way. It feels too heavy under makeup and also causes some of my primers and foundations to pill. So I have been using this just at night for the last few weeks and in conjunction with the Liquid Collagen. The plant collagen, collagen amino acids and ceramides have definitely healed my skin. My dry patches are now gone! . Algenist claims that this product also releases natural, stress-relieving notes to help promote restful sleep, which I sadly can’t confirm. Well sure, there are plenty of thick moisturizers out there, but this one contains VEGAN plant collagen and Algenist’s patented Alguronic Acid! Furthermore, this formula doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin with heavy fragrances or make it feel congested. In the morning, my skin feels soft, hydrated and revived! Despite having a high price tag, a little goes a long way and the effects this has on my skin are outstanding! I highly recommend that y’all try it out! Head to your closest Sephora and just ask for a sample!(I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are your own. )

I just repurchased, it is expensive but it lasts 6+ months and I used more than the recommended pea sized amount.

I received this for testing purposes, and could not have been more excited that this is the product that showed up. review_title: a little research gives it a chance
review_text: I’ve been using this product since release. So thats about 2 full months at this point. I wasn’t using any vitamin A or retinoid based products prior to this so my skin was Virgin I’m that sense. All the people on here complaining about how it makes their skin peal clearly didn’t do any research before slapping this on their face. That is a very common side effect to non retinoid/retinol tolerant skin. You have to build up tolerance over time. That being said my skin only lightly pealed twice with this. I used it every second day alternating with the framboos, sometimes I use the baby facial once a week but I’m lazy so it’s inconsistent.—Just for reference. Once your skin is tolerating this product it is nice. I have eczema on my face which has calmed down and the redness that comes with it has also faded. I would recommend this to anyone. Just everyone needs to understand it’s not an overnight thing.

This product will get rid of my acne so quick and smooth my face. I’m not too good with routing and I didn’t buy it for rinkles (although I’m sure it will turn over skin cells and get rid of fine lines), but this product is a win-win for sure. Over night I will wake up with softer and smoother skin. Worth the money? Depends because this has a high % of retinol but, I would re-puchase this product!

I’ve been using A-Passioni for four weeks, only once a week.  I follow it with B-Hydra and another moisturizer cream.  Even using only once a week, I’m already in the peeling stage, and seeing brighter, younger skin underneath.  The flaking is annoying because even with tons of moisture on top, I still see flakes through my foundation.  The nurse at my med spa said it is remarkable to be able to get 1% retinol OTC.  Don’t know if that’s true, but this is doing it’s job, and I am seeing results fast.  The burning sensation is gone now, and it’s just flaking, so my skin is getting used to the product.  I trust DE and this one is exactly as it says.  Definitely use some kind of after moisturizer, especially if you have combo skin like I do.  Looking forward to starting every 5 days soon.

review_title: Good but takes a lot of patience
review_text: Good but takes a lot of patience. I started this in January as soon as it came out. Til now, it has been 4 months since I started and even with a ton of moisturizers, this still irritates my skin every now and then. I do not have sensitive skin, i use all kind of products on my skin and did not have anything near the reactions that i had with this. At the beginning, i had a full on red peeling face the day after I applied this. It was very intense and i had to stop using it for at least 1 week or more for my skin to heal. After the first month, I started to get a little better on once a week so I decided to up to twice a week. Had bad reaction again and I didnt actually use it twice a week safely until month 3. I lost my patience several times and had already wanted to give up and return it. But reading so many good reviews, i decided to stick it out a little longer. Long story short, now at month 5, i am using it every other night and only half of the pea sized amount and it works wonder. My texture is so much smoother and it takes care of acne so well. i definitely can’t use it by itself but every time I have to mix it with the Hyra-B moisturizer. And then go on top with another moisturizer or oil. It’s working wonderfully now but whenever I am brave enough and try to up to every night, it irritates me immediately. So nope, every other night is the way to go for me. Hope this was helpful.

Retinol- Left skin looking plumper and softer the morning after using it. Did not help with any wrinkles, discoloration/hyperpigmentation nor texture on my skin. It lasted me 4 months, I applied it 3 to 4 times a week, only at night, using half of a water droplet for my entire face. Smell and color of the product were not a problem, and packaging is travel friendly and easy to use.

I love this retinol! I notice a huge difference in my skin after using it, less wrinkles and my skin Is much more smooth! I use a hydrating gel moisturizer after and it works amazing in combination with this

This is my first retinol cream and WOW my skin has transformed! I’ve been fighting dull skin, discoloration, and fine lines on my face for the last few years but this has really helped boost the vitality of my skin! Holy grail product for me—I look years younger! I use it 2x/week in circulation with other day/night serums and haven’t had any breakouts or angry reactions since I started about 4 weeks ago.

Miracle product much like other DE products.  Start off slowly applying it a few times per week.  After the second application, I could tell a slight difference.  After two weeks, my skin looked more luminous and tighter.  I am really looking forward to seeing what it does over the next few months.
Best retinol product I have ever used. Doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. Reduces fine lines and keeps breakouts away. Absolutely love this.
I really wanted to like this and probably used it longer than I should have... my skin reacted bad and got dry, rough and bumpy. It also seemed to break me out beyond any skin purging.

Really love this scrub! The crystals are the perfect size and doesn’t feel too abrasive on the skin! It really does brighten my skin when it feels dull. My favourite way to use it is after scrubbing I leave it on for a few minutes as like a little mask. Also smells really nice and refreshing, totally recommend it!
I have used this cleaner only 3 times and i can feel the difference. My skin feels cleaner and smoother. I probably going to buy this product in the future.!

This product is wonderful. It has a light scent to it which is very nice. It exfoliates my skin but doesn’t make it feel stripped or tight. My skin feels smooth and moistened after I use this. It hasn’t caused any sensitivity to my skin either very gentle. Will definitely be buying more when I run out. I received this product as a gift from olehenriksen via Influenster.
Loved the way this made my skin feel the day of use and the day after!! The smell is refreshing and clean. I definitely recommend!

Wonderful product! The smell is fresh and bright, the texture is effective for exfoliating and my skin was smooth afterwards. I think a resistance needs to be built up for the slight burn. Slowly but surely.

Smells like fresh lemonade!! It’s the perfect summer scent! I was a little concerned about some of the ingredients because I have mildly sensitive skin, but so far it hasn’t bothered me. I’ve been using the scrub 1-2 times a week for a few weeks now and my skin is so soft and smooth. This product will be a staple in my skin care lineup for a long time to come.

review_title: Smells like a lemon pie - works well.
review_text: Wow! This product smells so amazing. I am a fan of lemon and so the scent does not bother me. It almost smells like a lemon dessert. I have sensitive skin and did not have any issues using this product. I’ve used it a few times and noticed my skin feeling softer. It did not irritate my skin at all. And washed off well, too. I also appreciate the back explaining the active ingredients will make you sensitive to the sun - so many people don’t realize that with skin care.

I got this product as a complementary sample from influencer! I was super excited to be chosen to test this product! This product smells super good. I got the opportunity to try this and I absolutely love it. It makes my skin soft and smell amazing! I would highly recommend this. It smells delicious like lemonade and does the job perfect!

I like the versatility of this scrub. You can use it daily or as a quick mask. I also like the amount of scrub particles, I hate when scrubs feel like liquid with not enough grit to make a difference.

The best product I’ve received from Influenster so far. I was beyond excited when I learned I was getting the opportunity to try a new ole product and this one did not disappoint. My only con is the price for the amount you’re getting. I hope they come out with other scents but lemon is amazing!

I was a little skeptical about using this toner because I have yet to find one that I really like but I’m glad I came across it. The first thing I noticed is that it doesn’t have a harsh smell and I loved that right away. For me this toner is incredibly soothing and doesn’t burn my skin after I’ve washed it. It puts moisture back into my skin and leaves my face hydrated. I did receive this toner complimentary for testing purposes but I wholeheartedly love it and recommend it to anyone.
The smell alone will make you love this product!! It’s very gentle on the skin as well. Works great on combination with the gel moisturizer. The product was sent to me for free for testing purposes.

I received this product as part of a complimentary promotion, and since my skin is oily, I let my mom use it to try. She absolutely LOVED it and will be replacing her toner with this instead! She said it is the only product she has ever used that makes her skin feel dewy and fresh without feeling oily! Based on her, I would definitely recommend this product for ladies with dry skin, especially if you live in a dry climate

I love this product. I received this in my recent Lancôme voxbox, complimentary of influenster! It leaves your face feeling soft and smells good! It doesn’t make my skin oily but I can’t put it on my forehead because I have acne prone skin. I tried it and the next morning I noticed I was starting to see little bumps on my forehead. I will def still use this product on the rest of my face!

I received this product 2 weeks ago. In the beginning was fine then started to make me break out so I stoped using it. Nevertheless, I do like the packaging and the smelling. I received this product for free and testing purposes.

This toner is amazing! It has a super smooth, velvety texture that also leaves my face feeling smooth and velvety. It also hydrates my skin and leaves my complexion looking even. Would recommend and purchase.I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

I wasn’t super impressed with this toner compared to others. The texture was very weird- oddly thick and gel like, it was almost like they took the moisturizer and just added a bunch of water to it. I didn’t notice much of a difference in my skin either. I will continue to use it and if I get better results I will update but at this point I don’t really recommend it.*Received this free for testing purposes

This is my favorite toner. It has a medium scent, so if you’re sensitive to fragrances, you may not like it. I personally don’t mind it, I think it smells appropriate for having honey in it. I use Trentinoin 0.6% and was finding that it was drying out my combo skin. I bought this to help remedy that, and it works amazingly well with a good moisturizer. It cleans off any dead skin cells and feels like it plumps my skin. I have seen a stark improvement with my foundation on or off. It gives a natural glow and absorbs quickly into the skin. One con is that it is deceptively thick so you need to use more than you think. I would apply it with my hands first and then use a cotton pad to swipe my skin. Overall a wonderful toner, it’s definitely a luxurious experience to use and will purchase again.
I feel prepared for the winter days with this toner! It is so hydrating and I love that my skin looks so healthy immediately.
LOVE! This stuff is amazing for those with dry skin. It cleans my skin so well while leaving it hydrating and SO smooth. I love this line SO much. Get the moisturizer too. It’s worth it!

I always used to apply coconut oil to remove makeup but it’s heavy on the grassy side so I’m really glad I got this product to try out in the mail. This formula removes my full face of makeup, including my waterproof eye makeup perfectly. I took it with me when I went away on a trio and I really enjoyed have a hassle free makeup removal at the end of an exhaustiing day, and as a bonus it smells amazing and leaves my skin feeling fresh for the next day. Keep in mind I always follow up with my normal face wash and mosuterizer, but I still feel extra pampered when I wake up!
I was not sure what to think of this product at first but am loving it. It smells great and does not leave I greasy. Def worth a try.

review_title: good enough but not HG status
review_text: Got this as a complimentary sample. It does a good enough job with waterproof mascara, which is always difficult to remove. But I had to double cleanse and when I did, there was still foundation that came off upon second cleanse. I would stick with my Clinique take the day off balm!

I love this, although coconut oil works about the same, without the to-die-for fragrance. The problem with this is it is so oily, it makes my eyes cloudy after using. I keep my eyes closed of course, and wipe it off before opening them, but still… Then I read the label that says to avoid contact with eyes. LOL. So as much as I love it, it’s eye makeup that I need to remove most and this doesn’t fit the bill.

I received this product free to review. The packaging is simple and effective BUT I wish they added a spot for the scoop inside the lid. Otherwise it just sits on top of the container and can easily be lost / pick up dirt or bacteria. The product itself has a light scent. It’s nice. The balm melts easily with a little water between your hands. I don’t find my face is greasy after. And I have sensitive skin and have no issues using it. I do find I have to use a good cleanser after to get it all off. It does break up your makeup well.
Love how still removes my makeup, including my waterproof mascara. All I need is a small amount. It smells great and leaves my skin moisturized. This was a complimentary product.

I recieved this item complementary to review through Influenster’s program. I honestly really like this product. *I did use a  cleansing brush to apply.* The smell is quite relaxing and wasnt overpowering. A lot of facial products burn and make my skin inflamed, this product did not! I would purchase this in the future, I’d also recommend this product to others. I have pretty dry skin on my forehead and nose, than its oily the rest of my face. Using this product made my skin feel wonderful, even the dry spots. its definitely in my top favorites. The packaging is nice, it comes in a well labeled box. The actual container itself is nice as well. On the container it asks “effectively removes makeup and impurities? Yes!“ I completely agree that it does. It also asks “moisturizers and smooth skin after cleansing? Yes!“ I agree that it moisturized my skin a lot. I feel a big difference.

I received this product for free through Influenster and was very happy with the quality. It melts any makeup off your face and leaves the skin feeling very moisturized. The only reason I give it 4/5 is because the scent is not my favourite. Though, I have been using it for a few days and have had no breakouts on my combination skin. I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a moisturizing makeup remover!

I have always wanted to try a cleansing balm to remove my makeup so I was SO excited when I found out that Influenster was sending me one to review!  I really enjoyed using this product. It felt really good on the skin, not slimy like I expected.  It removed my makeup really well, mascara and all!  I would absolutely recommend this product tofamily and friends and plan on purchasing in the future!

Great cleanser ! I received this recently and have to say I am impressed ! My skin already looks better, fresher and dewy! This is a balm cleanser which is different than any cleanser I’ve ever used! I enjoy the smell and can’t wait to see the result in a month or two of use! Would recommend !

This is a sunscreen - not a every day face moisturizer. There are other brands who have managed to put SPF into daily face moisturizers much more successfully. If that’s what you’re looking for - I would not recommend. If you want an overpriced sunscreen to wear to the pool/beach then this is the product for you!

I have a bit of color in my skin so most sunscreens leave me looking pale or covered in a white sheen. Invisible is a bit misleading on some of these products but drunk elephant gives me the coverage that I need without the weird glaze left on my skin. After about 5 minutes it absorbs nicely into my combination skin

I received this free from Influenster for a VoxBox campaign, but sadly, this was the worst product in the box. First of all, I don’t understand the word “sheer” in the title when it left a notable white cast on my already pale face; those darker skinned may have an even worse experience. It is sticky and pills very easily, which is a hard pass for me, since I usually wear makeup over sunscreen. It pilled even without makeup. Hard pass.
I like how Umbrasreen merges with the skin, although I would like the protection to be greater

Amazing. Worth every penny. Does not disappoint. Very soft smelling and does not irritate skin. I recommend using a very small amount under morning skincare or foundation. I’d give this ten stars if I could.

I haven’t tried their SPF before so I’m not sure yet on the long term wear of it. Since it’s Fall and Winter here in N.America, I haven’t had to use SPF much since I’m mostly indoors. I did end up doing a few trail runs and found this to be non-greasy and doesn’t leave a white cast from the physical sunscreen (which I prefer over the chemical sunscreens). I did use it under makeup but I had light makeup on (as I do in the summer) and found that it didn’t effect it for the first half of the day. I didn’t reapply it though and my makeup did look worn down by the end of the day (12 hrs time). Can’t really attribute it to the sunscreen however. It’s pretty much the way my makeup breaks down after half a day. However, with any sunscreen, this would definitely come in handy on our sunny vacation when we go in January. Would recommend.
It’s a good daily sunscreen. It is non-greasy and absorbs well. Do I think I’ll be spending $35 dollars on it in the future? No. But it’s a good sunscreen and works well under makeup.

review_title: Doesn't work for my skin tone or type.
review_text: I tried this several times and it was not for me. Trying it on the back of my hand, it seemed fine, but on my face (and using the correct amount) the white cast is unacceptable without makeup and pills on top of all of my moisturizers. If you have very light skin, it may work well, but know that it smells of sunscreen. I would recommend the Innisfree sunscreen in its place.Light/Medium skin toneCombo/oily/dehydrated skin
I Love this sunscreen.  I have sensitive skin and with most other Sunscreen cause a breakout. This does not. I love that it goes on smooth I use on face, neck, hands.

One of my favorite things about drunk elephant is that there is no scent, no extra frilly things... ifs just a good product and that’s all it needs to be. This sunscreen sits lovely underneath foundation and it adds an extra layer of protection. It does exactly what a sunscreen is suppose to do. I’m very pleased with this product.

The ingredients in this product make it different from any other moisturizer out there right now. Once you open the product your greeted with a strong pleasing scent of charcoal. I have pretty normal skin and don’t usually get acne so I can’t say that this product helped with my acne. However I can say that this product hydrated my skin perfectly and really feels good on. I received this product complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes.
I am obsessed with this product, it’s the only thing that can keep my oily skin under control.

I was excited to receive this moisturizer, when I got it I couldn’t wait to put it on my face. the moisture this moisturizer provides is insane! I apply it at night before I go to bed and when I wake up my face feels amazing! It smells pretty good too, also love the fact that it helps with blemishes! It’s a 2 in 1! A moisturizer that helps with breakouts is a everything if you as me lol. I highly recommend this. Oh and let’s not forget it is good for all skin types!! So stop reading this and go get it, you will love it
I love this moisturizer. I have combo skin and ecthyma. Anything to sop up oil is a must-have for me, and this product has given me the best skin of my life. Blemish-free and smooth. A+.

I received this product for free about a month ago from influenster, and it made me break out all over my face. I was really disappointed because i really wanted to love this product but I had to stop using it immediately. I really love Origins but this product was not meant for my skin. (FYI: I have combination skin!)

First acne treatment that doesn’t burn my skin!⭐⭐⭐⭐You’re going to love it because it is cruelty-free, lightweight, gentle for all skin types, and it’s also made with Bamboo Charcoal, 1% Salicylic Acid and a lot of natural good-for-you ingredients so that you can say Goodbye Breakouts and Hello Hydration. I love it as an acne treatment although it is not the best product I’ve tried for hydration. You can use this product either day or night but I won’t recommend using it underneath your makeup because it can make your foundation oxidize and look dewy (if you prefer to look matte).The scent is so woody, herbal and fresh, almost like aromatherapy, so it helps me to sleep better too. Oh! and the packaging is made with recycled plastic, paper and cardboard. YAY!Disclaimer: I received this product #complimentary from @Influenster for testing purposes.⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀#mermaidlife #OriginsTribe #contest #GlowBaby

I love this product! I got it complimentary and thought I’d give it a shot and I was surprisingly impressed. I will say, it feels a bit thick and oily at first but it soaks into the skin very well over night. The acne treatment isn’t too abrasive and is really great for regular minor breakouts.

Wow I’m utterly surprised by how fast this worked for me. The first use cleared up my skin. Although I only use a night because my skin is normally dry. But it still works and my skin looks so clear after. I’m so happy about this product!

I have such a hard time finding moisturizers I like with my extremely oily but sometimes has dry patches acne prone skin. It have only ever found one other moisturizer that I can use on my skin that does the job. This one has replaced that. It gives me the perfect amount of moisture without making me oily nor too dry. I think that it has helped keep my skin clear also. I would pay the money for this one absolutely. I would recommend to anyone that has problematic skin like myself for sure!!!

I received this product complimentary for testing purposes. I do like this moisturizer and I definitely see an improvement in my acne so that’s good. However it does have a scent to it so I don’t like wearing it during the day. I’ve been consistently using it every night before I got to bed and it does a good job moisturizing my skin. The only negative is it seems to quickly leave your skin a little oily minutes after using which i dont mind if I’m going to bed but it’s one of the reasons why I don’t use it during the day.

This product is AMAZING! In just 1 week, I’ve noticed a drastic change to my uneven skintone due to sun damage/over exfoliation, and it has been slowly but surely lightening my dark spots and giving me a nice natural glow. I have sensitive skin and It is gently enough for me to use every night before bed. I am in my late twenties and I can say since puberty, my skin has never felt this smooth before. I have been been using the glycolic toner and that works to clear up acne, but doesn’t help my acne scars or uneven skintone. So I’m glad I now have a product that does both.

This was my first time using any type of lactic acid/HA product so I can’t compare this to any other product. I brought this to help with dark spots and maybe I didn’t use it long enough but I can’t get over the fact that it stings when I apply it after I wash my face. It also has a sticky texture on my skin and it rubs onto my arms as I sleep which means I accidentally taste it and at times it irritates my eyes. I just don’t think it did anything magical for me enough to purchase again. I have heard of people using this on their arms and legs so I might try it on dark marks that I have from scars on those parts of my body but I just don’t think I will use this on my face again. I think it’s too strong for my face.

Instead of using this as a daily treatment, I use it once or twice a week. Three drops on the Shiseido cotton pad and swipe my face after cleansing. Afterward I use oil based moisturizer and massage my face till product all absorbed. The result is instant next day, skin is smooth and brightened. The only caveat is that the product I am using now is from when the Ordinary was a stand-alone company, not the one that has been bought out by Estée Lauder. I don’t know if ingredients stay the same after. For the results and the price, I am very happy with the product.

This is an amazing leave on chemical exfoliant!  It has the perfect ph balance to penetrate, and exfoliate, the skin without causing severe burning or peeling.  I spent over $200 dollars on two other brands claiming the same the same benefits.  Unfortunately, their claims are a complete lie!  The ph in AHA’s should be 3-4, ideally 3.5-4 if you have sensitive skin.  The ordinary is a 3.5.  The two products I’m referring to are about a 7.  Meaning, you might as well put water, or a basic moisturizer on your skin. The first rhymes is a sleep mask that smells like water melon. The second, spelled differently Cate Summerville.  Save your money, and go for The Ordinary.
Use this every night! works great on pimples that are just starting to form.

review_title: Yay! A solution to dry, flaky skin
review_text: This works great for me. Before I started using this, I had to exfoliate every other day, or my foundation would gather in dry spots, and it was terrible. My skin has become more sensitive and drier over time.  Dead skin cells build up
Great acid! I use it about 3 times a week and it smoothed out the bumpy skin on my forehead!

I own almost every serum by The Ordinary except for a select few. I don’t normally have any issues with their serums, in fact they’ve been amazing! I’ve only used this one twice because the following morning I wake up with 3 or 4 small pimples starting (I’m assuming because of the irritation?). Anyways, I can see this being a great product, but I’d advise against anyone with sensitive skin using this. It it an exfoliant and not light on the skin, so use sparingly.
Great product for a great price. I have combo skin and this product makes my dry skin just melt away. I pair this one with the buffet serum from the same brand and it makes my skin so soft and clear.
This is the best chemical exfoliant! I had an allergic reaction to food at school and was left with hives. I put this on and my hives were gone and my skin was clear!

Oh my goodness. This product is magnificent. I am obsessed with everything about it…. the fragrance, the texture, the way it makes me skin look so dewy, and the packaging is just so lux! I am excited to see how this sunscreen works with my makeup, but right now I am loving it!

First of all, this packaging is the cutest! This doesn’t have the typical sunscreen smell and it goes on super nice! I think it blends well with makeup. It isn’t greasy or thick and my skin is glowing! I didn’t notice that it pilled like some people said.

I love Glow Recipe and specifically their watermelon line of products, but this sunscreen is not up to par. It pills! I’ve tried it a few different ways, waiting even more time between moisturizer and applying, using the method they use on their tik tok. It keeps pilling. It’s also extremely disappointing to see all of the reviews are incentivized and that some “influencers” have placed their handles around their reviews for attention. Only listen to the reviews that aren’t incentivized. You can totally skip this sunscreen, the pilling isn’t worth the price.

I was so excited to receive a watermelon scented moisturizer with spf. It is perfect for not only beach or pool days, but even days when you will simply be outside running errands. It doesn’t leave my face like, smells great and absorbs evenly. I received this product free to give my honest opinion and review about it.

I really wanted to love this. It feels nice on the skin and isn’t greasy. I love the added skin benefits. But, even when I try to blend it into my skin very gently it pills like crazy. I don’t even have dry skin either. There’s no way I would wear this under makeup. I might be returning. :/

I was so excited to see that the new product was a sunscreen ! The packaging is not only gorgeous the application blends beautifully. The smell has a light fragrance that is not overwhelming at all. Looking forward to using this in the spring & summer !

I have solidified my skincare routine except for finding a good spf to top it off. So far I am enjoying this product for my spf. It leaves a glowy look on my face while also leaving my skin feeling moisturized. The cute pink packaging is also a plus. So happy to be protected from the sun with this sunscreen!

So ive been testing this for about 4 days and Unfortunately i wanted to love this but i do not at all . I have very sensitive eyes and this sunscreen started to burn my eyes each time i used it and it also never sank into my skin only sat on top and felt greasy in a few hours . .

This product works magic! It gives me very glowing, fresh looking skin. I apply it under my make up and it keeps me moisturized  throughout the whole day. And also keep the foundation last longer. Really like it

I love this face SPF lotion. It doesn’t have your typical sunscreen white cast or greasy feel to it, and it applies really smoothly under my makeup. It did not feel greasy at all and smells super good. It kept my skin protected when I went to the beach and it did not break me out which is a win because my skin is sensitive and breaks out easy.

Where do I begin. Everything from the packaging to how lightweight the formula is makes me happy. While I do not experience many breakouts anymore, I notice that my skin can become inflamed at different points. Since I’ve been using this moisturizer, my skin hasn’t experienced inflammation and it has stayed hydrated throughout the day. This is hands down the best moisturizer I’ve used. I did receive this product complimentary for testing purposes but I love it.

I thought I wasn’t going to love this product because my skin is sensitive and most moisturizers either make me really greasy or cause me to break out. However, this formula works really well for me. It’s lightweight and has a slight rose scent that I actually love. I wouldn’t mind making this a part of my skincare routine. I did receive this product complimentary for testing products but that didn’t sway how I feel about the product.

I’m typically not into gel moisturizers but I was really pleased with this one!! After just a few days of use it left my skin feeling super hydrated!! New favorite. This product was sent to me for free for testing purposes.

This moisturizer I received as part of a complimentary promotion. I used it in conjunction with the Lancôme moisturizing toner and it has made my skin feel so soft and dewy! Would not recommend if you have oily skin, but is great for those with dry skin especially in a dry climate!

I received this product complimentary from influenster! This moisturizer is very similar to the toner. I love the smell but cannot put it on my forehead because I have acne prone skin. It doesn’t leave your face feeling like there’s a layer caked on. It is very refreshing!

I got this as a rewards item. I was pleasantly surprised that it didn’t make my skin super oily like most moisturizers do even when they say oil free. I also  was looking at my face last night and thought it looked clearer. I was confused as to why. I came on here to buy the full product and saw that there is salicylic acid in it and thought oh that must be why. Also a little goes a long way. I used the 0.16 oz sample for 7 days straight. The one thing I would change is the fragrance. It smells nice to me but I don’t think smells are necessary in face products.

I would say this is probably my second favorite moisturizer next to Kate Sommerville. I have pretty sensitive skin so it can be hard to find products that work for me. My skin is also very combination- can be extremely dry and flaky and then super oily by the end of the day. It helps a lot with the dryness which is hard to find in products but seems to make my oiliness a little bit worse which is why I gave it 4 instead of 5. Dislcaimer: I received this product for free for testing purposes.
This moisturizer is so good!!! My skin feels so smooth and just flows from the nourishment. It smells great and a little amount goes a long way!

I LOVE this moisturizer. I’ve been using it for about a week now and my skin finally feels happy! I live in the high desert where it’s extremely dry but I have problem skin so that makes it hard to find products that really work for me! This product is my new go to and I’d recommend to anyone who has dry problem skin! Love love love it!

A little goes a long way! Even though it’s gel based I like the consistency. It feels like a rich moisturizer. Especially because my skin is so dry, it really takes this product in well and my skin feels so much more hydrating after. I normally use this at night to let it soak into my skin. I normally use something else in the morning but this is still great for morning.

I’ve tried other peace out brand protects and this one is no exception. Love it! It’s very easy to use and not greasy. Put it under my eyes before and bed and have already noticed a difference from 2 days ago.

Incredible! It takes a little while to get used to the application and you have to be consistent with it but it works wonders. I only apply it under eyes and right before I go to sleep, I’ve noticed my makeup application is much easier now and my concealer doesn’t crease under my eyes. review_text: I find this to be difficult to put on as it’s a solid stick that doesn’t glide onto your skin easily. I wish I could return but I didn’t actually start using this purchase until a few months after I bought it.

I’ve been using this serum by Ole Henriksen for a few weeks now and I have to say I  like it. This was my first time ever using a product from the brand and have been enjoying using this product thus far. This serum says to apply serum to face and neck daily massaging in an upward circular motion. I applied one pump to the back of my hand ( one pump was enough product to cover my face and my neck generously) and then I massaged it in. After immediately applying the serum, there were no immediate results or signs of diminishing fine lines, dark spots or wrinkles but the purple tint did immediately brighten my skin which I did like. After applying the serum I did notice that it left my hands and face a bit tacky which I wasn’t a big fan of. After a few minutes of letting the serum absorb into my skin I did notice that it left my skin pretty smooth for the most part with a hint of tackiness, but nothing out of the ordinary. I like that this serum didn’t leave my skin looking or feeling greasy as some serums tend to do on my oily skin. It absorbed really nicely and didn’t feel heavy or like I had product on my face. I also liked that the consistency wasn’t too thick or pastey but had more of a milky consistency. I liked that the ingredients weren’t harsh or didn’t irritate my skin. I like the packaging and the pump disperses just the right amount of product to cover your face and neck. My one con about this product for me was the scent. I’m someone who personally is very sensitive to strong, perfumed scents and I found that this product was very strongly scented and a bit too over powering. If you’re someone who is sensitive to scents this product may bother you. Overall I’d definitely recommend this product to try out and/or add to your daily skincare routine. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

I prefer this over the gel cream even though I’m not a fan of heavier creams. this is definitely a little bit on the denser side, and the smell is not for everyone (it’s refreshing but also gives off a medicated scent as if it’s healing my skin). I used this for 4 weeks along with the mist and serum in my night time skincare routine and it’s changed my skin. it is smoother, no breakouts, more glow and no more dullness. will be purchasing again and again! I received this as a complimentary product for testing purposes.

I can see why this project is designated for PM use as it’s very thick. Though I love the lightweight of the gel this is the perfect PM moisturizer. Love that ingredients helps repair, soothe, and refresh my skin. It will leave your skin feeling a little oily next day at least in my experience. I received this product for testing purposes.
I tried this product via Influenster. Love the calming cream. It was lightweight not too heavy and worked well with my makeup. Definitely would buy this product.

I had a sample size & This worked amazing for me, but i noticed I started breaking out and this is the only thing I changed in my skincare routine. Really sad cause I enjoyed this I have rosacea & this helped a lot! Idk why they have to have essential oils in here cause that’s probably the cause of breakouts, if they removed those I think the formula would be perfect.
I love products with ceramide and this is no exception. It’s an excellent night cream and the texture is really creamy. It also smells great!
very well formulated,  and smells great,  one of the best moisturizers.   the best product in the Sunday Riley line.

I felt like SR ICE Ceramide Moisturizing Cream was a bit heavy for me to use twice a day so I just use at night. Excellent for a winter cream. I can’t wear every night because it’s so thick because then I break out. The smell reminds me of maybe coco butter. Love the little “scoop” that helps get the cream out of the bottom of the jar.

This cream is perfect for the winter months, it’s thick and hydrating. I wear it to sleep or during the day, it’s given my skin some of its moisture back! I’d definitely recommend to anyone in cold climates or looking for a thick moisturizer.
I really enjoyed the feel and non greasiness, smoothness & how it made my face & neck look & feel.  It is truly a wonderful and fabulous product!
I loved this product it really moisturizes your skin leaving it silky and smooth. I got mine as a sample form buzz agent. Will definitely be purchasing this product again.

review_title: super soft and great for sensitive skin
review_text: This is my go to moisturizer every night! I originally got this as a sample but it was so good that I ended up using this as my main moisturizer! It’s soft and smooth and doesn’t affect my sensitive skin negatively. I will say I give half a point off for the scent. I’m not really a fan. it doesn’t smell bad or anything, I just prefer floral scents. My friend who tried it said she liked it though, so it could just vary person to person. It doesn’t stop me from using it all the time though, which is why I didn’t take off a full star.

This is a very hydrating moisturizer. I have oily combination skin, and I think that this is a great moisturizer for winter. It is very thick and a little tacky, so I don’t use this under makeup. It comes with a tiny spatula to scoop out product, which helps keep it sanitary. It has a light sweet scent that is not overpowering. If you are in need of a moisturizer to help dehydrated skin, this is a great choice.
Feels great! I absolutely love the formula and how hydrating it is. A little will go a long way leaving your skin feeling hydrated and smooth.

The packaging deserves four stars. Very beautiful and high end. I’ve only used this a few times since receiving it. I love that it has no scent and feels like a midnight moisturizer. Non-irritating. I have not noticed any differences yet. The price point is a bit high in my opinion.

I’ve been using this Honey Halo Moisturizer for weeks now. This moisturizer is very thick to the touch, smells like pure honey and a little of this product goes a long way.The packaging is great for those who worry sanitization as this comes with a metal spatula you can use to scoop out your moisturizer. The metal spatula is magnet for easy storage after using honey halo. I’ve found Honey Halo to be very nourishing, moisturizing to my skin and it has worked perfectly for my oily skin. It has helped combat my skin irritation along with dryness as the ceramides have improved my skin’s barrier which locks in the moisture. I personally love to use Honey Halo Moisturize at night time considering the thickness of the product, I’ve found that this moisturizer is extremely beneficial when applied at night. Also thank you to Farmacy for gifting this product to me to try out!
Wasn’t wowed by it but it does it’s job as a moisturizer and a little goes a long way. I have normal/dry skin and it works well for me.

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty.  This Halo moisturizer felt amazing on my skin. I have combo skin and it definitely worked amazing. My skin felt nice and hydrated and super soft! I also loved that the consistency is super creamy and has a slight scent to honey! Highly recommend, especially for the fall/ winter

What can’t I say about this miracle moisturizer? Upon first glance, I found the container adorable. It’s made of glass and shaped like a honeycomb. The lid has a wood-like appearance and has an internal magnet for the metal spatula. The smell wasn’t overpowering at all; a simple, light, fragrance that doesn’t linger. The product itself is a light yellow butter-like cream. It melts into your skin for a moisturizing feel that doesn’t sit on your face. From the first use, my skin looked and felt different. I don’t wear foundation, but I do wear powder blush and it applies smoothly and stays all day. I’ve been looking for a miracle moisturizer for my year-round dry skin and this fits the bill. This moisturizer didn’t affect my sensitive skin; no breakouts, redness, or itchiness.

I have semi-oily skin in my t-zone area and received this in my most recent FFF box. I typically only use primer in the morning before applying my makeup but decided to start using this, waiting about 5-10 minutes and then use primer. This stuff is amazing. I legit do not need to apply powder like I had to before I started using this. Some how the shine stays minimal. I love this stuff so much because it has brought balance to my skin. I have a healthy glow after using this.

I love it so much and a little goes a long way. It’s so thick and creamy and sink into the skin so nicely. It doesn’t feel heavy on the skin which I really appreciate and the scent doesn’t bother me but if you really hate the scent of honey definitely avoid this product.

I thought this would be too heavy for my oily/combo skin, but this is a LIFESAVER! I’ve always shied away from things that look like they’d make me a grease ball, but my skin has never looked better... Ever. A thin layer of this lasts all night, it’s not sticky, leaves your skin soft and plump, and smells like honey. I don’t think i can live without it!
This creme smells absolutely delicious!  A very moisturizing intense product that is not for oily skins However, I use it for deep tissue face massages and also with my  jade roller and Gua Sha.

review_title: recommend, few things to keep in mind...
review_text: I should start by saying that my skin is combination acne prone, so I don’t usually buy heavy moisturizers. This winter I needed something more substantial to follow up a lactic acid cleanser and another daily exfoliant as my skin was becoming flakey and had frequent reactionary breakouts. This has worked great and has been replenishing. My skin has recovered and I’m even noticing some improvement on discolouration due to acne scars. This being told I can see why other reviews mention it’s not hydrating enough - it’s feels more buttery. I’m applying a toner (spray) before and it helps locks in moisture and feels balanced. Would purchase again and also curious about trying out the lighter version of it available on the Farmacy moisturizers line.

I’ve always had issues with moisturizer either not giving me enough or giving too much and then breaking out but this moisturizer gives me ev-er-y-thing. I use is morning and night, at night I’ll sometimes add a little facial oil if i feel like i need it, otherwise this is my absolute go-to. I’m on my second jar

I’ve used other vit c serums with minimum results but I love this serum, it made my skin glow after the first use and gave me an even tone, willneed to try it long term to see how it does. Woulddefinitely recommend this to try out.
Leaves you skin very very soft from the vitamin e and super glory from the vitamin c!

This was a good product but I was given a sample so it wasn’t a lot of product! It felt nice on my skin but I wasn’t able to notice anything significant just based on how long I used it. I would buy a full size bottle because I did enjoy using it.

review_title: Good for radiance, but that’s all
review_text: If you’re looking for a serum to just help with glow and hydration, this is great! But if you’d like something that gives more than that (helps with skin texture or even out skin tone), I’d keep looking.
Highly Recommend!! This serum goes on light and not greasy, huge plus! I’ve used it for 2 weeks and can tell a difference in my skin.

This was mainly purchased for use on my hands to soothe them from frequent washing and medicated baths I give my dog, for which wearing gloves is just not practical. I have to say, from the moment I put it on I saw a difference. I am now trying it on my face and more necessarily my neck to see if they respond as well. I find the texture light--lighter than YTTP serum--which is nice for one who experiences very hot and humid east coast summers. It layers nicely under sunscreen. We are just heading into May and already it’s heating up so a good time to give this serum a try. Being priced at the lower end of the spectrum is a plus. The fragrance is not overwhelming. I am optimistic!
Didn’t do much for me. Very liquidly so it came right out of the tube. Smell was ok
This serum feels really nice and doesn’t feel too oily on my skin.

My skin is less dull when I use this product daily (both day and night). Sometimes it takes longer to settle down on my face but that’s not a problem to me because I usually wait for a few seconds until I apply my moisturizer. For this price, good quality. And vitamin C works extra when pairing with vitamin E. I would recommend to an extra layer if you want more hydration. Overall, I would recommend this product. The packaging is mid-weight and looks good too!

Love this! It smells wonderful! My skin is left feeling hydrated without looking oily. I got this as a sample from Influenster in exchange for my honest review and I’m so grateful. It’s definitely a nice addition to my morning routine and it sets well under my primer and makeup.

One of my favorites right behind the lip balm. I notice a HUGE difference when I use this mask. My skin looks so much smoother and my pores are smaller after one use. I use this once a week. I feel it also helps fade my hyperpigmentation from acne scars. I would Definitely recommend.
I receive this product unsealed. It comes only in a box and I think someone already open the jar.

Wow, I am pleasantly surprised at how well this mask worked! A small amount goes a long way, I barely made a dent in the bottle. The pores on my nose and chin are much smaller after one use last night. It made my face very smooth and noticed a significant decrease in sebum on the side of my nose in the creases. Very, very happy I purchased this mask! I suggest getting the Sephora mask spatula tool as well, it made the application and removal much easier and mess-free!

This is a holy grail! My new favorite product discovery and it’s super affordable. This mask is great for sensitive skin types and I cannot hype it enough. It applies and blends easily onto the skin without the need of water (you have to use it over clean and dry face) it feels smooth, creamy and soft. I love to use this mask after taking a warm bath, so that my pores are open and ready for it. I don’t know, but it gives you such a luxurious feeling, and leaves your skin visibly better, less oily, almost matte and cleaner after one use. When dry, this clay mask doesn’t tingles and gives you a minimal tightening sensation, nothing crazy nor uncomfortable. My skin looks amazingly good and juvenile after every use, that I just want you to experience it for yourself.Recommended!!!

This clay mask has been part of my skincare routine for years - it’s a go-to when I need a gentle and effective mask to exfoliate and clear up my skin. This is my honest and authentic opinion, as a Sephora Beauty Insider Community Ambassador. This is a no muss, no fuss, get it done creamy, light charcoal grey hued, kaolin clay based mask that when used once or twice per week on the oiliest parts of my combination skin (nose, chin and jawline) gently but effectively exfoliates, clarifies, deep cleans, softens and smooths skin in under 20 minutes, without leaving it overly dry or tight. All for under $20 ($15 + tax). A little goes a long way so you get a lot of bang for your buck with this beauty. Consistent use over time, whether as a spot treatment or applied over a larger part of my face, has helped with maskne as well as periodic breakouts. It’s been an amazing ally in the fight against blackheads and breakouts. As far as clay masks go, this is in my top 3! 🏆 Simple and simply effective. A must have for me. Highly recommend.👍🏼
this has made my pores better, this mask will last you a while because you only need a thin layer on. It helped my pores and my acne.

I received this product complimentary from Innisfree to try in exchange for my honest review and I am really loving it! It is a really thick creamy clay mask that really works well to get rid of excess oil and impurities. Leaves my skin feeling clean and smooth!

I was able to receive this to try for my honest review. I really liked the consistency and how it has made my face feel refreshed and tightened my pores. I enjoyed the fresh scent and would definitely purchase this for mysein the future.#freeproduct
Reasonable price for a clay mask that leaves my face feeling extra clean and refreshed! Don’t try to keep it for longer by using less like me, it even dried out at the bottom.
I love this innisfree pore clearing mask. It makes my skin smooth and clean. I can see the improvement of my pores too.

I’ve had it for about 3 week’s now and it hasn’t broken me out (that’s really important to me) and I’ve noticed some subtle changes so i’ll stick with it! I’ve tried the PTR ones and they were very strong with little results, I’ve found that this is gentle with more results!

I use this product for a quick exfoliating to remove acne crusts and the flakes of skin from dry patches. It gives me a smoother skin ready for makeup application. I don’t use it every day, I use it mostly when going out on weekends. The instructions don’t say anything about rinsing, but I rinse after I use the pads. I will definitely buy this product again.
The exfoliating effects were too strong (I use half of a pad 1-2 times a week). It does tone a bit, but I saw minimal brightening affects.

I hate that I’m writing a review about these because I dont want them to sell out but these are a game changer. They make ur skin so glowy and clean and they really help sooth and tone. I have sensitive skin and they are amazing.

I was so happy when #firstaidbeautygiftedme their Facial Radiance Pads because I used them off & on in years past with great success, no matter my skin type at the time of use. My skin has been dry, extremely sensitive, oily, & now normal-to-dry, & the @firstaidbeauty pads completely transformed my skin. Since it had been a few years since I last used the toner/ exfoliation pads, I decided I would test these for 3 + weeks before reviewing.First off, let’s cover what makes the Facial Radiance Pads so magical. They contain both Lactic + Glycolic Acids to gently (but deeply) exfoliate, brighten, & tone the skin. Formulation includes both Indian Gooseberry + Cucumber to tone, while Lemon Peel + Licorice Root brighten skin’s appearance & invoke a beautiful glow. All skin types can use these, even sensitive skin! This #firstaidbeauty product is vegan, gluten-free, cruelty-free, clean, & non-comedogenic.After 3.5 weeks I’ve noticed:* Smaller pore size/ less noticeable pores* Textured areas are smoother* Small scars + old acne marks are starting to fade* Skin tone is more even & bright* Radiant, healthy glow. Dullness where??!!* Makeup applies much easier & more evenly* Redness has been reduced* Clears up current acne + ingrown hairs so they resolve fasterOBSESSED. I’m obsessed with these Facial Radiance Pads all over again! I will purchase these when I run out because I love the benefits I get from them & like that I can use it as a toner + exfoliator in one. Plus, I am dying to get the Limited Edition tub of pads! At nighttime I use 1/2 or a whole pad on my face, neck, & décolleté after cleansing (the FAB Pure Skin Face Cleanser is perfect for this step!), then let it dry down for 5-10 minutes. Afterwards, I pat in a thicker toner or essence with my hands, & follow it up with my serum(s), eye cream, + moisturizer. If the results I’ve seen in the last ~4 weeks are any indication, then I’m up for DRAMATIC results in 6 months. I can’t wait to see!

These are a super toner for your face. Normally I try to test a product for roughly 30 days before posting a review but I noticed immediate results from these. Their formulation is absolutely perfect. As someone who has used many toners, I love toners that come in the pad form because they are always very saturated and you’re not wasting product by putting it into cotton pads or trying to just apply it with your fingers.
They were not a miracle. I would not buy these pads as a toner. I believe they caused my skin to breakout, and I would not recommend to a friend.

These worked great for my dry, sensitive, acne prone skin! It tingles a bit in areas I have a pimple starting, and really helps with exfoliation and brightness. I use them after cleansing, and before the rest of my skincare routine.
I have super sensitive oily skin and this is a great! It leaves my skin glowing!

I absolutely LOVE these radiance pads. I have combination acne prone skin. After using dermatologist recommended retinol my skin looks so clear however the retinol has left it dry, flakes and dull. These radiance wipes are great for my sensitive skin. They fluff off all the dead skin while hydrating at the same time. PRO TIP: cut them in half to stretch the # of pads as there are nicely coated in product.do yourself a favor and BUY...

Activate your GLAM! Ladies THIS is my new favorite serum! I’ve been very fond of the Drunk Elephant Glycolic Serum until I was sent this one complimentary in exchange for a review. Now—-I’m a Lancôme girl! My skin looks phenomenal and feels smooth. My uneven skin tones and splotchy red spots are GONE! I’m absolutely in love. The pump is very easy to use and makes me feel so fancy!

Really loved the way this product made my skin feel. Didn’t really like the smell but it is still tolerable! It makes me skin moisturizing! I would recommend this product to others and I received this product for free from influenster to try.

For starters, this product is an ESSENCE. not a serum. it should be used as the essence step in your skincare routine. The lightweight texture is perfect for BEFORE all other skincare products. That aside, this thing is SO fragranced. It is too strong and also has a high amount of alcohol that i can smell pretty strongly as well.I used for 7 days - as the claims say i would see results in 7 days. And I saw nothing dramatic happen. I saw no reason for me to spend tons of money on a bottle of basically perfume to rub on my face. There are better options for an essence step.

I got a bunch of  sample packets that I’ve been using once  a day for the last few weeks, and at first I did notice that it made my skin look more youthful, but now I have some of the worst acne I’ve ever had in my life! It took me a little bit to realize it was this product and not my diet/ lotions/makeup. Etc. I have not had so many bumps/pimples on my face at once since using this product :.( . Oh well, good thing I was using free samples and not an expensive bottle! Try before you buy!

I’ve been using this product for about 3 months now, twice a day. I really don’t see a difference at all in my skin. It isn’t clearer, skin isn’t any more moisturized and dark spots haven’t faded. It really just doesn’t feel like it does anything.
I’d give 10 stars if I could. my only complaint is there just isn’t enough product! And please make it a staple in the Rewards Bazaar!!!! I LOVE this stuff but it’s sooo expensive!

I received this free as part of my influencester box.... I never thought I’d see myself in my late 20s buying a serum this expensive.... BUT THIS ISH WORKS!! Very light and I saw results after about a week and a half. I love how they crafted the bottle to pick up and dispense the right amount. It’s light and doesn’t leave my already oily skin oily! Mind blown.

I love how this serum makes my skin look after only using it a few days. I received it free from Influenster and I am excited to continue using it. I have pretty normal to dry skin and it works well with all of my other products too.

review_title: Will Never Be Without This Miracle Product!!!
review_text: I’ve never considered a skincare product life changing until I discovered this! It came as a free gift and after using it for 2 weeks (twice daily) my skin was so smooth and balanced!! Now I refuse to go without it!!

I received this product as part of my Influenster campaign.  It is not something I ever would have bought on my own, especially at it’s price; however it does wonders for your skin!  I’m just under 30, so those fine lines are setting in.  This product helps to ease those lines, doesn’t cause acne, and blends well with foundation during the day or is a nice coat to put on at night.  For those wanting something that works, it’s worth every dollar.
If you want to treat yourself this is the product. Smells amazing. Goes on smooth. I want to own a million of these....
Love the flavor but not as moisturizing as other balms. Have to reapply often.

This is by far the absolute best lip product I have ever used in my entire life.  I’ve tried a lot, and I prefer to stick to products with more natural ingredients when it’s something on my mouth that I know I’ll be ingesting.  Burt’s Bees and other natural balms PALE in comparison to this product!  I will absolutely never go back.  The texture is phenomenal, never waxy, perfectly smooth, and extremely hydrating.  So many other lip balms made me feel the urge to constantly reapply them (I swear it’s a scam to make you buy more... seriously.). But not this one!  I’ll maybe apply it twice a day just for personal preference, but I rarely feel the urge to add more.  It’s a wi yet life saver, too, especially in dried out furnace air.  I cannot say enough good things about this product.  Even the large size I love.  It looks like a glue stick, but the application is so quick and easy and it doesn’t feel too big.  The price seems high, but for the products and results that I get, it will absolutely beat out a $5 chapstick every single time.  I would be shocked to hear a bad review on this balm.
This stuff is incredible. Super hydrating, smells amazing. Great during the summer. I need to buy another as mine has been gone for awhile now but its sold our.

Smells like heaven, perfect packaging and a great price. One stick can last a month if not longer. By far my favorite lip balm out there and I am an avid lip balm user. If you like the smell of the bum bum cream then I can guarantee you will also love the smell of this balm.

LOVE this lip balm! Smells amazing (not exactly like the Bum Bum Cream, but a similarly gourmand type scent), has great ingredients, and leaves my lips feeling incredibly soft. In regards to the complaints about deceptive packaging, even though the entire tube is not full, the actual component itself is huge (WAY chubbier than most other lip balms). You’re getting over 6 grams of product, which is more than a lot of other lip balms out there. It’s definitely expensive in comparison to what you might find at the drugstore, but I’ve personally found it worth the investment!

I absolutely LOVE the way this lip butter makes my lips feel. With that said, I do have to say that I am not a fan of the scent. It was definitely not the scent I expected. I was also rather disappointed in how much product you get. I was surprised when I realized I had hit the end. I enjoyed it while it lasted, but $18 is a little steep for the amount you get. I will not be purchasing this again, but if you can justify the price, I say go for it! Picture is empty and rolled all the way down.
Soft and buttery, love this a lot. Leaves my lips super soft.

I am a total chapstick fanatic and I am always buying new ones and applying them constantly and so I’ve learned what I like and don’t like in a chapstick. This one is great it moisturizes, is not greasy or sticky feeling at all, I apply it more than I need to because the smell is so amazing !
I love it very moisturizing and glides on the lips like butter (hence the word “lip butter”. Only 4 stars bcuz there’s not much product in the tube.

I got this #freeproduct from Topbox and was surprised at the size of the sample. Wouldn’t really see the difference because of the size but I liked the smell of it and it made my eye area hydrated. I would try this again if given the chance it is on sale.

#topbox #freeproduct I got this product free to review  and give my feedback. it’s a nice smooth serum. smooths nicely over the face and isn’t sticky. it doesn’t have a bad smell either. I would highly recommend this product

Like all of the product in the same line as this that i have received from topbox #freeproduct , the sample was very small in order for me to be able to do a full review and see any difference. But the smell is great, dries very fast and glides onto my dry skin smoothly.

I received this for free in exchange of my honest opinion. A little drop of this serum goes a long way as well and it won’t leave your skin feeling greasy or sticky it soaks right into your skin. I love all their products, and I felt it did great even with the small quantity in the sample size.

Got to try a sample of the Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum through #freeproduct from Top Box along with a sample of Clinique’s correcting eye cream and wrinkle correcting cream from the same product line.As the sample that I received was quite small, it was hard to get the full effects of the serum but not much of the product seemed to be needed. I applied the serum to some fine lines that are starting to appear and used the serum every night during my nightly routine for a week.I noticed that the forming lines seemed to be less apparent after the week but it wasn’t a huge obvious noticable change due to the usage of a week.Easy to apply the product and would love to try more of the product in the future. Overall, solid product!

I recieved this #freeproduct from #topboxcircle in exchange for my honest review. I used this serum day and night for a couple of days. This serum is very moisturizing, absorbs quickly into the skin and doesn’t leave your skin feeling greasy. The sample was too small to determine results but overall I liked the product!

I received this product free to try from Topbox circle in exchange  of a honest opinion. It cames as a sample size and there wasn’t enough product to get the full effect over the time. But after just a couple of uses, this serum left my skin very moisturized, not sticky and I love the scent. It would have been nice to try this product more longer.  #freeproduct

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. When I applied it on my face, I could tell it’s very thick and rich. It is not greasy or leave behind any sticky feeling on your face. It absorbed quickly and my face felt hydrated. There’s no fragrance or scent in this serum which I really like. I did not receive enough product to see longterm results.

i tried the cream and serum together. if i have the opportunity to do it again i will try one for 2 days then then other .after using this product for 2 days both morning and night combined with serum it might of been a little to heavy for my skin as 2 large pimples appeared .i loved the serum it felt silky on my finger tips as well on my face.after adding the cream my skin did not feel heavy but he texture was nice and a very very light smell.
The one application I could get out of the sample layered well under makeup. I did not see any change to my skin.

this oil is HEAVEN lathered on your face! My first experience with it was just so nourishing and revitalizing to my face.I just this product everyday and my pores have been diminishing day by day, I absolutely love this product! I will be using it for years!
Simply amazing. Must try for everyone!

I got this after hearing amazing things and my current cleansing oil was almost gone, I don’t regret buying it but I also won’t buy it again. It doesn’t remove make-up that well, I still have to go in with something else to remove my make-up (and I don’t where that much makeup)

I have normal skin. I use this to clean the makeup from my face  each night before using my exfoliating cleanser. It gets my skin nice and clean while soothing and hydrating. I have seen an improvement in my skin texture and brightness since using (about a month).

review_title: DOES NOT REMOVE MAKEUP VERY WELL
review_text: I really wanted to love this and was so excited try it however im really not understanding what all amazing reviews are about.. this didn’t remove my make up very well at all and I followed the directions exactly and I dont use water proof or wear that much makeup.. just foundation concealer and mascara... no eyeliner or eye shadows... I pumped 3 pumps into my dry hands and warmed it up by rubbing my hands together first however my hands are always pretty cold.. (not sure if you need to have warm hands to make this work better or not)  then I started massaging it all over my face starting with my cheeks and forehead and finished off with my eyes and made sure I went over them numberouse times until I felt my mascara was starting to clump off my lashes and then i added warm water while still gently massaging and then rinsed off completley but I was left with tons of makeup and black mascara all around my eye area..I looked like a raccoon so I dried my face and did the process all over again.. that helped a bit but I was still left with lots of makeup residue and needed to use my normal cleanser to get the rest off.. I used this for 4 days and was trying different techniques and still came up with the same result every time.  I did like that it did not leave any sticky residue or film on my face. But honestly there are other oil cleansers out there that remove makeup way better than this one and for a better price too!

This is so good, probably the best and I’ve tried a lot of oil cleansers. I’ve probably repurchased this like 10 tomes, if not more. even when I go to try out a new cleanser I always end up coming back to this. I use it before the tatcha deep cleanse to help break up and remove my makeup and it does such a good job. you only need a couple pumps and it even breaks down my eye makeup without issue. has a nice scent, does irritate my skind and leaves it feeling soft. would recommend this to people who like double cleansing. or just oil cleansing in general

I cannot say enough good things about this product!! It’s lightweight, doesn’t clog your pores, smells nice, lasts forever, and does a great job!! I use this as a makeup remover or as my first cleanse. It’s applied dry and then rinsed off, and does a really great job of breaking down ALL of my makeup. I slept overnight with this on, crossing my fingers I’d wake up looking good, but it was soo streaky and I missed those hard to reach spots on the back of my arm and leg and it was very noticeable (luckily I tried this during quarantine and nobody really saw me). Overall would not recommend at all - use a tanning mousse instead that goes on in color so you don’t end up with splotches from applying blindly.

review_title: There’s a Trick to This Stuff!
review_text: I love this cream. Since using it as part of my nighttime regimen, my skin has changed dramatically. I live in southern Ontario, and in the cold dry winter months my skin has the worst flaky patches that make my foundation look cheap and awkward. Since using this, my skin is smooth, bright, and moisturized, and my skin tone is evened out. I do find that it pills, and I find it difficult to “pat” into the skin. I use a small pea sized amount (you don’t need anymore than that) and I add 3 drops of The Ordinary Alpha Arbutin 2% + Hyaluronic Acid and mix in my palm, then apply it to my face; it doesn’t pill, and spreads so evenly. Highly recommend!

I like this cream and while it does have a slightly grainy texture, it absorbs quite quickly for smooth results. I did not have any uncomfortable spicy feelings with this cream but I do not have overly sensitive skin. If you have had issues in the past, I’d def try to mix it with another moisturizer. I’m still undecided if I can see all the benefits of this cream but for the price, it was definitely worth a try and an easy cream to add to a weekly rotation. I would likely purchase again.

review_text: This product produced visible results on me.  It does burn a bit but if you add a drop to The Ordinary Buffet serum, it alleviates any discomfort.  I had hyper-pigmentation from cysts and within one month, they were gone.  I will definitely be buying this from now on!

Dotting it on is easy with the applicator and a little goes a long way. A little squeeze and the product comes out and blends in with the metal tip. I like the texture in the applicator tip, it smooths out the serum and spreads out evenly. Chilling the serum in the fridge makes it feel even better going on. I’ve been using this daily for a couple weeks now and can already see a difference in the firmness around my eyes. My hooded eyelids are not as saggy, skin feels firmer and looks brighter. I still have a lot of product left so I think this would last for at least a couple months. At this price point I think it’s definitely worth buying again.

I love the slanted tip/applicator for smoothing, especially when it’s chilled.Highly recommend, even though the price is high, a little bit truly goes a long way!

I was lucky enough to receive a tube of this eye serum from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. At first I had some trouble applying it, you have to squeeze the tube a little to get  just enough product on the tip that it will glide around the eye area. If you squeeze too much I feel like the product gets wasted, not enough and it skips/tugs. The serum feels very light and cool and absorbs almost instantly. I used the method where you swipe towards the middle 3 times under the eye and on eyelid, then smooth eyelid towards outside and finish with brow bone massage. I still have some trouble applying just the right amount so I massage in any excess using my fingertips following the same application method. The tip is textured and shaped unlike other eye serums that have a tip or rollerball, and it is flexible. This serum doesn’t seem to moisturize on its own but definitely helps my eye cream work better. After using this for a month I give it 3 stars because I have not noticed much difference and for this price tag I expect more. The box says I would notice “more awake” eyes, what does that even mean?  I would have like to seen a more ergonomic wand and moisturizing benefits. While I greatly appreciate the freebie, I would not repurchase.

I was really excited to receive this product.  I haven’t noticed drastic results. However, I’ve noticed that it calmed my under eye area so it was less puffy and the fine lines were softened. The tune needs to be a little softer.

I would not say that it helped get rid of dark circles but rather it helped with the appearance. It moisturizes wonderfully. I would purchase this product in the future.

This is the second skincare item ive tried grom dior and it did not disapoint. The serum absorbed well and my fine lines diminished. My one complaint would be the ridges in the applicator tip. I often found traces of product caught in the ridges and so i cleaned it off and applied the additional serum with my finger so none wkuld be lost. I loved that i had no clogged pores and my skin looked fabulous. A definate repurchase.

It leaves my skin feeling soft and not at all sticky like some serums do. It also works well under my makeup. What I wasn’t too impressed about is the packaging and the effectiveness of the serum. The squeeze tube plus the applicator makes it really difficult to get the right amount of product out and spread around where you want to apply it. Not enough and the applicator was pulling my skin, and too much was wasteful. Also, I only used this on one eye for 3 full weeks and didn’t really see any changes in the firmness, fine lines, or darkness of my circles. The only thing this serum provided for me was very soft skin and less puffiness. I don’t think I would buy this again.

review_title: Excellent Eye Serum with Cooling Applicator
review_text: I have been using Dior Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum now for about a week and I am loving the results. My skin looks brighter and feels more firm after applying each morning and evening. I don’t struggle with puffiness in the mornings, but do occasionally have darker areas under my eyes and this serum helps minimize and brighten underneath my eyes. Some of my smaller fine lines have even disappeared as the serum plumps and hydrates those areas. I have enjoyed using Dior Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum because the applicator feels nice and cooling on the skin. Also unlike other products, I noticed a change in my skin after using the serum only 3 or 4 times. Although pricey, this is definitely an eye serum I will likely purchase in the future.

After a week of continued use both day and night, I am excited to see the results of this age defying serum. Under eye puffiness and dark circles have dramatically gone down and I look overall more refreshed. I’ve noticed a softening of the fine lines and crow’s feet at the edge of my eyes which is really exciting. With even more continued use, I can imagine how more dramatic the results will be. I found you must be careful with the applicator to not over apply but once you get used to the container you know more what to expect and how much you want to release to get proper coverage. I thought the applicator was genuinely good and helped smooth the serum over the entirety of the eye area. There are specific directions on how and where to apply for results so make sure to read before using. Overall I’m really pleased with how my eye area is more radiant and firmer. Price tag is definitely on the higher end but results are definitely visible and measurable. I’d suggest for anyone looking to keep their eyes and delicate skin looking young, radiant and smooth.

I tried this product as a stand alone product (just on toner), and I tried this product in combination with my toner, essence, serum and spf.I found this Moisturizer to work GREAT in the multiple step Korean method of skin care. It worked very well as a stand alone product as well. I liked this one better stand alone, compared to the Lotus Dream Night Cream from the same line.I think the formula is great, the smell is preferential (I am not a big fan, but it is all natural and it goes away super fast.). I like the texture because it is right in the middle. You can use a little less, or a little more depending on your skin’s needs. I also love that it does not clog my pores, as I have a major issue with pore clogging. It also worked really well as base for my foundation. I only wish this would have some spf protection as well.Side note: My foundation is a luminous finish, and this moisturizer gives you a glowing look as well. So I was worried together they will look greasy, but I am quite happy with how the compliment each other.All and all, I would highly recommend this product. Also, the 1.6 oz is a huge amount. I have been using this for a couple of weeks now, and I still feel like I have not used any yet.I received this product complimentary, to test from Influenster.
