I love this moisturizer! The smell is so pleasant. It has not broke out my acne prone skin after 2 weeks of use. It absorbs super quickly and wears well under a full face of makeup. I like that this can also be used as a night cream. Highly recommend.
Non-greasy! Makes my skin super soft and look great. It even makes makeup application better. I apply a small amount after washing my face in the morning.
Delicate as a lotus flower. I loved the fragrance, the texture, it leaves no residue unlike other similar products. Only downside for me is I like my moisturizer with SPF.

**I received this product complimentary**I haven’t used Fresh products before, but I don’t really like this moisturizer. It is light, and I can feel my skin actually sucking it in rather than it just sitting on top and making me look shiny. It smells  light and cucumbery, and nice. Overall I think it’s a good product. I’m happy that I received it, however the price point means I likely won’t purchase it again.

The Sugar Lip balm was gifted by Fresh. This balm left my lips hydrated for hours! I’m obsessed with the way this balm felt. I loved that it was a buildable color as well. However, this color in particular didn’t compliment my skin tone as much as I hoped.

Fresh’s sugar lip treatment in papaya (kindly gifted to me by Fresh) is an intensely hydrating lip balm that contains beeswax and a variety of fruit oils (like avocado and lemon peel). It does not seem to contain any actual papaya, so I suppose that’s just the name of the color. The scent is sweet like a sugary lemon wafer. The treatment does contain added fragrance as well as added color, which creates a pretty buildable pink-red on the lips. One note: the tube is luxe and metallic, and the top twists off (so don’t try to pull)!

This is a very hydrating lip balm. The color is very Beautiful like a berry juicy shade. Lips feels very nice after using it. You need to twist to open it, which make this very safe to keep in your bag.

I looooooooove Fresh’s lip balm! I’m always into natural clean beauty on my daily lifestyle and Fresh always has a perfect colors! And of course keeps my lip hydrated that I can feel it’s been protected. I can’t live without them! This time it was Gifted by Fresh.

Love using Fresh products! They never disappoint. This sugar lip treatment keeps my lips hydrated and I also love how it’s give your lips a tinted color. There’s a few shades to pick from. I highly recommend this product!
It’s such a bummer they changed the formula. They removed the SPF, and it’s sadly not as creamy and fabulous.

Fresh lip balms have been a favorite for as long as I remember. Sugar Lip Treatments are the same, but infused with beet sugar, and along with hydration provide a hint of buildable color. The peony shade perfectly matches my natural lip tone, making them look fuller and juicer. I wear it in the summer as a hydrating lip stain. The product was gifted to me by Fresh.

I’ve been using the fresh lip treatments for years and always keep them on hand, they’re just too good. So hydrating and nourishing and with an added tint of color! Couldn’t ask for more in lip product! Gifted by fresh

This product was gifted by Fresh and pretty good if you want a lip color. I didn’t prefer this color for my light skin and definitely isn’t an everyday wear but it felt nice on my lips for the first few hours then wore away. Good product just not my color

Very creamy and moisturizing. I’ve always been a big fan of Fresh products and this is another win. Product is very buildable so you can go for a more natural or bold look with the same product. This was gifted by Fresh and I think I would pick another shade next time but overall great product!

This collagen might be great and work wonderfully if you’re stupid-rich and don’t mind having to spend $115 about every 3 weeks. That’s how long the tube lasts. Seriously. I’m not convinced it really did anything anyway.

This liquid collagen is amazing. It applies super easy, dries fast, and moisturizer can be applied on top of it (or makeup!). Within just a few days of using it i noticed my wrinkles fading away. Try it. I received this product complimentary from Algenist.

I purchased this because I absolutely love the lip collagen but I just don’t notice the same amazing results that the lip serum gave me. I did read one review before purchasing that said if you show no sure signs of aging, not to spend your money on the product and they were probably right. While I’m 28 and am aging.... I don’t have any lines or anything set in my skin. It’s a very expensive product and all I really liked about it was the texture and the smell (which are both great). I probably won’t repurchase unless I notice significant change in my skin once I stop using it when the bottle runs out... but I doubt that will happen since i didn’t see any change when I started a few months ago. I am saying that I would recommend this product to someone who shows more signs of aging than I do at this point in life.

Absolutely love this serum. I have no issue with the fragrance. Just like with any product you introduce to your routine it’s going to take a while to adjust to it and you do. I’m combo and once it’s used to it the results and worth it all! Love mixing this into my lip balms as well.

I too received a free sample. While one sample is not enough to see dramatic results, I shelled out the $$ to give a try. I’m in the middle of forty and my fine lines under my eyes diminished and even the 11’s between my eyes have softened. The skin under my neck has definitely tightened up. I could probably use a little less than is measured out. I have been using it well over two weeks and there is only 1/4 gone. That’s with morning and night usage. Well, almost twice a day. For the most part, I stayed consistent. I don’t love the scent, not that there is a scent, per se. It also leaves the skin a tiny bit tacky, so I always follow with serum and/or moisturizer.

I received this complimentary from Algenist and This serum is great! I’ve been using it on my face and neck area and i can really see a difference in the appearance of my skin. It feels more luminous and i think it is helping with fine lines especially on my chest.

When I first got this I used it in the morning and it was a little too much for my combination skin; but now it’s my staple night routine item. I read that collagen is mostly for moisturizing when applied topically so I’m not upset when I’m not seeing a ton of plumping effect (honestly I don’t believe anything that’s applied on the skin’s surface can plump lol), but man this thing nourishes the skin well. I was getting a ton of pimples along my jawline and it pretty much has stopped ever since I started using this. The scent is soft, and the product is gentle enough to be paired with most other serums and creams I have. Very happy and will continue to buy.

review_title: This worked for my finicky skin.
review_text: Sadly for my wallet, but very good for my skin, I’ll have to make this investment.... I tried out a sample for about a week and a half and I saw improvement in evenness of my skin tone and firmness and I just loved how my skin felt. I have oily skin and usually when I wake up my face feels greasy, but I did not feel that way when i put this Liquid Collagen on at night. My skin felt velvety and firm/tight, but not dry at all. And it smells very comforting!
Made me skin red and itchy. Thankfully it was only a sample and not a waste of $100.

I’ve read these reviews that say the collagen molecule is too big to be absorbed by the skin. I don’t know if that’s true. I didn’t want to like it because it’s expensive. So I tried the samples I got for a week or two and stopped when it ran out, prepared to forget it like most samples. About a week after I stopped I noticed increased crepe-y-ness on my temples and cheeks. This had been doing something after all and it was only really clear after I stopped. So that’s pretty cool. My personal experience is that most OTC skin care anti-aging stuff is placebo effect. Or the changes are so gradual in both directions that I can’t objectively tell if it helps. But this makes noteworthy improvement. So even if the molecule is too big, algenist has done some other thing here that helps. I’m actually going to buy a second bottle. My first ran out a few weeks ago and I miss it. Same thing. Stop using it and notice a difference. I hardly ever buy a second bottle of anything.

This is a great toner! Super gentle but effective way to clear your skin. I loved that it didn’t strip my skin and left it feeling great. I have super sensitive skin and this didn’t irritate it at all.
This toner is the definition of FRESH! It’s so soothing once applied to a clean face, doesn’t dry out at all. Slight fragrance but it’s still subtle and not overbearing. I like it for sure :)
Very good. Works well.Pro tip: It should be a given people, keep away from the eye area. You don’t tone the eye area.

Amazing product for the price.  I recieved this product from influenster for my honest opinion and honestly i have been loving it!  I am especially looking forward to incorporating this into my skin care for the fall as the weather get drier as does my skin. My skin drinks the product up and it preps my skin for serums to be applied

I don’t usually like toners but this one has changed my mind!  It doesn’t burn like some have done in the past, in fact it feels soothing when I put it on. Also I ADORE the scent!  It’s so fresh and lovely!  The formula definitely hydrates my skin and doesn’t dry it like others have also done in the past. I recommend to anybody wanting to try a toner and will definitely purchase in the future.

review_title: Like a refreshing glass of water for your skin.
review_text: Its funny how toners always were in the very end of my beauty care list. I would always skip this step. BUT after receiving BELIF aqua bomb hydrating  toner everything changed. Its really gives your skin all the hydration you need. I feel the difference right away. Skin feels like you just gave it big glass of cold water. I live it!

Loved this toner, great for the summer time to add in hydration without any weight. Helps bring moisture into the skin, making it ideal for any skin type! Weightless and very refreshing I revived complementary from Influenster!

So far I am loving this toner! I have combo skin and I have noticed a big change in my dry areas! I was a flaky mess on my chin and cheeks and my skin has definitely improved since I started using this.

The Aqua Bomb Toner is no joke! It smells like 7-up (Delish!) and immediately calms the skin. The moisture I felt even before applying the cream is insane! I would def recommend to anyone needing more moisture in their skin!

I received this toner from Influenster 2 weeks ago and love it! I haven’t used toner in years and now I’m wondering why! It seems to get the last little bit of makeup off and feels so refreshing! I’ve been wearing a mask at work 10 hours a day and have less breakouts then before the mask and they aren’t as bad when I get them. My face goes a little red after use, but it goes away quickly. I also have sensitive skin and the scent is fine. Would purchase again!
I use this as a morning lotion because its really lightweight and doesn’t make my skin feel heavy! I had to buy again because I love the smell and the texture

Bought this because I love FAB, and have bought a lot of their products, I swear by their Ultra Repair cream.  I was looking for a product that is light weight and moisturizes- while it is light weight this leaves my skin dry and tight. I dont have dry skin, I run on the oily side- but this really dries me out.
I received a sample of this and loved the way it felt on my skin. I’m considering buying a jar at some point, maybe when I finish my other moisturizers.

This product felt amazing on the skin but I found out soon enough that it was breaking me out. Some skin types can’t handle coconut oil and others soak it up! So definitely see if you can get a trial size before purchasing:)
I originally got a sample of FAB coconut water cream, and I loved it so much I bought the full size. It plumped out fine lines and made my skin feel nourished.
Absorbs well, but hydration does not last on dry skin. Horrible, strong smell as well. The only product from FAB that I dislike.

Love it. I was initially on the fence about this product. Until I incorporated a few different serums (collagen and Q10 from the Inkey List) plus hyaluronic acid. My skin texture has changed so much, it is so soft and radiant! I’ve had to use other creams if I’ve forgotten this while traveling, and I do notice a difference. This is a perfect base for makeup or to bare your skin. Plus there is this wonderful cooling experience when you initially put this on. I’ve never had any piling of products and, for me, the finishing texture is not tacky. For me - this cream is an entire experience. I’m on my second jar now and I will keep on using this from spring to fall. I live up north and I know this won’t do diddly squat when it’s - 40C (-40F for my imperial system folks!) - but that’s ok as FAB Coconut Smoothie Primer is my winter jam. Star off for packaging - I don’t like having to scoop out the product with my finger and having to continuously expose the cream to air. This product is thin enough to be in a pump or squeeze container.

I got this in last months PLAY box and I fell in love with it! I love the way my skin feels after applying, not oily or wet but it soaks into my skin and it feels weightless. Amazing product, basing this off of the sample but I am purchasing and will continue to purchase!!

I think this is a really great moisturizer. I however have very dehydrated and dry skin and it just wasn’t quite enough for my needs. So while I think this is an excellent product, it may not meet the skin needs of those with very dry skin.

I absolutely love this product. I started using it after hearing Hyram rave about it on YouTube. I have combination skin so wanted a good gel cream for my day moisturizer. This delivers in EVERY WAY and instantly absorbs into the skin. The only thing to watch is that if your skin barrier is damaged, this can burn and irritate your skin. Make sure to use on healthy skin to avoid discomfort, and maybe try the FAB Ultra Repair Cream to help repair your skin before using this if you’re having issues. I use that cream at night and this during the day.
I enjoy using this serum. It does make my ski brighter and a little firmer. But it’s not as life changing as I thought it would be. And it’s really pricey. But overall a good product.

This vitamin C serum WORKS! I have never used a vitamin C that also makes your skin feel that moisturized. Trouble with other brands is that a lot of the time the serum isn’t fresh, and vitamin C is known to have a shorter shelf life. With this one you put it together yourself (which was simple), so you know it’s new. The only downside is the smell. It no joke smells like car tires. The upside to that is the scent will eventually disappear.

it burns my face the minute i applied it on. After diluted it the second time I use it, it still stings and hurts. This is insane.I have bought the baby facial (BHA/AHA) of drunk elephant, and it burns me too. I have tried the VC eye cream, it also burns and swollen my eyes. This brand is insane. All three products 1 start.

I love Drunk Elephant products, but of all the Vitamin Cs I have tried over the years this is my favorite one. Even the old formula was good. I like this one because it seems even less thick than the original, but it also doesn’t feel tacky. I hate skincare products that leave my skin tacky. I wish it wasn’t $78, but I am grateful I received this product for free. :)

Usually use the high priced gold standard vit c serum but didn’t want to have it shipped in the hot summer to Arizona. Tried this. Don’t notice anything. The high end serum makes my skin smooth and glowing. This- no glow and my dark spots are reappearing. Too bad.

review_title: Best Vit C Serum, Hands Down
review_text: This is such a fun yet very effective serum! You get to feel like a little scientist when you open the kit and get to mix the ingredients yourself which gives a fun twist to the product. This serum really helps brighten and even your complexion. I really tried to use this as long as possible before giving my opinion. This has really made a difference in the appearance of my skin and it gives your skin a luminous glow. It feels refreshing and clean and isn’t heavy on the skin. I will definitely buy a replacement when this runs out! I recommend to anyone that wants to even and brighten their skin tone.

I thought the idea was fun to mix up your own serum with the powder and serum base; however, my skin did not like this serum. This serum irritated the corners of my mouth and around my lip area and it gave me little forehead bumps. I was so excited to receive this, but unfortunately did not love this one. I usually LOVE Drunk Elephant products, but this was a no for me.

First to start with the smell-Im not a fan of it.However even though its tacky ,I like the serum.Using it for over a week now I can say that my skin likes it.I will see in few weeks if there are any more results.I I can say that I have used other DE products and this one didnt have that wow effect on me as the other products did.

Can’t say I Love this but it has boosted a new glow in my skin. It’s a bit sticky when applying, so I pat it into skin instead of smoothing it on like another serum I use. I’ve noticed some breakouts since starting but nothing to make me quit using it. I’ll finish this bottle and may find something a bit better. Fine for now though.

I got this product for free to give my full honest review from influenster and drunk elephant.  Lets start with how amazing it is that if comes with two bottles so you can mix up the formula your self and you know that its super fresh. It honestly makes you feel like a mixologist super fun. The product does have a little bit of a Chemical smell I think it because of the vitamin c in it. I really enjoyed how fresh and plump my face felt after I applied it. Compared to Murad vitamin c moisturizer which dried my face out and made my extremely itchy on it. I’m not having this issue with this product so far. The only down side is the amount of product you get in the container for the price just wish it was more.
Super lightweight and gives a great glow. Love wearing it under my makeup.

I’ve been using the Cleanser, Power Toner, Superberry Oil, and the Moisturizer.... it’s my new favorite skincare routine! This product is perfection in a bottle! I love how it feels when I apply it, I love the glow I get after application, and I feel like it even provides a smooth base for when I apply my make up! Some people say it’s “sticky” but I follow it with the YTTP moisturizer and it hasn’t been an issue! Seriously, you have to try this!!

Truly an amazing product. I struggled with skin for a long time and still so in the winter. Consistent use of this product in the AM/PM will give you beautiful results. I don’t even use moisturizer any more I only use this product to moisturize my face. It also looks beautiful when you mix a little with your foundation, rub together in your hands and apply to face and gives you a gorgeous glowy finish.
Smells amazing, moisturizes, leaves a wonderful glow, and doesn’t break me out. Love this facial oil!

I live in a cold climate and have a dry, peeling, and irritated nose from the weather. I use this oil on my nose and it does an amazing job moisturizing it as I can see the skin around my nose improving the next day. I do avoid using it on my face in general as it does break me out. I would recommend this oil if you have extremely dry skin.
Just what my dry skin needed this summer!  Highly recommend.

I have only recently become a fan of facial oils and this is one of the best I’ve tried. It hydrates the skin, but doesn’t make your skin too oily because its so lightweight. The smell is sweet, fresh, and not overbearing. This layers really well under makeup. My skin feels so much healthier since I started using this.

This oil is amazing. I have a combination skin that dries out for the most part during winter and this helps me keep that glow from within look! Its not extra oily and my skin absorbs it very well, I love it!!

review_title: Love it!  Great balance and glow.
review_text: I just started using this facial oil about 2 months ago and I love it!  I used to use argan oil and before that used lots of different lotions, and was always finding that some parts of my skin would be dry, while others broke out.  Once I started using this oil my skin evened out, and it gives me a great glow.  I actually recently got a compliment on my skin for literally the first time in my life.  I’ll be re-purchasing!

I’ve been using this oil as the start of my daily morning makeup routine and it’s great! It absorbs quickly and adds just enough moisture without leaving skin oily in appearance. It hasn’t caused me to break out, and just a few drops is sufficient. No strong scent. No tingling or irritation.

I really liked the Keihl’s Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum. It’s super hydrating. I’ve noticed reduced fine lines and slightly reduced dark circles. I’m hopeful that with continued use I will see the results I’m looking for.

I received this product free from infuenster. I had very high hopes because I struggle with dark circles. This product is very creamy and feels like a primer. But I still felt like I needed moisturizer on top of it and I didn’t really like the way my makeup applied on top of it. I have a very sensitive eye area and day 1 and 2 my eyes felt fine. Everyday after those product left a tingling, itching sensation. After seven days there might be a slight difference in discoloration, but it definitely doesn’t help with puffiness. I would not spend $50 on this. I’ll stick to my regular moisturizer.
I have been using this product for only 10 days and I already see a difference. Highly recommend. My under eyes are noticeably less dark and my skin is hydrated. I use in the morning and at night.

I have always had some dark circles, luckily they’ve never been too bad. I recieved this as a complimentary package and have been using it for about a week. Considering the small amount of sleep I have been getting it has been helping me a lot. The price is steep but if you suffer from bad circles this could help!

I love Kiehl’s and was excited to try this generously size eye serum. There is no smell and no irritation after using for eight weeks. I like that. The texture is medium weight and didn’t feel greasy or too thin. I had hoped for more results in dark circle reduction and line diminishing. I really didn’t see any miracles there (nor did I expect them). Regarding packaging, the clear plastic top doesn’t stay seated at all. Not helpful when traveling with this product. Perhaps others will see better results, but I just found it a hydrating eye cream.

I been using it over a Month,I apply as directed, I use it at night and Day. You only need to use a little bit. My under eye area has very deep bags, and puffiness. What the serum has really done for me is decreased puffiness. My eyes would look so tired throughout the day, and since v I’ve been using this night and day for about over a month. there is almost no puffiness, even first thing in the morning. And has reduced the appearance of My deep bags. The only down side it dries out my under eyes and they start itching but otherwise it works.

One of the most effective eye serums I have ever tried, period. Yes it does have dimethicone in it, but it didn’t give me any problems. It’s been almost two years and with day and night use I had no milia growing. And I did get milia from quite a few other eye products. I used to have a visible line under my left eye and now it’s gone. GONE. I also didn’t notice any new developments of fine lines, especially considering I have awful sleep schedule. This is a keeper and I will be buying this eye serum as long as they don’t discontinue it.

review_title: One of the better eye creams I’ve used
review_text: This eye cream feels great. It really feels like it holds in moisture. I have seen a slight brightening in my dark circles, but will need to use for longer to see results. Definitely one of the better eye creams that I have used.* I received this product free for review in an Influenster Vox box

I received this product for free from influenster! I was so excited to try it out. I love the consistency. Its kind of thick so you only need a tiny bit. I put it on twice a day and noticed that my eyes looks more awake. He only thing is that it can be a little itchy to the sensitive skin around the eyes at first but it wasn’t bad. I would definitely buy this and use it again!

review_title: TRI-PEPTIDE and Hyaluronic Acid and Vitamin C
review_text: I love this eye cream! My eyes are super sensitive and get but they really liked this! It hydrates and plumps soooo well and it goes on really nice and smooth. Love that it has Tri-peptide( for plumping) and Hyaluronic acid to  provide moisture and suppleness.

review_title: GO TO YOUR NEAREST SEPHORA RIGHT NOW!!
review_text: I bought this product sceptical because I’m very picky with my creams but Ill have to add this one to my collection and routine! This product is HANDS DOWN INCREDIBLE. First use I used it before I went to sleep and I woke up with glowing, brighter, and softer skin!!! This is a must if you want a plumping moisturizer that isnt sticky. This is an amazing way to also nourish the skin with vitamin c. This product is scented. I don’t typically go for the scented skincare but this is an ACCEPTION!!!!

I already love Ole Henriksen serums so had high hopes with this one. It did not disappoint. My skin was immediately brighter and i have started to notice my pores getting smaller. I will be re-purchasing this!

review_title: A must have in skin care routine!
review_text: I have been using this serum for a week already. I started using it right after I received it! I must say I really love it! Smells amazing, leaves the skin feeling soft and leave a really nice glow through out the day. I feel like already see my skin brighter and tighter. This is my first ole product and must say I will Definitely more products now.

I really liked this initially but then it started to make me break out. And breakout in areas I don’t normally breakout so I knew it was this. The way it smells is great and the way it feels on is good. There was just something about it that didn’t work for me. And I was really excited about it. So it’s kind of a bummer.  I did get this product for free from Influencer.
I am loving this serum! It smells great and leaves my skin glowing. I paired it with the moisturizer and it doesn’t make my skin look oily at all. The price is great for the huge bottle!
This serum leave your skin with a nice glow .!! I recommend

I wanted to wait until I finished the bottle until I wrote this review... honestly I am not impressed at all with this product. I don’t find it has done anything to “brighten” my skin, or my hyperpigmentation/acne scarring. It also has an overbearing ‘fake’ orange smell, and pills really badly under other products and makeup. For the price point, I would definitely say it does not deliver. I will stick to the truth serum, which has a better texture, smell, and does not pill! The truth serum also did a waaaay better job of improving the brightness of my skin and problem areas!

AMAZING SERUM. I definitely see results. I have been using it for 3 weeks now and I love how it keeps my skin glowing all day. I do follow it up with the C-Rush moisturizer which helps boost radiance but overall you can add any moisturizer for that matter. The only reason why I give it 4 stars is because the feeling it leaves behind. It feels tacky on the skin and gets sticky. It could be great before applying foundation but I prefer a non-sticky serum.

I would recommend this serum. A little bit does go a long way and I did see some of my dark spots and hyperpigmentation fading after two weeks of continued use. This serum is packed full of ingredients that are beneficial to the skin like vitamin C and hyaluronic acid. The only thing that I don’t really like is the smell. It’s one of those citrusy smells that seem artificial or candied-like and I’m not really a fan. It does fade away though Andre minutes after application.
I recently got this product a free gift from olehnriksen and I abso love it. It’s not heavy. Goes on smooth and really freshens my face has really helped my forehead lines. Thanks so much.
After using it my face feels refresh and cool. The only thing I didn’t like its the burning sensation when applying.

After trying this product which I received to try I was loving the texture. I have combination skin (sometimes oily, sometimes dry) and this gave my skin an overall glow that felt hydrating without leaving my skin sticky or oily

review_title: Good for my acne prone skin
review_text: I got this complimentary and I’ve only been using it for 3 days so ymmv! My skin tho has been loving it!! It smells similar to the mask, is cooling (great for summer), hydrating but not greasy! The scent could be overwhelming for some people but I personally love it! It’s veryyyy fresh!! I’m curious whether I’ll see any improvements to the skin texture since I’ve been very lazy with actives lately! It seems to be working out well for my acne prone combo skin!

The only downfall for me is the smell. I’ve had it on for a bit and I can still smell it on my skin. BUT it does make my skin feel cool and light and plump so I can definitely say I will continue to use and enjoy this product.

This moisturizer is so refreshing and light! It is perfect for summer time as it has a cooling effect on the skin. I also noticed a difference in my pore size. It is a pretty steep price but I would recommend this product :)

thought i was getting lots of acne caused by my mask, actually turns out it’s from this moisturizer.  found it to be really greasy and it made my acne worse. will not buy again. really wish they hadn’t changed the moisturizer from this brand :(

received this product complimentary from Influencer. I have used other OH products previously and think this is very similar to other moisturizers. I do enjoy the scent of this product and that it is cooling to the skin. It’s lightweight and makes my skin so soft. I would repurchase.

I got this product complimentary from Influenster. I have been using it for about a week now and I like it a lot. It gives my skin a fresh cool feeling and tingles slightly . I have noticed some improvement in my pores! Only reason I won’t give it 5 stars is it has caused me to break out a bit initially.  I would definitely recommend this product and the price point is great for an exceptional moisturizer.

This is old Hendricksens newest moisturizer!! It’s cooling to the skin and light to use. I got to try this product and I am loving it. Definitely good for my sensitive skin and I like that I just need to use it twice a day to see results. Helps drastically minimize the size of my pores too.
I like the product! I’ve been using it for a week now and I can tell you that it actually reduce the look of my pores. My skin also felt hydrated! The product is not heavy on my skin too.

Ive tried a loooot of micellar waters and this is by far my favorite! I use this after exercising during the day so I don’t have to wash my face and irritate it more. I don’t recommand to use it to wash your face at night, but it’s great for a quick refresh.

Ive tried a loooot of micellar waters and this is by far my favorite! I use this after exercising during the day so I don’t have to wash my face and irritate it more. I don’t recommand to use it to wash your face at night, but it’s great for a quick refresh.

Great micellar water! Hydrating and leaves skin feeling amazing. I like this way better than other micellar waters I’ve tried. This was the first DE product I’ve used, and although pricey, I now believe they may be worth it! I received this product complimentary from Influenster.

Great micellar water! Hydrating and leaves skin feeling amazing. I like this way better than other micellar waters I’ve tried. This was the first DE product I’ve used, and although pricey, I now believe they may be worth it! I received this product complimentary from Influenster.

review_title: The only lip balm/ treatment you will need
review_text: There is not much new to say about the lip product everyone loves it and with good reasons, for me I love the consistency, how I can use it not only during the day but it works wonders as a lip mask at night, summer fridays did that.

The vanilla! This Summer Fridays lip balm is vanilla-scented, but like, for real. It’s made with vanillin, the organic compound found naturally in vanilla beans, so the fragrance is a rich and complex, not artificial. There’s no flavor or sweetener here, just lots of hydration and a cool clear tip so you can see exactly how much product you’re dispensing.

Here is all I got to say about this product. It’s nice but it’s not worth the price. I love that the applicator is concave but that’s all about it that stands out from it’s competition. It has a nice subtle vanilla scent that I would describe as marsh mellow scent apposed to vanilla. I do really enjoy that scent, which is unmatched. If you are not a vanilla fan, this is good for you because it has a lighter marsh mellowier smell. Would I but it again? Meh, it’s nice but it’s not worth the price. There are many better lip products for hydration, rejuvenation, tint and shine. for instance Dior lip products, Lanolin, Aquaphor, and Kiehl’s #1 lip balm are all superior lip products for chap lips. Did I enjoy this product? Yes. Would I buy it again? No. But then again I only tried the Vanilla Beige lip butter, which is tinted.
its a pretty basic lip balm, it has a nice color too it as well, i enjoy it but it’s nothing insanely necessary to have

For starters, I’d actually never tried anything from Charlotte Tilbury before now. I’ve always been interested, but I had a hard time coughing up that kind of money on a brand I wasn’t familiar with. So, when I received the Charlotte Tilbury Magic Elixir, I was super stoked to get acquainted with the brand. The serum itself feels really nice on the skin. It’s not thick or tacky, and absorbs rather quickly. It also has a soft, delicate fragrance to it. Typically, I try to stay away from fragrances skincare as it’s just not necessary and has the potential to cause irritation, but the fragrance in this was non irritating and was also not overwhelmingly strong. If you’re familiar with the BareMinerals SkinLongevity Long Life Herb Serum, it is eerily similar. Like almost exact between the feel and scent. When using this serum, I just applied a few drops to my face before applying my moisturizer, and it seemed to play well with all of my other products in my skincare lineup. I used the entire bottle over the course of a month, and that was with conservatively sized amounts at each application, so it may not be a realistic product to add to your lineup if you’re budget conscious. Overall, I’m satisfied with the results this serum gave me. My skin did feel softer and less texturized. It also gave me a very healthy glow and did not irritate my skin whatsoever.

I got this as a deluxe sample and omg... it’s AMAZING. it smells super citrus-y which is really pleasant and it wakes you up for sure lol. it’s really hydrating and it feels suuuuuper lightweight. it sinks into the skin pretty quickly but only like 80% does, so you still feel  hydrated. definitely a summer lotion, but it still does the job during the winter. once this runs out, I’m definitely buying the fill sized product. :)

review_title: A GLASS OF OJ FOR MY FACE
review_text: So refreshing! My skin is combo/oily depending on days but it absorbs this moisturizer and just instantly feels energized and refreshed. It’s like a glass of fresh orange juice and my skin just drinks it up. It smells like OJ too! It’s a very light formula so it applied smoothly and blends out nicely, leaving no streaks or crumbs just like the eye cream from the same line. Perfect for when I have to start the day early and need a little something to wake me up! Will definitely repurchase!!!

This is a great lightweight moisturizer. But, as it’s energizing, I wonder why it doesn’t have SPF because it’s definitely supposed to be a daytime product. I have combination-oily skin and it was nice and lightweight on my skin and absorbed quickly...if it had SPF 25 at least it would get five stars! I received one to try out for testing purposes for free and am enjoying it, so it you’re looking for a good lightweight moisturizer to wake you up in the AM, try this one.
Decent moisturizer. If you have oily skin I don’t recommend this since it made my skin oily right away.
Non-greasy but at the same time not very moisturizing. It feels really light on the skin with refreshing smell, it’s a nice day cream but definitely not enough for winter.

I love the scent of this! I love how it transformed my skin... so Idk why I haven’t bought this again!! The craziest part is that this isn’t even targeted towards people who have acne! and it removed all my acne! I love this it makes my skin feel awake and now my skin is not so good so I should definitely repurchase this! its been too long :(  It smells very citrus so if you don’t enjoy that scent I wouldn’t recommend it but if you can look past that get it!!!
I love this moisturizer! Clean citrus smell and leaves the skin soft. Great for sensitive skin!  Tip: a little bit goes a long way!!
